articles.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
articles.content: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 春克法案:代理机器人动作春克
articles.content_zh: 代理机器人在机器人控制回路中放置了一款大型语言模型(LLM)代理,由它将感知,运动,和视觉-语言动作(VLA)工具作成于一个内存的引导下,从而在不进行再培训的情况下被概括为新任务. 这种通俗性以高效益为代价。 每个原始人都需要在完整的互动史上进行一轮LLM推理,因此一集的成本随着原始人的数量而增加. 我们认为这一推理在很大程度上是多余的:一旦选择了一个子目标,它的原始就遵循了内存已经规定的常规. 我们介绍Chunk Act, 它引入动作块化 代理机器人。 Online,单调会发射出一整块被链式的原始人,这些原始人只在失败时自动执行并返回控制. 下行,ChunkAct将内存编译入这些块中,因此执行在测试时是无内存的,计划员被保留给需要推理的决定. 因此,LLM的计算以决定数而不是原始数为尺度. 在LIBERO-Pro上,ChunkAct在代理机器人的艺术状态上提高了5.0分,同时需要2.9x更少的LLM调用,4.4x更少的输入符,2.3x更少的输出符.

articles.title: LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts
articles.content: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce \textbf{LoopWAM}, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67\% to 43.33\%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5\% average success on RoboTwin~2.0 and 49.5\% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20\% to 55.56\%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. \href{https://loop-wam.github.io/}{\textcolor{orange}{Project Page}}
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LoopWAM:从部署推出中改进闭环一般政策
articles.content_zh: 仅仅扩大专家示范并不能使通用机器人政策从部署中改进。 现实世界的推出包含成功,次最佳行为,和失败:模仿每一个被记录的行动会强化不良行为,而过滤失败则会丢弃物理相互作用的证据及其后果. 我们引入了\textbf{LooopWAM},这是一种闭路世界行动模式,它直接从这个全质量的谱系中学习,同时利用其自身和其他部署的政策的推广。 依赖源的噪音取样统一了行为学习和行动条件世界模型,而质量指导和质量加权监督则保留了跨质量的全面视频监督并规范了动作模仿. 视频和动作符号在整个平行的发号施令过程中相互作用,使学到的后果能够直接告知行动产生者。 在"机器人挑战"(RoboChallenge Table30-V2)上,三轮部署与训练将成功率从23.67分提高到43.33分,收获了19.7%的得分,最终得分为56.80分. ROOPWAM在RoboTwin~2.0和49.5X在RoboCasa365上取得了平均成功,但没有增加预训,在所有三个基准的比较方法中取得了最佳的总体结果。 在挑战性衬衫折叠任务方面,单任务后培训后两轮部署驱动的改进将成功率从13.20分提高到55.56分. 这些结果表明,在多任务学习和单一任务后培训中,从混合质量经验来看,封闭式学习有所改进。 \href{https://loop-wam.github.io/\textcolor{orang-}项目 页 次

articles.title: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
articles.content: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoExplorer:人类Loco管理远景-运动-Touch观测站 在锡图
articles.content_zh: 从人类的演示中学习人性化的机能操纵取决于观察运动、姿态和物体相互作用如何随着任务的发展而共同演变。 扩大不同环境的收集工作,进而有利于轻量级、可移动的捕获系统。 然而,现有的数据集只提供了这种协调的部分观点。 因此,我们引入了EgoExplorer,一个用可穿戴系统建造的百小时视觉-运动-触控人类机能操纵观测站. 其以专业活动为重点,不断录制的以自我为中心的视频与被重建的全身运动,精细的发指和触觉观察相配合,并附有阶梯级描述. 为了用稀疏的体能感知来达到这个覆盖范围,我们开发了Calibrate-Complete-Constratin管道. 具体地说,可再用校正在运动推论之前,先修补参与者几何和传感器附件,以分解与表达相接的安装相抵. 在时间之前完成不可观察的联合运动,而分层限制则促进测量协议、时间连续性和几何一致性,而光是运动的合理性并不能保证。 对照跟踪器的参考文献,该方法比最强基线减少了71.9%的机身点出错;相匹配的评价也显示在手部稳定性和接触估计方面有所改进。 初步研究探索在模拟中结合人造物重新瞄准全身控制进行多模式生成和调节。

articles.title: Dog-Breed Text-to-image Flow Matching from Pretraining to Fine-Tuning on 4 Consumer GPUs
articles.content: We generally perceive that training text-to-image diffusion models requires heavy compute: it is true if we aim at a comprehensive frontier model. This understanding prevents people from training their own models when getting started in the field. We develop MiniDog, a framework that enables pretraining diffusion transformers in 55 minutes and fine-tuning in another 15 minutes on four 3090 GPUs. For data, we use 26k dog images from ImageNet and caption them for pretraining and use 2k images generated by FLUX.1-schnell for fine-tuning. We precompute the image and text features and cache them for efficiency. For architecture, we use E2E-INVAE for its semantic latent space, a small transformer with 22M parameters, a small Qwen model for text encoding, and in-context conditioning. For training, we use iREPA and an EUPE perception encoder for acceleration. For evaluation, our repository supports FID, HPSv2 score, PickScore, and various VAE reconstruction metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在 4 块消费级 GPU 上从预训练到微调的犬种文本到图像流匹配
articles.content_zh: 我们通常认为，训练文本到图像扩散模型需要大量算力：如果我们旨在打造一个全面的前沿模型，这确实是事实。这种认知阻碍了人们在该领域入门时训练自己的模型。我们开发了 MiniDog，一个框架，能够在四块 3090 GPU 上于 55 分钟内完成扩散 Transformer 的预训练，并在另外 15 分钟内完成微调。在数据方面，我们使用来自 ImageNet 的 26k 张狗图像，并为它们添加描述用于预训练；同时使用 FLUX.1-schnell 生成的 2k 张图像用于微调。我们预计算图像和文本特征并缓存它们以提高效率。在架构方面，我们使用 E2E-INVAE 以获得其语义潜空间、一个具有 22M 参数的小型 Transformer、一个用于文本编码的小型 Qwen 模型，以及上下文条件机制。在训练方面，我们使用 iREPA 和 EUPE 感知编码器进行加速。在评估方面，我们的仓库支持 FID、HPSv2 分数、PickScore 以及各种 VAE 重建指标。

study.overview: MiniDog：开源代码库与配方，在四块 RTX 3090 上从零预训练文本到图像 flow matching 扩散 Transformer（狗图像），预训练约 55 分钟、SFT 约 15 分钟，256×256 达 gFID 8.32。
study.problem: 训练文本到图像扩散模型通常被认为需要巨大算力，初学者难以跑通完整训练流程。作者提供数据、架构、训练方法与评估齐备的轻量方案，使人能在消费级 GPU 上完成预训练与微调；目标为 democratizing T2I training，不追求构建通用完整 T2I 模型。工作聚焦狗图像生成，并比较外部视觉编码器、REPA 与 iREPA 对齐方式、MSE 与 cosine 对齐损失，以及 supervised fine-tuning 的影响。
study.method: 数据：ImageNet 26k 狗图重标注预训练，FLUX.1-schnell 生成 2k 图 SFT。架构：E2E-INVAE tokenizer；22.06M、12 block LightningDiT（RMSNorm、query-key normalization、SwiGLU、2D RoPE）；Qwen3-0.6B 文本编码，in-context conditioning。冻结 tokenizer、文本与目标编码器，缓存 latent、文本嵌入与 patch 特征。rectified flow 直线路径（α_t=1-t, σ_t=t）flow matching loss + iREPA 对齐损失（Block 4，λ=0.5；3×3 卷积、padding 1、patch 归一化 γ=0.7、ε=1e-6），EUPE 加速；SFT 关闭 REPA。
study.evidence: 最佳配方 E2E-INVAE + 128 token caption + iREPA（MSE）+ EUPE，gFID=8.32；SFT 后 HPSv2=0.2427，PickScore=19.61。4×3090 预训练 200 epoch 55 分钟、SFT 100 epoch 15 分钟；单卡预训练约 3 小时、SFT 21 分钟，显存至少 10 GiB（训练中评估 FID 需 15 GiB）。E2E-INVAE 重建与可扩散性优于 E2E-VAVAE；长 caption 收敛更快；REPA/iREPA 加速收敛，MSE 优于 cosine；编码器比较原文截断。SFT 的 FID 更高但数值未列，作者归因于偏离预训练分布；Fig. 1 为精选图；Table 3/4 具体数值材料未提供。
study.limitations: 作者自述：MiniDog 不构建全面的 T2I 模型，只是面向狗图像生成的极简项目；SFT 以更高 FID 换取偏好分数提升。材料在“Comparing different vision encoders”处截断，未见明确 limitations 章节，也无多随机种子、失败案例或数据偏置讨论。以下为建议核查而非作者陈述：gFID 基于自有 26k 参考图与提示词，能否与外部结果直接比较；20 个狗品种与狗域结论能否外推；用 FLUX.1-schnell 合成数据做 SFT 的效果与风险；iREPA 等加速结论是否基于单次运行；SFT 的 FID 数值、Fig. 1 精选图、依赖奖励模型而非人工评测；编码器对比完整数值需回原文核对。
learning: rectified flow 的直线路径 α_t=1-t、σ_t=t 与 DDPM 类噪声调度在训练目标和采样过程上有何区别？
REPA/iREPA 如何用外部视觉编码器（DINOv2、DINOv3、PE-Spatial、EUPE 等）的目标特征对齐中间层来加速收敛？为何 iREPA 用 3×3 卷积替换线性投影并按 patch 归一化？对齐层与 λ 如何选择？
如何用 gFID、HPSv2、PickScore 以及 VAE 重建指标 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、rFID 分别评估生成模型与 tokenizer？FID 与 HPSv2/PickScore 为何可能给出相反结论，应如何权衡质量、多样性与人类偏好？

articles.title: Cepheid: Decoupling Scale from Structure for Cross-Family Motion Completion
articles.content: Sparse-to-dense motion completion recovers dense mesh motion from sparse vertex displacements. Residual priors trained on one geometry family frequently fail to beat parameter-free harmonic extension off-family. Moreover, cross-family training meets a scaling barrier: residual amplitude varies by more than an order of magnitude across geometry families and collapses as observations become denser. Since this scale depends on unknown target motion, it cannot be measured directly at test time. We decouple residual structure from physical scale by learning a dimensionless prior, estimating amplitude from observables and a lightweight correction fitted only on training sources. Our unified model surpasses harmonic extension across all evaluated families, including unseen cloth and legged bodies, without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. The same prior applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body. Project page: https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Cepheid: 跨家庭运动完成结构脱钩
articles.content_zh: Sparse-to-dense 运动完成后从稀少的顶点迁移中恢复了密集的网状运动. 在一个几何学家庭接受过培训的剩余前科人员往往无法在家庭外击败无参数口音扩展。 此外,跨家庭培训还遇到一个缩放障碍:残余振幅在几何家族之间变化幅度超过一个数量级,随着观测密度增大而崩溃. 由于这个尺度取决于未知的目标运动,因此无法在测试时直接测量. 我们从物理尺度中分解出残余结构,先学习一个无维度,从可观测物中估计振幅,以及只安装在训练来源上的轻量级校正。 我们的统一模式超越了所有被评价家庭的口音延伸,包括没有骨架、登记或交叉通信的看不见的布和腿的尸体。 同样的前作在不进行再培训的情况下适用于有指向的动物视频和抓住柔软身体的机器人. 项目网页:https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/

articles.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
articles.content: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Tev: 扩展长线代理环境,并给予合理进步奖励
articles.content_zh: 长视距物剂越来越引起人们注意,它们能够自发地 -- -- 从小时到天天 -- -- 执行具有经济价值的任务,这是自动发现和递归自我改进所必不可少的能力。 然而开源模式在长距离任务上仍然挣扎着,主要因为缺乏培训数据和工作食谱,而规模化两者都是很困难的:长而复杂的任务很难处理和核实,其回报也很少. 我们讨论两个。 首先,我们介绍Tev-Gym,这是第一个具有可核查的,密集的,渐进的奖励的长视距特工训练数据集——跨7个领域核查的1,170个任务环境. 它基于一种潜在的世界第一方法,首先构建一个潜在的世界:对任务领域、工作流程和每个步骤之后的预期状态的完整和正确的隐藏规格。 然后,每项任务都从这一规格逐步转化为一种能产生物剂的环境,从而实现可控制的复杂性和自然进展的衡量标准。 第二,我们把这一衡量标准变成一种培训方法:通过制定进步潜力奖励(PPRS),我们把进步转化为密集的逐步奖励,提高培训效率,使否则无法完成的任务能够训练。 使用这种食谱进行的培训产生了Tev-27B,这在代理最后考试的计算和数学科学领域(ALE-CM)上取得了实质性成果,在Pass@5上与GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5相匹配。 尽管仅接受ALE相关数据培训,它还是概括到终端-奔驰(TB)3.0和4.0子集,超过了GLM 5.2和双子座 3.7 Flash,并在TB 2.1等中视任务上达到克洛德·奥普斯 4.8级的性能.

articles.title: PLAYGROUND: Progressive Layout Generation with Render-Grounded Planning
articles.content: Generating editable graphic designs requires arranging visual and textual elements into a coherent composition while preserving their content and editability. Although recent MLLM-based approaches employ iterative generation and visual refinement to reflect the real-world design workflows, their high-level plans are predetermined prior to execution, limiting their adaptability as the design evolves. To address this limitation, we propose PlayGround, a progressive layout generation framework that dynamically adapts to the current rendered canvas. PlayGround establishes a progressive design loop comprising a Progressive Planner, a Layout Generator, and a Visual Verifier, guided by a Structure-Aware Retriever. Given an initial set of unordered elements, the Structure-Aware Retriever initially infers a coarse layout structure to retrieve structurally similar reference designs. Subsequently, at each turn, the Progressive Planner examines the current rendered canvas alongside the remaining elements, forms the next functional group, and plans its composition. The Layout Generator then predicts editable layout attributes, while the Visual Verifier evaluates rendered candidates and provides feedback when refinement is necessary. To train the Progressive Planner with step-wise supervision, we construct a two-stage data generation pipeline that extracts functional groups and turn-level planning trajectories from completed designs. Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate the effectiveness of PlayGround over existing methods. Our code and weights will be publicly released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PLAYGROUND: 渐进式布局的生成, 以轮廓规划
articles.content_zh: 生成可编辑的图形设计需要将视觉元素和文字元素排列成一个连贯的构成,同时保留其内容和可编辑性. 虽然最近基于MLLM的方法采用迭代生成和视觉改进来反映现实世界的设计工作流程,但其高层次的计划在执行前是预先确定的,随着设计的发展限制了它们的适应性. 为了解决这个限制,我们提议PlayGround,一个渐进的布局生成框架,能动态地适应当前制成的画布. PlayGround 建立了一个渐进式设计环,包括一个渐进式规划器,一个布局生成器,和一个视觉验证器,由结构-智能检索器指导. 由于初始的一组无序元素,结构-Aware Retriever最初推断出粗糙的布局结构来取回结构上相近的参考设计. 随后,进步规划员在每一回合都与其余要素一起审查目前形成的情况,组成下一个职能小组,并规划其组成。 然后布局生成器预测出可编辑的布局属性,而视觉验证器则评审出候选人,并在需要改进时提供反馈. 为了对进步规划师进行分步监督的培训,我们建造了一个两阶段的数据生成管道,从已完成的设计中抽取功能组和回合级的规划轨迹。 Crello和LICA的实验演示了PlayGround在现有方法之上的有效性. 我们的代码和重量将公开发布。

articles.title: Visual Tokens on Demand: Visual Budgeting for Scalable and Efficient Multi-Image Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 需求上的可视化键:可视化和高效的多图像预算编制方法
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型已经迅速进步,但大多数仍然为单一图像输入而优化。 多图像推理成本高昂,因为每个图像都增加了许多视觉符号,增加了编码和注意力需求. 解决上述问题的现有技术,包括可视化活物活化,可视化活化,可视化活物活化,可被学习到的再模版,分级压缩,可取回-可取取取的可视化推理,以及基于内存的架构,基本上都是为单相图情景设计而来,冗余主要是空间和局部的. 多图像推理带来了更多的挑战:在图像之间可能出现冗余,与任务相关的证据可能稀少或分布,积极的逐一图像压缩可以去除比较,计数,时间推理,检索,或证据地基所需的细节. 此外,现有的降标方法往往要么是(一) 无培训但具有推论效率,通常依靠访问注意矩阵来获得对FlashAttent等具有内存效率的注意实施访问可能不切实际的表示重要性,要么是(二) 依赖培训,要求重新培训或调整基础的MLLM,使之适应新的压缩调取模式。 在这项工作中,我们研究可伸缩的多图像推理和理解,而不对基准模型进行再培训,也不在推论时间访问注意矩阵. 为此,我们提出mmVB,一个轻量级的插座和游戏模块,通过跨图像上下文分配查询条件的每个图像符号预算,只增加1.6M可列车参数,同时将可视输入符号减少9x. 这种降能产生更快的5x时间到一键并减少7x预填FLOP,同时在8个多图像推理基准中保持94.4%的全分辨率精度.

articles.title: PixelMoE: Scaling Pixel-Space Diffusion with LLM-Style Mixture-of-Experts
articles.content: Pixel-space diffusion models provide an appealing alternative to latent-space diffusion models by directly modeling raw images without relying on a learned tokenizer. However, scaling pixel-space models has predominantly followed dense strategies, tightly coupling model capacity with active computation. In this work, we show that standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can be effectively transferred to pixel-space diffusion. Building on this finding, we introduce PixelMoE, a pixel-space generative framework that sparsely scales model capacity with standard LLM-style MoE, without diffusion-specific routing mechanisms or auxiliary routing objectives. Specifically, PixelMoE combines standard Token-Choice (TC) routing with fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation, a shared expert for capturing common representations, and a bias-based load-balancing strategy. To complement sparse capacity scaling, PixelMoE further introduces Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, which varies spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory from global structure formation to fine-grained detail refinement. At comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales, demonstrating effective sparse capacity scaling in pixel space. On class-conditional ImageNet-1K, PixelMoE achieves FID scores of 1.47 at 256x256 and 1.53 at 512x512 without representation alignment or perceptual losses, comparing favorably with leading pixel-space and latent-space generative models. Code and models will be released soon.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 像素MoE:用 LLM- Style- Mixture- of- Experts 放大像素- 空间扩散
articles.content_zh: 像素-空间传播模型为潜在-空间传播模型提供了一种有吸引力的替代方法,方法是直接对原始图像进行建模,而无需依赖所学的示意器. 然而,缩放像素-空间模型主要遵循密集策略,将模型能力与活性计算紧密相接. 在这部作品中,我们显示标准LLM-风格的Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)架构可以被有效转移到像素-空间传播. 基于这一发现,我们引入了像素-空间基因框架PixelMoE,这个像素-空间基因框架以标准的LLM-风格的MOE来缩小模型容量,没有扩散专用的路由机制或辅助路由目标. 具体来说,PixelMoE将标准Token-Choice(TC)的路由与精致的路由专家结合,用于输入-适应性稀疏的计算,一个用于捕捉共同表述的共享专家,以及基于偏差的负载平衡策略. 为了补充容量稀疏的缩放,PixelMoE进一步引入了Pixel-Space相位相匹配(Pixel-Space signal flow matching),它沿着从全球结构形成到精细细细细化的去诺化轨迹的空间分辨率不同. 在可比的活性参数计数中,PixelMoE在模型尺度上一贯地超过其密集的对等方,显示出在像素空间中有效的容量稀有缩放. 在类条件的ImageNet-1K上,PixelMoE在256x256和512x512上分别取得了1.47分和1.53分的FID分数,没有表现对接或知觉损失,与领先的像素-空间和潜入空间的基因模型进行了有利的比较. 代码和模型将很快发布.

articles.title: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
articles.content: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldRecon:用于大型立体重建的基因多维多维网络重建 世界
articles.content_zh: 从无位多视图图像中再造出完整,高品质的大型场景网格,需要忠实的几何地平面,而巧妙地完成无法观察或仅被稀有地捕获的地表. 我们介绍的是WorldRecon,一个基因多视图重建框架,用于从未显示的RGB图像中恢复完整,大规模的3D场景间隙. WorldRecon使用一个粗糙,吵闹的全球点云和相机,从重建模型的输入图像中估算出来,作为全景生成的全球脚手架,并将其分割成相重叠的空间块. 为了有力地利用这些不完善的几何前缀,我们为本地的3D基因模型TRELLIS.2配备了专用的以重建为基础的取材结构,从它的局部点-云作物和与块相关的图像观测中生成出每个块,产生稀疏的结构,详细的几何和PBR材料. 为了保持场景层面的一致性,我们引入了了解邻居潜在油漆和因果世界生成程序,将结构、几何和物质背景传播到相互重叠的街区。 这些设计共同将多景基因重建规模扩大到了大规模场景,产生了连贯,统一的网格. 广泛的实验表明,世界Recon实现了最先进的重建性能,将Chamfer的距离减少了14.9%和43.1%,同时在合成和现实世界室内场景上,F分数分别比最强的基线提高17.3%和12.0%,从而展示了忠实而完整的基因重建以及强烈的平面到现实的通化. 项目网页:https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.

articles.title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.content: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 人类最后建造的遥感模型? 将任何地球观测任务设定为递归自我改进
articles.content_zh: 地球观测(EO)模型仍然由人工构建. 对于每一项新任务,专家都设计出一种培训方法,并参照基准加以调整。 我们显示这个循环可以交给代理商. 任何可核查的任务都可以作为牵引装置和验证装置,在这种装置中,验证装置界定了代理人可以使用什么,验证装置界定了什么是成功。 每个EO任务都可以通过标注的基准,独立的传感器,物理模型或同一地的反复观测来进行可核查. 仅考虑到这两个组成部分,通用编码剂就构建了EO模型,并根据自己的输出递归改进. 设置长期以来被视为单独的研究问题,从用少数标签学习到跨域适应,成为了使用和核实的选择。 在跨越光学、合成孔径雷达和多光谱时间序列图象的4个EO基准上,特制模型超过了最新水平,并且将大部分精确度保持在培训标签的1%左右。 这为EO建立了一个新的范式,在这种范式中,人们设计了用具和核查员以及代理商来构建模型,因此EO模型会像代理商一样得到改进.

articles.title: RepProbe: Can Video Language Models Count Repeated Actions? A Diagnostic Benchmark
articles.content: Repetition counting requires identifying and enumerating action cycles over time. While state-of-the-art video language models describe actions fluently, they fail to reliably count how many times an action repeats. To investigate this limitation, we introduce RepProbe, a benchmark of 42K real and synthetic video clips containing exactly k in [1, 20] complete repetitions, with controls for clip position, temporal coverage, and duration. These controls allow us to study the counting failure directly and locate where in the model it arises. Counting accuracy collapses at high counts across the video language models we evaluate, and controlled experiments show this collapse is not explained by frame sampling alone. We compare model outputs with linear probes trained on the final-layer representations used to generate those outputs. We find a consistent representation-to-output dissociation: substantial count information remains linearly decodable even when models fail to report the correct count. Further analysis shows this failure arises primarily at the output stage, where answers concentrate on a small set of preferred numbers rather than the available count information. The dissociation holds on both real and synthetic videos and is not explained by clip duration, position, or scene content. These results indicate that models encode repetition structure but do not reliably report it in their outputs. Project page: https://arenaa.github.io/RepProbe-webpage/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RepProbe:视频语言模型能够计算重复动作吗? 诊断基准
articles.content_zh: 重复计算需要确定和列出随时间演变的行动周期。 虽然最先进的视频语言模型对动作的描述很流利,但它们无法可靠地计算一个动作重复了多少次. 为了调查这一限制,我们引入了RepProbe,一个包含[1,20]个完全重复中准确k的42K真实和合成视频片段的基准,并控制了片段位置,时间覆盖和持续时间. 这些控制可以让我们直接研究计数失败,并找到模型中发生的地点. 我们所评价的视频语言模型 在高点上计算精度倒塌 受控实验显示这种倒塌不是光用帧取样来解释的 我们把模型输出与经过培训的线性探测器比较,这些探测器是用来生成这些输出的末层表示。 我们发现一种一致的表达-输出分解:即使模型未能报告正确的计数,大量计数信息仍可线性解码. 进一步的分析表明,这种失败主要发生在产出阶段,在产出阶段,答案集中在少数首选数字而不是现有的计数信息上。 分离状态既包含真实的视频,也包含合成的视频,没有用剪辑时间、位置或场景内容来解释。 这些结果表明模型编码了重复结构,但不能可靠地在其产出中报告。 项目网页:https://arenaa.github.io/RepProbe-webpage/

articles.title: Scaling Online Optimal Transport Minibatches for Flow Matching
articles.content: A central challenge in scaling flow models is maintaining stability in training and integration. In flow matching, this stability depends critically on how source samples are paired with data. Independent random pairing introduces substantial stochasticity, motivating minibatch optimal transport (OT) to construct online source-target couplings that reduce this randomness (Tong et al., 2024). However, as applications extend to larger and higher-dimensional datasets, small minibatches can limit these benefits, while scaling the coupling to substantially larger minibatches at every iteration is computationally prohibitive. Moreover, how OT coupling affects the full stochastic gradient and integration remains theoretically unresolved. In this work, we develop a scalable online entropic OT approximation that enables substantially larger source-target couplings while preserving the benefits of OT. We close the theoretical gap for both unregularized and entropic OT by proving strict reductions in full stochastic-gradient variance and integration error relative to independent pairing, and further characterize how these improvements strengthen as the online coupling minibatch grows. Experiments on single-cell gene interpolation-flow and image-flow training validate these predictions, showing that larger online couplings consistently improve training stability and final generation performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 放大在线优化运输量
articles.content_zh: 扩大流动模式的一个中心挑战是保持培训和一体化的稳定。 在流量匹配中,这种稳定性主要取决于来源样本如何与数据对接. 独立随机对接引入了实质性的分色性,激发了小批量优化运输(OT)构建可减少这种随机性的在线源-目标耦合(Tong等,2024年)。 然而,随着应用程序扩展到更大型和更高维的数据集,小型小炮管可以限制这些好处,而在每个频率上将接合范围扩大为大得多的小炮管则在计算上令人望而却步。 此外,OT接合如何影响全分层梯度和整合,理论上仍未得到解决。 在这部作品中,我们开发出可伸缩的在线Entropic OT近似,在保留OT的好处的同时,能够使源-目标耦合大大地扩大. 我们通过证明与独立配对相比, 严格减少完全的相位相位差和集成误差, 并进一步描述随着网络接合小批量的增长, 关于单细胞基因内插-流和图像-流训练的实验验证了这些预测,显示更大的在线耦合持续地提高训练稳定性和最终生成性能.

articles.title: Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Plan-Bench:现存的VLM能在健康的世界里超越理智和计划?
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)在视觉感知和空间推理上取得了很强的性能,导致人们越来越有兴趣将其用作体现AI的高级规划者. 然而,物理任务需要模型来整合空间信息,理性超时状态,并在各种限制下产生多步骤计划,这就提出了当前VLM能否可靠地支持这种推理和规划而独立于执行的问题. 我们提出Bench计划,作为评估与所体现世界相关的自愿活动高级别推理和多步骤规划能力的基准,同时隔离行动执行的影响。 它涵盖三个相辅相成的层面,包括16个子类和699个整理样本。 对28个VLM的广泛评价表明,还有改进的余地,即使是最强的模型也只有75.0%的准确度。 我们进一步发现,这种模型的扩大总体上提高了这些能力。 校正研究还表明,作为高级规划人员,较大的模型显示出越来越大的潜力。 总体而言,Bench计划提供了一个轻量级的探测器,用于评价与所体现环境有关的脆弱LM的推理和规划能力,并评估其作为实际任务的决策者的潜力。 我们的基准和代码见https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench。

articles.title: Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?
articles.content: Visual reasoning is an important capability for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand visual evidence, spatial structure, constraints, and state changes. Existing evaluations mainly rely on real-world data or procedurally generated tasks. Real-world data preserve natural complexity, while procedural games provide controllable generation and verifiable solutions. However, it remains unclear whether abilities measured in toy games correspond to real-world visual reasoning and whether game examples can support transfer. We introduce Game2Real-Bench, a benchmark that studies these connections across four capability groups, including fine-grained perception, spatial reasoning, constraint reasoning, and sequential planning. We construct 1,000 procedurally generated game samples with executable verification and curate 400 real-world samples aligned by shared reasoning requirements rather than visual similarity. We evaluate 25 representative VLMs and observe strong game-to-real consistency, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.935. We further study one-shot game-to-real transfer on four models. Constraint reasoning improves for several models, while fine-grained perception declines with game demonstrations. We also construct Game2Real-Dataset with nearly 24K verified game samples across 18 tasks and 65 QA families. Our benchmark, dataset, and code are available at https://github.com/QingAnLiu/Game2Real-Bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Game2 Real-Bench:玩具游戏启示和转会到现实世界视觉理性?.
articles.content_zh: 视觉推理是视觉语言模型(VLMs)了解视觉证据,空间结构,约束,以及状态变化的重要能力. 现有评价主要依靠现实世界的数据或程序产生的任务。 现实世界的数据保存了自然的复杂性,而程序游戏则提供可控制的生成和可核查的解决方案. 然而,仍然不清楚玩具游戏中所测量的能力是否与现实世界的视觉推理相对应,游戏实例是否能够支持转移. 我们引入了Game2Real-Bench,这个基准研究这些联系涉及四个能力组,包括精细感知,空间推理,约束推理和相继规划. 我们建造了1 000个程序生成的游戏样本,进行可执行的核查,并按共同推理要求而不是视觉相似性对400个现实世界样本进行校正。 我们评价了25个具有代表性的VLM,并观察到了强大的游戏对现实的一致性,而皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼的相互关系为0.935. 我们进一步研究四个模型上的一发相机的游戏转会. 约束推理对多款模型有所改进,而精细的感想随着游戏演示而下降. 我们还建造了Game2Real-Dataset,在18个任务和65个QA家族中拥有近24K个经过验证的游戏样本. 我们的基准、数据集和代码见https://github.com/QingAnLiu/Game2Real-Bench。

articles.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
articles.content: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniCompass:Omni-Modal视频定位和理解的整体基准
articles.content_zh: 随着多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)的迅速发展,评价其视频理解能力变得日益重要. 现有的视频理解基准只涵盖部分评价层面,限制了对全方位模式视频理解的系统诊断. 我们引入了OmniCompass,这是全方位模式视频定位和理解的整体基准. OmniCompass 定义了两个评价轨道: OmniCompass-VL对需要视觉证据的任务进行视觉语言模型评估,而OmniCompass-AV对需要视听联合证据的任务进行全方位模型评估. 每个轨道包括三项相辅相成的任务:时间定位(TG)、空间定位(SG)和问答(QA),评估一个被引用的目标何时出现、在哪里以及会发生什么。 QA涵盖OmniCompass-VL中的5个认知和3个推理类,而OmniCompass-AV中的3个认知和2个推理类. OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频和2,460个跨域实例,以及短、中和长三种持续时间类型。 一个叙述和音频丰富的子集组成了OmniCompass-AV,包含240个视频和720个实例. 每个实例在两个对齐的设置下进行评估:仅文本和文本+图像,通过文本和可视语言指导来指定同一目标. 所有实例都用人工说明,并进行多轮质量核查。 对50个小额供资和微型企业的评价表明,开放源码模式仍然落后于专有模式,特别是在视听理解方面。 精确的时间和空间定位即使在领先的模型中也仍然具有挑战性,其预测仍然显示出成对的目标规格不一致。

articles.title: WorldOracle: Benchmarking Action-Conditioned World Models against Real-World Executions
articles.content: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We will release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: World Oracle:制定打击现实世界处决的行动模式基准
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了WorldOracle,这是专门用来评价有行动条件的世界模式(ACWMs)与对等的现实世界处决的基准. 鉴于相同的初始观察和低级动作序列,WorldOracle询问预测的推出是否复制了现实世界中发生的事情,包括物理后果和任务状态过渡. 我们按照四个互补的方面评价模型:物理状态正确性、相互作用的空间相接性、关键的相互作用领域忠贞性和多视角行动的一致性。 为支持这一评价,我们管理涵盖不同互动动态和表现的现实世界培训和评价套件。 评价套装包括长而多的、成功和失败的处决事件,从而能够对各种行动结果和行为分布进行评价。 对7个具有代表性的ACWM的实验揭示出不同的模型优势和故障模式. WorldOracle为衡量和推进以行动为条件的世界操纵模式提供了系统的基础. 我们将发布数据集,评估代码和领导板。

articles.title: DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing
articles.content: Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model's own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. From a common supervised Wan-Image initialization, gated joint training reaches 77.08% complete compliance, compared with 70.92% without gates and 75.00% when generation-local supervision instead checks the original task with both gates retained. These results support distinct local responsibilities and selective shared feedback for joint understanding-generation adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 双相桥:统一图像编辑的协调理解和生成
articles.content_zh: 复杂的图像编辑需要忠实的任务解释和准确的执行,但失败的编辑并不能显示哪个责任失败了. 我们提出"双相通"(DuplexBridge),它使用一个统一的模型自己的理解能力来增强自身的生成能力的快感,而没有外部的理解模块. 以源为底的桥梁具体规定了目标、最终状态变化和保存限制。 在不观察生成的图像的情况下,在忠实于原始请求的情况下,对理解进行监督;在实际获得的条件执行时,对生成进行监督。 对等信托检查有选择地接受对每个角色的全球任务反馈,同时保留独立有效的地方监督. 我们采用了CE-Bench,这是一个1 200个任务基准,衡量任务产生的变化和保存要求的共同满意度。 在三个模型配置中,整个系统比直接编辑改进了21.75-25.75个百分点的完全合规性,在KRIS-Bench、RISE-Bench、ImgEdit和Gedit-Bench上也观察到收益。 从共同监督的Wan-Image初始化情况来看,门式联合培训达到77.08%的完全合规率,而70.92%没有门;75.0%的代地监督则保留了两个门,以检查原先的任务。 这些结果支持了独特的地方责任和有选择地共享反馈,以便共同理解-生成适应。

articles.title: Registration is a Representation Problem: Solving Whole-Body PET/CT Registration
articles.content: Raw image intensities are a poor surrogate for similarity across images in correspondence problems. Further, while auxiliary segmentation labels can provide semantic identification and improve matching, they can assign only coarse identities to fine-grained anatomy and often cover only a subset of structures, particularly in whole-body settings. We present an approach that instead establishes correspondence using complementary representations of anatomy and demonstrate its utility for longitudinal whole-body PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg Challenge. Our 3D foundation model, anatomix, is used to derive fine-grained, per-voxel semantic representations that are consistent across volumes, and we further employ off-the-shelf segmentation models to obtain coarse anatomical identities. Together, these representations drive a GPU-accelerated iterative registration solver (FireANTs) in a hybrid multistage framework: the first stage estimates alignment from dense multi-channel features, after which a second refines the deformation using both anatomix- and segmentation-based losses. Lastly, because registration should not introduce non-biological tumor volume changes across time, we develop lesion-specific component-wise volume preservation schemes. Without any task-specific training, our system won first place in the PSMAReg Challenge leaderboard. Code and interactive visualizations are available at http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 登记是一个代表问题:解决整体-Body PET/CT登记
articles.content_zh: 原始图像强度(Raw image intentity)是通信问题中图像之间相似性的劣质代词. 此外,虽然辅助分解标签可以提供语义识别并改进匹配,但它们只能将粗糙的特征指定给精细的解剖学,而且往往只覆盖一子集的结构,特别是在全身设置中. 我们提出了一种办法,即利用解剖学的补充表述来建立通信,并展示其在 " 学习2Reg 2026 PSMAREG挑战 " 中纵向全身PET/CT注册的效用。 我们的3D基础模型-Anatomix,被用于得出精细的,每伏克索尔语义表达式,在数量上是一致的,我们进一步使用现成的分解模型来获得粗糙的解剖特征. 这些表示式共同驱动了混合多相架构中GPU加速迭代登记解析器(FireANTs):第一阶段估计从密集多相道特征来进行对齐,之后的第二阶段则同时利用解剖-和分解-损失来完善变形. 最后,由于登记不应引入非生物肿瘤的体积随时间变化,我们制定了针对不同部分的损伤量保全计划。 没有任何任务特定训练,我们的系统在PSMAREG挑战排行榜上获得了第一名. 代码和交互式可视化可在http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg上查阅。

articles.title: Trust Before Autonomy: Rethinking Agentic Remote Sensing for Crisis Response
articles.content: Agentic remote sensing is evaluated on how many questions it can answer, whereas crisis response depends on whether its answers can be relied on and how much of the decision can safely be handed to the agent. This paper argues that \emph{autonomy should be earned, not assumed}: An Earth-Observation (EO) agent should be granted autonomy in proportion to demonstrated reliability, epistemic honesty and verifiability. The position is supported by an evidential meta-analysis of twelve agentic RS/EO/GIS benchmark studies from peer-reviewed venues. Only one repeats runs, three contain unanswerable tasks and none measures calibration. Their own tables show that completed workflows are often not correct (task success exceeds tool-call correctness by up to 54pp on identical queries), that the gap to an expert trajectory widens overall with trajectory length (from 7 to 56pp), and that capability does not predict abstention (Spearman r from -0.25 to 0.50, all n.s.). The paper then contributes three EO-specific trust properties, an autonomy ladder for crisis EO tasks, and a readiness protocol that replays archived emergency activations before any live use. In this context, current evidence justifies assistive roles only.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自主前的信托:重新思考用于应对危机的代理遥感
articles.content_zh: 对代理遥感的评价是,它能回答多少问题,而危机应对则取决于其答案是否可以依赖,以及能够安全地将多少决定交给代理商。 本文主张,\emph{自治应该挣取,而不是假设}: 地球观测代理人应当按照证明的可靠性、认知诚实性和可核查性的比例获得自主权。 对来自同行审评地点的12个媒介RS/EO/GIS基准研究进行的证据元分析支持了这一立场。 只有一次重复运行,三次包含无法回答的任务,没有测量校正. 他们自己的表格显示,已完成的工作流程往往不正确(任务成功率超过工具调用正确率,在相同的查询中最高可达54pp),与专家轨迹的差距随着轨迹长度而总体扩大(从7到56pp),而且这种能力不会预测弃权(Spearman r从-0.25到0.50,所有n.s.)。 文件随后贡献出三个EO特定信任属性,一个用于危机EO任务的自主阶梯,以及一个在任何活用前重放存档紧急激活的备战协议. 在这方面,现有证据仅证明辅助作用是合理的。

articles.title: GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation
articles.content: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GAD: 几何注意力分解,用于相容视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视频传播模型产生视觉吸引人的短期序列,但往往在一段时间内为保存场景几何和物体结构而挣扎. 在本文中,我们首先表明,目前的视频注意力无法辨别出跨帧的可靠对应信息,即使在出现可识别的场景结构后,反应也分散在多个区域. 我们主张,可靠的跨框架协会作为场景结构形式在视频生成中对于信息交流至关重要。 因此,我们引入了几何注意力分解(GAD),它将函文从被冻结的几何模型的注意力转移到了视频注意力上. 从干净的视频中取出,这些通信将相同的静地表面或移动对象连接到相框上. 由于结构形成开始于更深的地层,而更浅的地层开始于更低的地层,因此我们在根据噪音时序选择的学生地层进行注意力分馏. 培训后,视频注意力更一致地集中在相应的地点. 跨越所有三个视频主干线的实验显示,长距离场景一致性和动态时间一致性得到了提高,几何增益跨代长度. 在Wan2.2 5B上,GAD在两个远程基准上将跨帧匹配精度比Wan基线提高至少30%. 值得注意的是,GAD在没有额外推论模块的情况下取得了这些成果,为高效和一致的以视频为基础的世界模拟提供了一个很有希望的方法。 项目网页:https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.

articles.title: The Federated Tumor Segmentation and Classification (FeTS++) Challenge
articles.content: International challenges have become the standard for developing and benchmarking biomedical image analysis methods using centralized multi-institutional data. Federated learning (FL) describes a paradigm-shift on multi-institutional collaborations, where models are trained across institutions while their data are always retained locally. The Federated Tumor Segmentation (FeTS) challenge, first held in 2021, was the first challenge dedicated to FL in medical imaging and editions in 2022 and 2024 pushed the frontiers of real-world method validation. FeTS++ 2027 returns after a two-year gap with a substantially larger and more diverse cohort, and with the two "pluses" that name the challenge: an official classification task alongside segmentation, and a move of the infrastructure to NVIDIA FLARE (NVFlare). Built on the clinically acquired, multi-institutional multi-parametric MRI data of the BraTS 2025 Lighthouse challenge, FeTS++ spans gliomas and meningiomas across patient cohorts from institutions in North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa, and focuses on ranking submitted methodological approaches according to their model utility and an efficiency-aware score. Task 1 asks participants to find the best strategy for aggregating knowledge from per-institution segmentation models, while Task 2 asks them to distinguish glioma from meningioma under the same federated protocol, in which the entity label is heavily confounded with the site of origin.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联邦肿瘤分化和分类(FETS++) 挑战
articles.content_zh: 国际挑战已成为利用集中的多机构数据制定生物医学图像分析方法和基准的标准。 联邦学习(FL)描述了多机构合作的范式转变,即跨机构培训模式,而其数据总是在当地保留。 联邦肿瘤分解(Federal Tumor specification (Feets))挑战首次于2021年举行,是2022年和2024年医学成像和版本中首次针对FL的挑战,推动了现实世界方法验证的前沿. FETS++ 2027在两年间距相隔相当大且更多样化的组群后返回,与两个"附加"命名了挑战:一个官方分类任务与分化,以及将基础设施迁移到NVIDIA FLARE(NVFlare). FETS++基于BratTS 2025灯塔挑战的临床获得的多机构多参数核磁共振数据,在北美、欧洲、亚洲和非洲各机构的病人群体中跨出胶片和脑膜炎,并侧重于根据其模型效用和对效率的认识分数对所提交的方法进行排名。 任务1要求参与者找到从按机构划分模式汇总知识的最佳策略,而任务2则要求他们根据同样的联邦协议区分胶片瘤和脑膜炎,其中实体标签与原产地严重混淆.

articles.title: MIST: Multi-Scale Spatial Context for Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
articles.content: Predicting spatial gene expression from standard H&E images could extend molecular analysis to tissues without spatial transcriptomic measurements. A standard Transformer applies self-attention over spots but ignores where each spot sits in the tissue, whereas a spot's molecular state depends on tissue context at multiple spatial scales. Building on this insight, we introduce MIST, a Multi-context Spatial Transformer that augments the self-attention backbone with two context pathways applied in every layer: a coordinate-invariant local pathway that attends over spatial k-nearest-neighbor spots, and a slide pathway that broadcasts a whole-slide summary to every spot; the model predicts all spots in a single forward pass. Because coordinates enter only through pairwise distances, the local pathway is invariant to translations, rotations, and reflections when image features are fixed. In intra-cohort evaluation across six human organ cohorts from HEST-1k, MIST improves mean Pearson correlation over the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.7%, 11.6%, and 11.4% for 10-, 50-, and 100-gene panels, respectively, with the lowest average MSE and MAE. MIST further improves leave-one-organ-out transfer by 6.0% over the next strongest baseline, attains the best expression-derived domain recovery (highest mean ARI and NMI at every clustering resolution, and higher NMI than the closest baseline on 84% of held-out slides), and reproduces spatial expression patterns of selected cancer-marker genes. Together, these results show that adding local and slide context to a vanilla Transformer backbone is an effective approach to spatial gene expression prediction from histology.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MIST:历史学基因表达预测的多尺度空间背景
articles.content_zh: 从标准的H&E图像中预测空间基因表达可以将分子分析扩展到没有空间转录测量的组织. 一个标准变形器在斑点上应用自觉,但忽略了每个斑点在组织中的位置,而斑点的分子状态则取决于组织上下文的多空间尺度. 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们引入了MIST,一个多文本空间变换器,它用每层都应用的两条上下文路径来增强自我关注的主干线:一个坐标不变化的局部路径,它覆盖空间相近-相近-相近的地段,以及一个向每个地段广播整个滑坡摘要的滑行路径;模型在单个前行通道中预测出所有地段。 因为坐标只通过对等距离输入,所以当图像特性固定时,局部路径对翻译,自转和反射是变化无常的. 在对来自HEST-1k的6个人体器官组群进行体内评价时,MIST将Pearson与最强评价基线的关联性分别提高9.7%、11.6%和11.4%,其中10个、50个和100个基因板的平均MSE和MAE的比例最低。 MIST在下一个最强基线上进一步提高了6.0%的一器官外移,实现了最好的表达源域恢复(在每个集群分辨率上最高的平均值ARI和NMI,在84%的持有源出滑动上,NMI比最近的基线更高),并复制了选定癌症标记基因的空间表达模式。 这些结果共同表明,将局部和滑行上下文加入到香草变形器主干线上,是一种从神学中进行空间基因表达预测的有效方法.

articles.title: LayerCanvas: Infographic Generation in AI Learning Assistants via Hybrid Layer-Set Diffusion
articles.content: Online learning platforms are increasingly deploying AI assistants to provide personalized, on-demand tutoring. These can leverage infographics to communicate complex information and improve the learning experience. However, automating effective infographic generation remains a challenging task, requiring a combination of visual richness with precise typography, structured layouts, and continued editability. Existing representation methods satisfy these goals only in part: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) representations preserve geometry, hierarchy, and text but provide limited aesthetic flexibility, while raster diffusion models produce richer appearances by flattening content and layout into a single image. Conditioning a diffusion model on a rasterized SVG does not resolve this conflict because the raster preserves approximate placement but discards element ownership, occlusion relationships, and the structure needed to modify and recompose the result. We introduce LayerCanvas, a hybrid approach that retains SVG as the semantic, structural, and typographic program while using diffusion to aestheticize non-text content. Rather than generating one flattened raster, LayerCanvas partitions SVG elements into z-ordered sets of mutually non-overlapping elements and processes them through communicating parallel RGB generation streams. The resulting layers are independently editable and deterministically recomposed, while text is rendered from preserved vector metadata. Our approach combines rich visual synthesis with accurate typography and localized editing. LayerCanvas substantially improves text fidelity over state-of-the-art raster image generators while achieving the highest overall aesthetic quality. We further demonstrate non-destructive content editing, localization, asset reuse, and animation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Layer Canvas: AI 学习助理中通过混合层-集合扩散生成图像
articles.content_zh: 在线学习平台越来越多地部署AI助手,提供个性化,点名辅导. 这些可以利用图象传播复杂信息并改进学习经验。 然而,自动有效成像生成仍然是一个挑战性的任务,需要将视觉丰富与精确的打字,结构化布局,以及持续的可编辑性结合起来. 现有的表达方法仅能部分地满足这些目标:可缩放矢量图形(SVG)的表达方式保留了几何,分级,文字,但提供有限的审美灵活性,而光栅扩散模型则通过将内容和布局平整成一幅图像来产生更丰富的外观. 在被光栅化的SVG上设定扩散模型并不能解决这一冲突,因为光栅保持了大致的放置,但抛弃了元素所有权,隔离关系,以及修改和重新组合结果所需的结构. 我们引入了 Layer Canvas,一种混合方法,它保留了SVG作为语义,结构,和打字程序,同时利用传播来将非文本内容美化. Layer Canvas 将 SVG 元素分解成 z 排列的相互不重叠元素组,而不是生成一个平分光栅,而是通过平行的 RGB 生成流进行处理。 由此产生的地层是可独立编辑的,确定性地重新组成,而文本则取自保存的矢量元数据. 我们的方法把丰富的视觉合成与准确的打字和局部编辑结合起来。 与最先进的光栅图像生成器相比,Canvas层大大改进了文本的忠实性,同时实现了最高的整体美学质量。 我们进一步展示了无损内容编辑、本地化、资产再利用和动画。

articles.title: Context-aware Bayesian Fusion for Multimodal Object Detection
articles.content: Reliable detection of pedestrians and road users is essential for the safe operation of autonomous vehicles. However, this task becomes increasingly challenging under adverse environmental conditions, such as poor weather and low lighting, where the performance of state-of-the-art pre-trained object detectors and on-board sensors tends to degrade, which limits their effectiveness and reliability. Moreover, retraining models for each operating context imposes significant constraints due to high data requirements, computational resources, and time. Considering this, we propose a novel context-aware multimodal late fusion approach that integrates a lightweight gating network within our probabilistic calibration framework. The gating network extracts environmental context and dynamically modulates the detection outputs of pre-trained object detectors based on the inferred context, without retraining of the detectors. Our methodology is evaluated on a modified KITTI dataset, in which the camera images and lidar pointclouds are augmented for varying fog levels. Experimental results show that our approach yields an approximately 14% relative improvement over non-adaptive late fusion baselines, achieving a consistent average precision of 56% across different fog levels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有上下文意识的贝叶斯多式物体探测法
articles.content_zh: 对行人和道路使用者进行可靠的检测对自主车辆的安全运行至关重要。 然而,在恶劣的环境条件下,例如恶劣的天气和低照明条件下,这一任务变得日益具有挑战性,因为最先进的预先训练的物体探测器和机上传感器的性能往往会退化,从而限制了其有效性和可靠性. 此外,由于数据要求高、计算资源和时间多,每个业务环境的再培训模式都受到严重制约。 考虑到这一点,我们建议采取一种新的具有上下文意识的多式后期聚变方法,将轻量级克网纳入我们的概率校正框架。 地标网络提取出环境上下文,并动态地根据所推断的上下文来调制预训对象探测器的探测输出,而无需再培训探测器. 我们的方法在经过修改的KITTI数据集上得到评价,其中相机图像和立达点云因雾度不同而增加. 实验结果表明,我们的方法比非适应性晚聚变基线的相对改善大约14%,在不同雾度之间实现一致的平均精度为56%。

articles.title: Concealed Handgun Detection using WiFi Signals
articles.content: While conventional camera-based surveillance systems and metal detectors can provide a sufficient level of security when used appropriately, they have fundamental limitations that reduce their applicability. Camera-based systems are unable to detect occluded or concealed threats and metal detectors require each person to enter through a narrow opening one at a time, leading to congestion issues and limited use in large crowds. A WiFi-based security system has the potential to be a complementary modality that is able to handle occlusions or concealment and is not hindered by strict spatial configurations. In this paper, we propose use Channel State Information estimated from WiFi-signals to detect concealed handguns. To this end we collect a dataset of aligned WiFi signals and RGB images that we call the WiFire dataset. We also propose a deep learning model called WiFireNet tailored to detect concealed handguns in WiFi signals using vision-based supervision signals. Our results show that concealed handgun detection is possible in WiFi and has promise as a complementary modality to surveillance cameras and metal detectors. We release the dataset, model and code to facilitate the further research into WiFi-based handgun detection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用 WiFi 信号隐藏的手枪检测
articles.content_zh: 虽然常规相机式监视系统和金属探测器在适当使用时能够提供足够的安全,但它们具有根本的局限性,降低了其适用性。 基于相机的系统无法探测到被渗透或被隐藏的威胁,而金属探测器要求每个人一次通过一个狭长的开口进入,导致拥堵问题并被大量人群所限制使用. 以WiFi为基础的安全系统有可能成为一种补充模式,能够处理隔离或隐藏,不受严格的空间配置的阻碍。 在本文中,我们提议使用WiFi信号中估计的海峡州情资料来检测隐藏的手枪. 为此,我们收集一个数据集,由一致的WiFi信号和RGB图像组成,我们称之为WiFire数据集. 我们还提出一个名为WiFireNet的深层学习模型,专门用来利用基于视觉的监督信号来检测WiFi信号中隐藏的手枪. 我们的结果表明,隐蔽的手枪探测器在WiFi中是可能的,并有可能作为监视相机和金属探测器的一种补充方式。 我们发布数据集,模型和代码,以利对基于WiFi的手枪探测的进一步研究.

articles.title: Segment Where You Look: Attention as the Interface Between Language Models and Segmenters
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) that segment from language must pass the location of the referent to a pixel decoder. The dominant interface compresses it into the hidden state of a single [SEG] token, a d-dimensional vector with no spatial index, and leaves the decoder, which never sees the expression, to recover the referent's extent. We show that the VLM already computes a better signal: the [SEG] token's attention over the image tokens, which is defined on the patch grid by construction. Probing a frozen segmentation VLM, we find that this attention yields 18 to 22 more gIoU than the [SEG] hidden state when read by the same probe, that it gains nothing from the image where the hidden state does, and that it is concentrated in the late layers. Building on these findings, we introduce AttnSeg, which replaces the [SEG] embedding with this attention as the decoder's prompt. A learned, signed combination of the attention heads forms a dense spatial prompt, and an attention-guidance objective supervises it directly. A two-stage recipe first trains the VLM to localize without the decoder, then trains the decoder to refine, within the budget of standard fine-tuning. Applied to Sa2VA, AttnSeg improves ReasonSeg by 6.4 gIoU and GS-Eval by 10.2 at 4B (4.2 and 9.6 over the same model fine-tuned on the same data), and by 8.8 and 11.3 at 14B. The gains reach 13 to 18 gIoU on object parts, multiple objects, and single objects, where the referent must be singled out, and are negligible on stuff regions, which the decoder already recovers unaided. Code and models are available at https://eslambakr.github.io/attseg_project_page/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 您所看到的片段: 注意语言模型和片段之间的接口
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs),从语言中分出的部分必须把引用者的位置传递给像素解码器. 主导界面将它压缩成一个单 [SEG] 令牌的隐藏状态,一个没有空间指数的d维向量,并留下从未看到表达的解码器来恢复引用者的范围. 我们显示,VLM已经计算出一个更好的信号: [SEG] 符号对图像符号的注意,它通过构造在补丁网格上定义. 探测出一个被冻结的分解 VLM, 我们发现,当同一探测器读取[SEG]隐藏状态时, 这种注意产生18到22个GIOU, 它从隐藏状态的图像中没有任何收益, 它集中在后层。 基于这些发现,我们引入了"AttnSeg",它用这种注意取代了嵌入的"SEG"作为解码器的快取. 一个有知识的,签名的注意力头组合形成了密集的空间快感,一个注意力指导目标直接监督它. 两相配方先是训练VLM去本地化而不用解码器,再训练解码器去精炼,在标准微调的预算范围内. AttnSeg应用到Sa2VA改进了ReasonSeg 6.4 gIoU和GS-Eval在4B上改进了10.2分(同一模型的4.2分和9.6分在同一数据上调整了),在14B上改进了8.8分和11.3分. 在对象部件,多对象,和单对象上,增益达到13到18个gIoU,其中引用者必须被单独挑出,在物品区域上可以忽略不计,解码器已经无助地恢复了. 守则和模型见https://eslambakr.github.io/attseg_project_page/。

articles.title: AIRRI: Towards a Human-Readable, Machine-Resistant Reading Interface
articles.content: The rapid advancement of image-to-text extraction systems and large language models (LLMs) poses new challenges for educational assessment by making assignment materials easy to transcribe and solve with minimal human effort. To address this problem, we present AIRRI (Artificial Intelligence Resilient Reading Interface), a framework for generating machine-resistant educational content, a dataset of higher-education assignments for evaluation, and an initial evaluation of the human readability of AIRRI machine-resistant text designs. AIRRI employs two categories of machine-resistance techniques. First, AIRRI applies image transformations including character spacing, word spacing, line spacing, character opacity variation, stripe overlays, and image noise. Second, AIRRI applies decision-based adversarial attacks: RayS, SurFree, and ADBA. We evaluate AIRRI against three image-to-text systems: Tesseract, EasyOCR, and the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our results show that AIRRI substantially degrades automated text extraction performance. AIRRI increased character error rates for EasyOCR (6.9% to 55.9%), Tesseract (2.3% to 100.0%), and GOT-OCR2 (30.7% to 48.1%). Word error rates increased for EasyOCR (24.9% to 96.7%) and Tesseract (10.7% to 100.0%). Among the evaluated decision-based attacks, ADBA consistently produced the largest degradation in image-to-text performance, while RayS and SurFree produced more moderate reductions. EasyOCR and Tesseract were generally more susceptible to both image-based and adversarial perturbations than the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our findings suggest that AIRRI can significantly reduce the reliability of image-to-text-to-LLM workflows, increasing the effort required for AI-assisted assignment completion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AIRI: 迈向一个人能读取的、机器能续读的界面
articles.content_zh: 图像到文本提取系统和大型语言模型的迅速发展,使派任材料易于被转录并用最低限度的人力解决,给教育评估带来了新的挑战。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了人工智能耐读接口(AIRRI),这是一个生成耐机教育内容的框架,一个用于评价的高等教育任务数据集,以及AIRRI耐机文本设计对人类可读性的初步评价。 AIRRI采用两种类型的机器抵抗技术。 首先,AIRRI应用了图像转换,包括字符间距,字行间距,行间距,字符不透明变异,条纹覆盖,和图像噪音. 第二,非洲空研所采用基于决定的对抗性攻击:RayS、SurFree和亚行。 我们对照三个图像对文本系统来评价AIRI:魔方,EasyOCR,以及基于变压器的GOT-OCR2模型. 我们的结果显示,AIRRI极大地降低了自动文本提取性能. AIRRI提高了EasyOCR(6.9%至55.9%)、魔方(2.3%至100.0%)和GOT-OCR2(30.7%至48.1%)的字符错误率。 EasyOCR(24.9%至96.7%)和宇宙魔方(10.7%至100.0%)的文字出错率上升. 在经过评价的以决策为基础的攻击中,亚银在图像到文字的性能方面一直产生最大的退化,而RayS和SurFree则产生更适度的减少. EasyOCR和宇宙魔方一般比以变压器GOT-OCR2为主的型号更容易受图像和对抗性的扰动. 我们的调查结果表明,AIRI能够大大降低图像到文本到LLM工作流程的可靠性,从而加大AI协助完成任务所需的努力.

articles.title: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
articles.content:
World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm.
  We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen.
  We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UniW(A)M:世界和世界行动模式的统一专家混合框架
articles.content_zh:
世界模型和世界行动模型分别侧重于未来的世界预测和可执行的行动生成. 虽然这些模型从所包含轨迹中学习了共同的物理动力学和相互作用语义学,但它们通常被隔离训练,这限制了预测和控制之间的知识再利用. 因此,主要的挑战是建立一个统一的学习框架,分享这些动态,同时保持每个范式所要求的独特的建模能力。
我们提出UniW(A)M,一种以扩散变形器为基础的专家世界(行动)混合模型,它统一了行动条件的世界模型和各种WAM变体。 共享的专家捕捉到共同的动态,而原子能力专家则被跨接口再利用,以便每个接口保持自己的有条件路径. 在部署时,一个插入适应性接口路由器(PAIR)从一个小子集的目标任务块设想中学习,为每个执行块选择合适的WAM接口,平衡任务成功和执行效率,同时使主干被冻结.
在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和三项现实世界操纵任务上,我们评价UniW(A)M,它取得了88.3%的实际世界平均成功率,而最强基线为76.7%。 在WorldArena上,它领导着以行动为条件的世界在所有三项任务上的模式化. AC-WM共同培训有助于在每个行动界面上产生行动,而PAIR将OD成功率从63.3%提高到76.7%。

articles.title: CryoTracer: A Synthetic-to-Real System for Filament Instance Tracing in Cryo-EM
articles.content: Particle picking in cryo-electron microscopy is commonly formulated as an object-detection problem in which individual particles are represented by bounding boxes, a natural representation for globular particles but a poor match for filaments that can extend across an entire micrograph. Existing methods reconstruct filament trajectories by linking local predictions in a separate post-processing stage, decoupling detection from instance formation and creating potential ambiguities at gaps and crossings. Directly preserving filament identity is particularly useful for polymorphic specimens, where segments originating from the same filament should remain associated. However, learning such instance-level representations is challenging because expert centerline annotations are scarce and costly to obtain. We introduce CryoTracer, a synthetic-to-real framework that addresses this limitation through procedural micrograph generation, transformer-based polyline prediction, and specimen-specific fine-tuning. Procedural pretraining exposes the model to diverse filament geometries, intersections, and imaging conditions before adaptation using a limited number of fully annotated experimental micrographs. CryoTracer represents filaments as ordered centerline polylines and optimizes their geometry using an orientation-invariant discrete Fréchet objective, enabling consistent learning regardless of tracing direction. Evaluation on established and newly expert-annotated datasets shows that CryoTracer improves instance-level filament recovery over existing particle-detection approaches. These results establish end-to-end polyline prediction as a practical alternative to detection-and-linking pipelines for recovering complete filament instances with limited micrograph annotation budgets. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cryotracer/cryotracer
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CryoTracher: Cryo-EM 中隐形物追踪合成系统
articles.content_zh: 在低温电子显微镜中取出颗粒通常被表述为物体探测问题,其中单个颗粒以边框为代表,是光子颗粒的自然代表,但线粒体的匹配性差,可以扩展到整个显微图. 现有方法通过将局部预测在单独的后处理阶段连接起来,使检测与实例形成脱钩,并在缺口和过境点造成潜在的模糊之处来重建丝状轨迹。 直接保留丝状特征对多态标本特别有用,因为同一丝状的片段应该保持关联. 然而,了解这种实例层面的表述具有挑战性,因为专家中枢说明很少,而且成本很高。 我们引入了 CryoTracher, 一个合成到现实的框架,通过程序微图生成,基于变压器的多线预测,以及标本特定的微调来解决这一局限性. 程序预训使模型在适应前暴露出多种丝状地美图,相交和成像条件,使用数量有限的全注实验微图. CryoTracher作为定点中线多线代表了有丝线并使用定向-偏差离散的Fréchet目标来优化其几何,无论追踪方向如何,都能实现一致的学习. 对已建立和新近得到专家说明的数据集的评价表明,CryoTracher比现有的粒子探测方法改善了实例级丝状恢复。 这些结果确立了从端到端多线预测,作为检测和连接管道的实用替代办法,以恢复完整的丝状情况,微图注释预算有限。 代码和数据见https://github.com/cryotracer/cryotracer。

articles.title: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoReader:在远景-语言模型中学习空间理性的后期几何
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)与RGB观察中仍然隐含的度量和多视图关系相抗衡. 几何地基模型从RGB中恢复了这种结构,但现有方法要么将估计的地物与可视地物相接并学会单独从问答中加以使用,要么将VLM潜入物与几何地物相接. 然而,捕捉几何并不能确保它的使用: 将释放的地物-对齐模型的对齐潜想零出,使其精度保持不变. 我们介绍GeoReader,这个框架为读取它们的VLM学习几何表达. 首先,我们训练轻量级几何读取器来制作连续的输入符号,用被被冷冻的VLM解码的几何描述来监督它们,使读者以目标模型已经能读取的形式来表达几何. 然后我们冻结了读者来保存这个接口,同时在空间QA上微调了VLM,这个问题上有几何注射条件. 几何描述只作为训练目标:推论VLM直接从连续几何符号中解答,而不产生几何思维链. 根据RGB图像的几何预测,我们的方法在MindCube-Tiny上与Quen3-VL-4B并用,在多源QA混合物下,平均达到72.5分6个额外的空间基准并用Quen3.5-9B. 这些结果表明,有用的几何表示是接收模型可以使用的一种,而不仅仅是可以重建几何的表示.

articles.title: Orientation Estimation of Cryo-EM Images for Molecules with Arbitrary Symmetry by Semidefinite Programming
articles.content:
This paper extends the non-unique games framework introduced in Bandeira et al. (2020) to address symmetric structures. Precisely, we consider the problem \[ \begin{aligned}
  \underset{g_1,\ldots,g_n\in \mathcal{G}}{\operatorname{min}}\,\, \frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{i,j=1}^n \sum_{s\in S} f_{ij}(g_i s g_j^{-1}), \end{aligned} \] where $\mathcal{G}$ is a compact group, $S\subset \mathcal{G}$ is a finite subgroup of symmetry elements, and $f_{ij}:\mathcal{G}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is a loss function. A notable example is common lines based orientation estimation of cryo-EM images for molecules with point group symmetry $S$, where $\mathcal{G}$ is the rotation group $\operatorname{SO}(3)$. With a semidefinite programming relaxation, we turn the problem into a convex program that is solved with the alternating direction method of multipliers. Unlike existing approaches which are tailored to specific symmetry groups, ours provides a unified computational framework for addressing all point group symmetries. We demonstrate the applicability of the proposed algorithm on the cryo-EM orientation estimation problem on both simulated and experimental datasets. In particular, our algorithm is effective in generating high-quality ab initio models from only a few class averages computed from experimental images.

articles.title_zh: Cryo-EM的定向估计 用半定式编程任意对称分子的图像
articles.content_zh:
本文将Bandeira等(2020年)引入的非独特游戏框架扩展至解决对称结构. 准确的说, 我们考虑这个问题 \ [\\ begin{access]
\ underset{ g_ 1,\ ldots, g_ n\ in\ mathcal{ G\\ operatorname{ min}\\,\\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s}\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ 1} ,\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\ s\\ s\ s\ s\ s\ \ mathbb{R} $ 是损失函数 。 一个值得注意的例子是,对有点组对称的分子的低温-EM图像进行常见行向估计,其中$\mathcal{G}$是旋转组$\operatorname{SO}(3)$. 通过半定时编程放松,我们把问题变成一个用乘数的交替方向方法解决的对流程序. 与针对具体对称组的现有方法不同,我们的方法为处理所有点组对称问题提供了一个统一的计算框架。 我们证明了拟议算法对模拟和实验数据集中低温-EM定向估计问题的适用性。 特别是,我们的算法能够有效生成高质量的初始模型, 仅从实验图像中计算出几类平均值。

articles.title: Just Respect the Semantics: Image-Token Compression via Pre-LLM Semantic Variable-Resolution Tokenization and In-LLM Relevance Pruning
articles.content: Image-token compression must reduce computation without hurting the semantics. We introduce Varest, guided by semantic fungibility: tokens within a coherent semantic region can be summarized coarsely, while object boundaries and literal text require finer distinctions. Object and text localizers guide variable-resolution merging, preserving spatial coverage and finer detail at boundaries and text. Learned [REL] registers then prune visual tokens after early decoder processing. Training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone. Across three backbones and 13 benchmarks, Varest outperforms 15 baselines in mean performance retention at every evaluated budget, retaining 86.10-92.33% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the original layer-averaged image-token count.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 尊重语义:通过预 LLM 语义变量解析度 Tokenization 和 In-LLM 关联性运行
articles.content_zh: 图像脚本压缩必须减少计算而不会伤害语义. 我们介绍Varest, 以语义可互换性为指导: 在一个连贯的语义区域内的符号可以粗略地概括, 而对象边界和文字则需要细微的区分. 对象和文本本地化器指导可变分辨率合并,保留了边界和文本的空间覆盖和更细化的细节. 学 [REL] 注册后在早期解码器处理后再进行prune视觉符号. 跨预算的培训使每个主干部门有一个检查站。 在三个支柱和13个基准中,Varest在每一个评估预算的平均绩效保留方面超过了15个基准,保留了86.10%-92.33%的完整绩效,只有5.56%的原层平均图像记录。

articles.title: RSIgen: Reciprocal Self-Improvement for Agentic Visual Generation
articles.content: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RSIgen:代理视觉生成的对等自我改进
articles.content_zh: 代理视觉生成产生的经验可以提高统一多模式主干线的本土理解(代理)和生成角色,但单是任务成功并不能决定哪个角色应该学习. 生成器更新也可以使代理的动作监督僵化. 我们引入了RSIgen,这是一个以任务为中心的相互自我改进框架,将学习分配、监督更新以及课程的循环构建联系起来。 动态责任运行(DRR)在证据、投入方面采用相应的干预措施,并支持选择学习对象和构建相容的培训目标的行动。 在发电机学习后,RSIgen重新评价了经过测试的动作的相对效用,其分支投入被固定下来以更新代理监督;保留的角色然后构建下个课程. 横跨巴格勒,文-伊玛目和万-伊玛目-7B,RSIgen改进了代理 Gen-Bench Full Survery9 以3.2-3.3分的比分通过三周期的SearchGen适应,并具有动作成本. 湾控制在相应的角色级培训风险下支持分配收益,在相应的适应预算下刷新收益,在接受者继续学习的同时从更新的课程来源中获益。 在对200个实际用户请求进行盲目评价时,与同一基线相比,组合式捆绑调整优惠分数达到任务完成率为70.0%,视觉质量为64.9%。

articles.title: RadarGSOcc: Doppler-Aware 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction Using 4D Radar Tensor with Geometric-Semantic Feature Extraction
articles.content: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is crucial for autonomous driving, but camera-based methods degrade in low-light conditions and LiDAR-based methods are sensitive to adverse weather. 4D radar is more robust, yet its sparsity and the high cost of radar tensor processing limit its use. We propose Radar Geometric-Semantic Occupancy Prediction (RadarGSOcc), an efficient framework that directly processes 4D radar tensors by separately extracting geometric and semantic features, including Doppler information, with a deformable attention-based geometric refinement module as its key component. We also introduce the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors, built on the K-Radar dataset with refined LiDAR-based annotations. RadarGSOcc predicts 15 classes within a 51.2m range and achieves 38.2% IoU, 7.6% mIoU, and 25.5% weighted mIoU, outperforming RadarOcc by 17% relative (25.5 vs. 21.9) in weighted mIoU while using fewer parameters and lower computation. It substantially improves truck prediction while trading off car accuracy, outperforms camera-based approaches, and narrows the gap with LiDAR-based methods. To assess robustness without per-frame ground truth in adverse weather, we further propose a novel proxy metric, Environment-Based KL Divergence (EBKL), under which 4D radar proves a reliable and efficient modality for 3D semantic occupancy prediction. The dataset and code will be publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 雷达卫星: Doppler-Aware 3D 语义占用预测
articles.content_zh: 3D语义占用预测对于自主驾驶至关重要,但相机方法在低光条件下降解,而LiDAR方法对不利天气敏感. 4D雷达的强度更强,然而它的相撞性以及高成本的雷达拉伸处理限制了它的使用. 我们提出雷达几何-语义占用预测(RadarGSOCC),这是一个有效的框架,通过单独提取几何和语义特征,包括多普勒信息,直接处理4D雷达的收分数,其关键组成部分是可变形的基于注意力的几何精密模块。 我们还引入了K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准,这是第一个使用4D雷达测距器进行3D语义占用预测的大规模基准,该基准建立在K-Radar数据集上,并配有精细的以LiDAR为基础的说明. RadarGSOC在51.2米范围内预测了15个类别,实现了38.2%的IoU,7.6%的mIoU,以及25.5%的加权mIoU,在加权mIoU中表现优于17%的相对(25.5对21.9),同时使用了较少的参数和较低的计算. 它大大改进了卡车预测,同时交换了汽车的准确性,超过了以相机为基础的方法,并缩小了与以LiDAR为基础的方法的差距。 为了评估在恶劣天气中没有按框架地面真实性的稳健性,我们进一步提议采用新的代用计量标准,即基于环境的KL Divergence(EBKL),根据该计量标准,4D雷达证明是3D语义占用预测的可靠而有效的模式。 数据集和代码将公开提供。

articles.title: Perception Beyond the Visible: Incompleteness-Aware Scene Understanding for Robot Autonomy
articles.content: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉超越可见:不完整-机器人自主的智能场景理解
articles.content_zh: 可靠的机器人自主性要求从局部和吵闹的观察中推理世界. 然而,许多感知系统模型仅可被可见的场景区域,依赖于固定的语义分类,并承担可靠的传感器测量. 这些假设在被隔离,小物体相遇,以及感官退化等下被打破. 在本文中,我提出了对不完全认识-场景理解的研究愿景. 我将这个愿景围绕三个基本挑战来组织:不完整的证据,不完整的知识,和不完整的传感器可靠性. 我通过模式感知,语义占用预测,开放世界的场景理解,标签高效的学习,以及不确定性导向的多模式融合,来讨论我对应对这些挑战的研究贡献. 基于这些贡献,我概述了未来以信仰为中心的4D场景展示的研究方向。 这些表述旨在联合地模拟几何,语义,运动,和不确定性. 我还讨论了主动感知和安全的适应策略,这些策略允许机器人通过相互作用来减少不确定性. 目标是发展可调节和可操作的场景表现,支持在动态和开放的世界环境中的可靠自主.

articles.title: PlanPath: Exploration-Guided Orchestration for Patient-Level Pathology Reasoning
articles.content: A patient's pathology case spans tens of slides from distinct specimens and anatomical sites, each carrying non-redundant, site-specific evidence. Forming a patient-level conclusion therefore requires locating the slides relevant to a given question and integrating complementary findings across them.
