However, existing pathology agents analyze one slide at a time and describe morphology rather than measure it, leaving evidence acquisition across a patient's specimens and patient-level quantification underexplored. To address this gap, we propose PlanPath, an agentic framework for patient-level pathology visual question answering (VQA). PlanPath turns the question into an exploration plan that specifies the evidence required, routes to the slides likely to carry it, and drives coarse-to-fine acquisition from tissue architecture down to individual cells. Tissue- and cell-level tools supply the counts, proportions, and extents, which PlanPath aggregates across slides into a traceable answer. To enable evaluation, we build two patient-level VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer, averaging 15 WSIs per patient, with pathologist-verified question-answer pairs derived from diagnostic reports. Experimental results show that PlanPath outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.4% and 12.1% in overall accuracy on the two datasets and further improves existing slide-level agents when plugged into our framework. The dataset and code are available at: https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PlanPath_1.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PlanPath: 患者一级病理学探索指导管弦乐团
articles.content_zh: 患者的病理病例会从不同的标本和解剖地点取出数十个滑道,每个滑道都携带非多余的,具体地点的证据. 因此,要得出患者一级的结论,就必须确定与特定问题有关的幻灯片的位置,并综合它们之间的补充结论。 然而,现有的病理剂一次分析一幅幻灯片,描述形态而非测量,使得患者标本上的证据获取和患者水平的量化不足被挖掘. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出PlanPath,作为病人一级病理视觉问题回答的代理框架。 PlanPath将问题变成一个勘探计划,其中具体说明所需证据、通往可能携带这些证据的幻灯片的路线、以及推动从组织架构到单个细胞的粗到细的获取。 组织和单元格级工具提供计数、比例和范围,PlanPath将各幻灯片汇总成可追踪的答案。 为了能够进行评价,我们为肾癌和胃癌建立了两个患者一级的VQA数据集,平均每名患者15个WSI,其中病理学家验证的对答来自诊断报告. 实验结果表明,PlanPath在两个数据集上的总体准确度超过了最强基线9.4%和12.1%,并在插入我们的框架时进一步改善了现有的幻灯片级剂。 数据集和代码见:https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PlanPath_1。

articles.title: Texture Interpolation as Texton Matching
articles.content: Texture interpolation asks what should lie between two textures. Standard methods typically blend pixels or features at corresponding spatial locations, implicitly assuming that co-located elements should be mixed. For unrelated textures, however, this correspondence is arbitrary: a crack at one location has no particular relationship to a fiber at the same location in another image. We study whether this hidden pairing choice is itself a major determinant of interpolation quality. We represent textures as collections of local appearance vectors, or textons, and replace positional pairing with appearance-aware matching while keeping the encoder, representation, and decoder fixed. This isolates the effect of correspondence from changes in model capacity or training. Across texture pairs, appearance-aware matching consistently improves the distributional quality of interpolated midpoints over positional feature blending. Soft matching produces the strongest midpoint statistics, whereas one-to-one assignments yield more balanced transitions and closer agreement with the target endpoint. The same intervention also improves a second pretrained texture interpolator without retraining. These results identify correspondence as a first-class design choice in texture interpolation: meaningful transitions depend not only on how strongly two textures are mixed, but also on which local appearances are mixed with one another.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 纹理内插为纹理匹配
articles.content_zh: 纹理内插会问出两个纹理之间应该有什么. 标准方法通常在相应的空间位置将像素或特征相混合,含蓄地假设同地相位元素应当相混合. 然而,对于无关的纹理,这种通信是任意的:一个地点的裂缝与另一个图像中同一个地点的纤维没有特殊关系. 我们研究这个隐藏的配对选择本身是否是内插质量的主要决定因素. 我们代表纹理作为局部外观向量或纹理的集合,并用外观意识相配取代位置对等,同时保持编码器,表示器和解码器的固定. 这隔离了通信的作用与模型能力或训练的变化. 在整个纹理配对中,外观知觉相匹配比位置特征相混合不断提高插值中点的分布质量. 软匹配产生最强的中点统计,而一对一的任务则产生更平衡的过渡,并更接近目标终点。 同样的干预措施也改进了第二个未经再培训的前训练出质插管。 这些结果将对应物确定为纹理内插中的一等设计选择:有意义的过渡不仅取决于两种纹理的多强相混合,而且还取决于当地外观的相混合性.

articles.title: ST-GRU PredRNN-V2: A GRU-Based Reformulation of PredRNN-V2 for Video Prediction
articles.content: Video prediction requires models to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies and to retain relevant information over long sequences. PredRNN and its successor PredRNN-V2 address this challenge with spatiotemporal Long Short-Term Memory (ST-LSTM) units that maintain two separate memory states, at the cost of a relatively complex recurrent building block. In this work, we investigate whether the simpler gating of Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can be transferred to spatiotemporal predictive learning. To this end, we develop a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit as a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM. The ST-GRU replaces the ST-LSTM's three gates per memory state with two GRU-style gates (update and reset), and merges the temporal memory state into the hidden state, which reduces the number of parameters by about 5%. We incorporate the ST-GRU into PredRNN-V2 and evaluate the resulting model on the Moving MNIST video prediction benchmark, following the original experimental protocol. Averaged over ten predicted frames, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 achieves an MSE of 55.1, an SSIM of 0.883, an LPIPS of 0.065 and a PSNR of 19.53dB. It does not surpass the original ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 on MSE, SSIM or PSNR, but it achieves a lower LPIPS and performs on par with the earlier ST-LSTM-based PredRNN, while using a simpler recurrent cell. These results suggest that ST-GRUs are a promising building block for spatiotemporal predictive learning and motivate further work on their design and integration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ST - 格鲁 PredRN-V2:基于GRU的PredRN-V2对视频预测的重塑
articles.content_zh: 视频预测需要模型来捕捉复杂的spatiotional依赖性,并保留相干信息超过长序列. PredRN及其后继者PredRN-V2以瞬间长期内存(ST-LSTM)单位来应对这一挑战,这些单位维持两个独立的内存状态,成本是相对复杂的经常性构件. 在这项工作中,我们调查是否可将更简单的Gated经常单元(GRUs)调用到spatiotal预测学习中去. 为此,我们开发出一个spatiotemporal GRU(ST-GRU)单元,作为ST-LSTM的以GRU为基础的替代品. ST-GRU将ST-LSTM每个内存状态的三个出入口替换为两个GRU风格的出入口(更新和重置),将时间内存状态合并为隐藏状态,将参数数量减少约5%. 我们把ST-GRU纳入PredRN-V2,并按照最初的实验协议,在Moving MNIST视频预测基准上评价由此产生的模型. 平均超过10个预测框架,ST-GRU基于PredRNN-V2的MSE达到55.1,SSIM为0.883,LPIPS为0.065,PSNR为19.53dB. 它在MSE,SSIM或PSNR上并没有超过原先的ST-LSTM基于PredRNN-V2,但是它实现了更低的LPIPS,并且与更早的ST-LSTM基于PredRNN的等效,同时使用更简单的经常性单元格. 这些结果表明,ST-GRU是快速预测学习的一个有希望的基石,并激励进一步开展设计和整合工作。

articles.title: Grid or Nodes? Probing Object Memory in World Models Under Partial Observability
articles.content: A robot's world model must remember objects that leave the camera's view. FloWM, a learned world model, keeps them in a spatial grid of features that it moves with five built-in velocities. A node memory instead keeps each object's position and velocity as numbers. We compare them in FloWM's own block world, with an oracle-fed Kalman tracker as the node memory. How the grid is read changes its score: a single-cell probe finds 66% of out-of-view blocks, while FloWM's own probe 89%. FloWM also scores 8 points higher in view although no frame is shown, which we attribute to its write-back of its own predictions. Out of view, the tracker reaches FloWM's range in 14KB against 5.6MB, with no probe. On diagonal motion, outside its five velocities, FloWM finds 11% of blocks even after fine-tuning, while the unchanged tracker keeps 93%. Faster blocks defeat both until one more allowed speed takes the tracker to 94%, where FloWM's built-in shifts would need 25 copies of its grid. A learned node memory must still replace the oracles and handle velocity under noise, long gaps, and the bounce.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 网格还是节点? 在部分可观察的世界模型中测试对象内存
articles.content_zh: 机器人的世界模型必须记住离开相机视野的物体. FloWM,一个有学问的世界模型,将它们保存在一个具有五个内置速度的特征的空间网格上. 取而代之的是节点内存将每个对象的位置和速度保持为数字. 我们在FloWM自己的块状世界中比较它们,一个以神谕为原料的卡尔曼追踪器作为节点记忆. 被读取的格子如何会改变它的分数:单细胞探测器发现66%的出视区块,而FloWM自己的探测器则发现89%. FloWM虽然没有显示帧,但是在视图中也得分更高8分,我们将此归结于它对自身预测的回写. 出道后,追踪器以14KB对5.6MB达到FloWM的射程,没有探测器. 在对角运动上,FloWM在其5个速度之外,即使在微调后也会发现11%的区块,而不变的跟踪器则保留了93%. 更快的块将两者都击败,直到再有一个允许的速度将追踪器带到94%,其中FloWM的内置转会需要25个副本的网格. 一个有学问的节点记忆仍然必须取代甲骨文,在噪音下处理速度,长相间隙,和回弹.

articles.title: MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain, A Multi-Sensor, Multi-Temporal Pretraining Dataset for Earth Observation
articles.content: Pretraining generalist Earth observation foundation models requires data that combine several sensors, varied temporal sampling and, increasingly, text, yet open datasets rarely provide all three in one consistent, easily accessible form. We introduce MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain, a collection of 279,166 tiles of 10 km drawn from the Major-TOM grid by clustering AlphaEarth embeddings. Each tile stacks Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat-8/9, Sentinel-1 RTC, Copernicus DEM and ESA WorldCover on a shared 1056x1056-pixel, 10 m grid, complemented by cloud masks, OpenStreetMap entities and ERA5 weather. The tiles are partitioned into three temporal regimes, Monotemporal (250,000 tiles, one acquisition), Monthly (12,500 tiles, twelve acquisitions spread over the annual cycle) and Burst (16,666 tiles, six acquisitions within 30 days), and are released as 6.3 TB of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs indexed by TACO v3 Parquet metadata, a standard that allows cloud streaming, efficient data access, and filtering before any pixel is read. A companion library derives sensor-tagged fact sheets, captions and 16 families of vision-language tasks from these layers at load time. We test our design choices in short pretraining runs of OlmoEarth-Base. First, a 25% subset of Major-TOM Core-S2L2A curated with AlphaEarth embeddings matches or exceeds the full corpus on 8 of 9 benchmarks. Second, on Elliot-Pretrain, adding Landsat-8/9 improves or matches Sentinel-2 only pretraining on every benchmark. Third, using DEM and WorldCover as prediction targets during pretraining further improves 8 of 9 benchmarks, while giving the same maps to the encoder as inputs degrades 5 of 9. Fourth, Sentinel-1 helps on 7 of 9 benchmarks, particularly on benchmarks with radar inputs. Fifth, rule-based captions match a small language model at no cost. The dataset is openly available at https://source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain,用于地球观测的多传感器多时预训数据集
articles.content_zh: 预训通论者 地球观测基础模型要求数据结合若干传感器、各种时间取样和越来越多的文字,但开放数据集很少以一致、易于取用的形式提供所有三种数据。 我们介绍MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain,通过将α地嵌入物集群,从Major-TOM网格上取出279,166块10公里的瓦片. 每个瓦片堆放哨兵-2 L1C、Landsat-8/9、哨兵-1 RTC、哥白尼德国和欧空局世界 覆盖在共享的1056x1056-像素上,10米网格上,并辅以云罩,OpenStreetMap实体和ERA5天气. 瓷砖被分出为三个时态系统:Monotemporal (25万瓦,一项收购),月度(12 500瓦,12项收购分散在全年周期)和Burst (16 666瓦,6项收购在30天内),并以Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs的6.3 TB发布,由TACO v3 Parquet元数据索引,这个标准允许云流,高效的数据访问,并在读取任何像素前过滤. 配套图书馆从这些层中获取带有感官标记的概况介绍、标题和16个视觉语言任务家族。 我们测试我们的设计选择 短预训运行 OlmoEarth-Base。 首先,一个25%的分集Major-TOM Core-S2L2A由AlphaEarth嵌入来配对或超过9个基准中的8个基准的全体. 第二,在Elliot-Pretrain上,添加了Landsat-8/9改进或匹配Sentinel-2,只针对每个基准进行预训. 第三,在预训期间将DEM和WorldCover作为预测目标,进一步改善了9个基准中的8个基准,同时在输入降低9个基准中的5个时向编码器提供同样的地图。 第四,哨兵1帮助制定9个基准中的7个基准,特别是雷达投入的基准。 第五,基于规则的字幕与一个小型语言模型相匹配,不需花费费用. 该数据集可在https://source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain上公开查阅。

articles.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
articles.content: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VideoJev:视频理解与互动的系统一模型
articles.content_zh: 视觉代理商必须将视频观察转化为及时的决定来跟踪进展,选择下一步要做什么. 在新兴的"系统一"范式的基础上,我们引入了VideoJev,这是一个将视频理解和互动作为结构化决策任务的模型家族. 我们调整了预先训练的多式大型语言模型(MLLMs),将自旋式解码取而代之的是共享头,该头根据视频证据对时间间隔和文字选项进行分数. 这些分数产生事件跨越或回答选择,统一了时间定位和多选择视频问题回答. 这结合了MLLMs的语义灵活性和代理商可以直接使用的有效决定. 随着互动的展开,新的目标和中间结果引发了对同一视觉历史的进一步询问. 视频 因此,Jev通过Cached推论对到达时的询问进行再利用视觉计算,对单个前行通道中的多个询问进行联合推论. 在三个时间基准上,VideoJev-4B和VideoJev-35B-A3B在骨干上分别提高了6.7分和10.8分,测量到的推论速度为2.8-3.1分。 在四个视频QA基准上,都实现了与自己在"想"模式中的主干相比的性能,所测量的推论速度超过100美元. 这些结果提供了一个统一、可重复使用的决定界面,将结构化的视觉判断编成复杂、开放式的工作流程。

articles.title: DPOison-VL: Clean Preference Poisoning in Vision-Language Direct Preference Optimization
articles.content: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality under a fixed poison budget, and derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks, different VLM architectures and scales, and baseline comparisons demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves up to 98\% ASR with only 2\% poisoned data and exhibits cross-model transferability, while largely preserving clean accuracy and general utility. Our findings reveal a critical vulnerability in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations in preference training data can silently redirect alignment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DPOison-VL: 视野中的清洁偏好中毒-语言直接偏好优化
articles.content_zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)已成为一种被广泛采纳的调和视觉语言模型(VLM)的方法,但多式联运偏好数据的安全性基本上仍未被探讨. 现有的偏好中毒攻击要么腐蚀了明确的监督信号,要么需要明显的触发器,从而在人类的检查下可以探测到. 我们引入了DPOison-VL,这是针对VLM-DPO的首个清洁偏好中毒攻击,它完全通过对一小部分训练图像的不易察觉的扰动来操纵模型对接,同时将所有的提示,回应,和偏好说明都留下了完整无缺地. 我们制定毒构图,作为双层优化 并得出梯度对齐代用 高效引导图像扰动 向攻击者指定的偏好。 我们还在固定毒剂预算下对有原则的毒药选择实行优先置换分数,并具有可证明的一等最佳性,并得出一个充分的条件,使优惠倒置。 跨越不同攻击任务的广泛实验,不同的VLM架构和尺度,以及基线比较都表明,DPOison-VL实现高达98QQ的ASR,只有2QQ的毒数据并展示出跨模型可转移性,同时在很大程度上保持了干净的准确性和通用性. 我们的研究结果表明,在VLM-DPO中存在着严重的弱点,在这种弱点中,偏好培训数据中难以察觉到的图像扰动可以悄悄地改变校正方向。

articles.title: Recasting DiT for Extreme Image Compression with Hierarchical Visual Priors
articles.content: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for extreme image compression, but their stochastic, iterative generation processes are not designed to decode compressed representations directly. We present PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) as a bitstream-grounded one-step generative decoder. PrismCodec uses the decoded representation in two complementary roles: a projected codec state defines the starting state for generation, while hierarchical visual priors derived from the same decoded latent provide semantic and structural guidance. To bridge the gap between stochastic, iterative generation and deterministic one-step decoding, we develop a progressive adaptation strategy. We first learn codec-conditioned transport from a noisy neighborhood centered on the codec state, distill it into a one-step mapping, and finally anneal the source perturbation to zero during end-to-end optimization. The resulting decoder reconstructs deterministically from the received representation without additional conditioning bits. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec consistently improves rate-perception performance over prior generative codecs, achieving BD-rate reductions of 70-75% in LPIPS and 75-81% in DISTS over StableCodec. Code will be released upon acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用分级视觉前传重制极端图像压缩的 DiT
articles.content_zh: 被预先训练的传播模型为极端图像压缩提供了强大的基因前传,但是它们的有花样的,迭代的生成过程并不是直接去解码被压缩的表示. 我们提出PrismCodec,它重塑了一种经过预先训练的分泌变形器(DiT),作为位流基的一阶分基因解码器. PrismCodec在两个互补角色中使用解码的表示:一个预测的编码状态定义了生成的起始状态,而由同一种解码后潜入的分级视觉前传则提供语义和结构指导. 为了弥合分层、迭代生成和确定性一步解码之间的差距,我们制定了渐进的适应战略。 我们首先从一个以解码器状态为中心的吵闹邻里 学习解码器条件的运输, 把它蒸馏成一个一步骤的映射, 最后在端到端优化时, 将源扰动到零。 由此产生的解码器在不增加附加条件位值的情况下,从收到的表示值中确定性地重建出. 在整个Kodak、CLIC和DIV2K地区,PrismCodec不断提高比以前基因编码的速率感知性能,使LPIPS的BD率降低70-75%,而DSTS的BD率降低75-81%。 守则一经接受就会公布。

articles.title: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
articles.content: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLM2R:从大语言模型到3D 重组器
articles.content_zh: 3D部分组装旨在通过预测每个部分的刚性SE(3)变换来从一组未组装的部分中重建出完整的形状. 由于一个部分的位置很少由它自己的几何来决定,所以任务需要对整个部分集进行推理,而现有的方法依赖于对等关系或迭代生成和验证,对多部分的物体的尺度差. 我们提出LLM2R,它将部分组装作为序列建模,采用预先训练的解码器唯一的大语言模型(LLM):一个Point-BERT编码器和一个Q-Former压缩器将每个部分压缩成一块几何符号,所有部分的块被调和,一个由Low-Rank Adaptation(LORA)所适应的因果LLLM在一个前行处理序列. 然而,由于引起注意,让一部分的隐藏状态只观察它之前的部分. 因此LLM2R在后半部分后附加了一组可学习的汇总符号:这些符号跟随了每个部分,所以它们的状态以恒定的符号成本将整组集合起来,一个部分意识在预测其自转和翻译之前会将每个部分的状态与它们组合在一起. 因此,一个架构处理语义和几何组装,并预测在单个非自回传中的所有外形. LLM2R在所有三个PartNet类别上都实现了最高的部分精度和成功率,在PartNeXt上实现了最佳旋转出错,翻译出错和部分精度,在Breaking Bad上实现了最低的翻译出错和最快的推论,只有断裂专用方法更准确. 它的优势随着零件数量的增长而增加:在100个零件上,它在Breaking Bad和Assembler上部分精确度超过GARF33.5分29.1分,在PartNet上将零射入不可见的分类中,比三个基线中最强的部分精度高出16分以上.

articles.title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20\%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in $3$ of $7$ (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average $98\%$ of its score across the other four.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 反思多式有限责任管理课程的投影员培训
articles.content_zh: 多式联运有限责任公司通常首先通过大型图像封装数据集的投影器培训,将视觉编码器与语言模型相统一,然后对完整的多式联运模型进行联合培训。 尽管它被广泛使用,但投影器培训阶段的作用仍然没有得到很好的了解. 我们发现:(一) 仅使用10至20美元的数据来培训投影仪已经恢复了大部分下游的性能收益,(二) 接受过不同数据集培训的出影仪可以线性地插入,同时基本上保持性能. 这些结果表明,投影仪培训主要进行粗细的对接,许多不同的投影仪同样取得了良好的成绩. 基于这些调查结果,我们提议PORTAL,一种无培训投影器初始化,既不要求成对的图像封装数据,也不要求以梯度为基础的优化,而只要求每个模式的汇总统计。 Portal在共享主子空间上计算视野和语言特征分布的高斯近似值之间的最优化的基于交通的地图,从而可以完全跳出投影器训练阶段. 在没有任何对接数据的情况下,PORTAL匹配了在558k图像封装对上培训的标准管线,跨越了6个LLM主干线,两个视觉编码器,以及16个基准. 它的绩效超过了以7美元(视觉编码器、LLM)设置的3美元铺设,在其他四个国家平均达到98美元。

articles.title: Detecting Unreliable Classifications from Quantized Models
articles.content: Post-training INT8 quantization is typically validated by checking accuracy retention, which requires ground-truth labels often unavailable in low-resource clinical settings. We show a label-free alternative: comparing a model's own output before and after quantization. We compute cosine similarity between the FP32 and INT8 models' output probability vectors for each prediction, which requires only a single forward pass. This output-agreement similarity separates lower-accuracy predictions across four evaluated architectures (ResNet-50, VGG-16-BN, Wide ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16) under fixed-percentile splits, outperforming a confidence-only baseline for all four. These results show that quantized models can be compared to their baselines to assess their drift and determine whether they are well suited for clinical deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从量化模型中检测不可靠的分类
articles.content_zh: 训练后INT8量化一般通过检查准确性保留来验证,这需要地面真实的标签,在低资源临床环境中往往没有. 我们显示一个无标签的替代品:比较一个模型在被分解前后自己的输出. 我们计算每一次预测的FP32和INT8模型的输出概率向量的同心圆相近性,这只需要一次前行通过. 这种产出-协议相似性将四个评价架构(ResNet-50、VGG-16-BN、Wide ResNet-50和ViT-B/16)的低准确度预测在固定百分率分数下区分开来,这比所有四个架构的只有信任的基准要差。 这些结果表明,可以将量化模型与其基线进行比较,以评估其漂移情况,并确定它们是否适合临床应用。

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Brain Tumor Segmentation With Stage-Wise Shared Adapters
articles.content: Different MRI modalities reveal different parts of a brain tumor. Segmentation models combine information from these modalities to outline tumor regions. Many models use a separate encoder for each modality. However, exchanging features among these encoders at several stages can increase model complexity. We introduce the Block-Wise Shared Adapter (BWSA), which combines compressed features from the modality encoders in a shared path and returns adapted features to each stream. In its fixed-blending form, BWSA adds the adapted features to the original features. Its trainable-gated variant (TG-BWSA) instead learns separate weights for the original and adapted features at each modality and encoder stage. We evaluate both variants on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023 with four segmentation backbones. On the official BraTS 2023 online validation set, BWSA increases average region-wise Dice by 1.3--7.6 percentage points relative to the corresponding unmodified backbones. TG-BWSA increases it by 2.8--7.7 points. Both variants add approximately 0.85--3.73% parameters and reduce average HD95 relative to the unmodified backbones.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 参数有效多模式脑肿瘤分解
articles.content_zh: 不同的核磁共振模式揭示出脑瘤的不同部分. 分解模型结合了这些模式的信息来勾勒出肿瘤区域. 许多模型对每种模式使用单独的编码器. 然而,这些编码器在几个阶段之间交换特性可以增加模型的复杂性. 我们引入了 Block-Wise 共享适配器(BWSA),它将模式编码器的压缩特性结合在一个共享路径中,并返回每个流所适应的特性. BWSA在其固定的混合形式下,将被改造的特征添加到原始特征上. 其可被训练的变体(TG-BWSA)取而代之的是,在每种模式和编码器阶段,为原始和被改造的特性分别学习权重. 我们在BratS 2020和BratS 2023上评价两个变体,都有四个分块骨干. 在官方的 BratS 2023 在线验证集上,BWSA 相对于相应的未修改主干线,平均区域Dice增加了1.3-7.6个百分点. TG-BWSA将其增加2.8-7.7分. 两个变体都增加了约0.85-3.73%的参数,并相对未修改的骨干降低了平均HD95.

articles.title: Observation Quality in DSM-Assisted Aerial Localization: A Benchmark and Base-Anchored Uncertainty Calibration
articles.content: Aerial map matching provides position observations for navigation, but a position error alone does not determine how an observation should be weighted. We define five benchmark tasks: position availability and agreement, grouped error structure, predictive uncertainty, controlled updates, and temporal accumulation. A case study in digital-surface-model-assisted localization evaluates base-anchored uncertainty calibration within this framework. The method combines propagated image and map sensitivities with the second moment of a compact configuration subset relative to the reported position. The reported position remains unchanged, and scale is fitted using separate position references without local surface-height ground truth. Thirteen covariance models are evaluated on two held-out query sets from locations represented in the calibration data. Relative to a constant full-matrix baseline, the method reduces equal-location normalized position-update risk by 7.70% on 728 conditions and 5.46% on a separate 142 conditions under an independent prior, with all localization failures included. On the primary set, equal-location negative log likelihood improves by 2.571 nat. These results show improved reference-based weighting at seen locations. Exploratory base-quality and conditional-addition controls leave the incremental update benefit of configuration disagreement unresolved. Navigation benefit and real temporal accumulation remain untested.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DSM-Assised 空中本地化的质量:基准和基准-确定不确定性校准
articles.content_zh: 空地图匹配为导航提供了位置观测,但仅一个位置出错并不能决定观测应如何加权. 我们界定了五个基准任务:位置可用性和协议,分组错误结构,预测不确定性,可控更新和时间积累. 数字地表模型辅助本地化的案例研究评估了这一框架内的基础不确定性校正。 该方法结合了所传播的图像和地图敏感性,以及相对于所报告位置的紧凑配置子集的第二分集. 报告的位置保持不变,采用单独的位置参考,没有局部地表高地真相。 对来自校准数据所示地点的两组搁置查询进行了13个共变模式的评价。 相对于恒定的全方位基线,该方法在728个条件下将等位态常态更新风险降低7.70%,在独立前的142个单独条件下降低5.46%,包括所有本地化故障. 在主集上,等位负对数概率提高了2.571纳特. 这些结果显示,在所见地点,参照加权得到改进。 探索性的基础质量和附加条件控制使得配置分歧的递增更新好处得不到解决. 航行利益和实际时间积累仍未经过检验。

articles.title: Denoise X: Self-Supervised U-Net for Quantum Mottle Suppression in Chest Radiography
articles.content: Deep learning for medical image restoration is often constrained by the need for paired training data. Acquiring perfectly registered clean-noisy radiographs in vivo is impractical due to patient motion and radiation-dose limits. To address this, we employ a self-supervised Noise2Noise paradigm that trains on independently corrupted observations without paired clean images. We propose Denoise X, a lightweight self-supervised U-Net model (7.79M parameters) for suppressing quantum mottle and electronic readout noise in low-dose chest radiographs. It is trained on the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset (112,120 images) using a stochastic Poisson-Gaussian noise simulator. Zero-shot evaluation on the unseen Montgomery County dataset achieved a PSNR of 36.09 dB and SSIM of 0.8806, outperforming the Bilateral filter while preserving high-frequency anatomical details. Using patch-wise inference, Denoise X processes native-resolution chest radiographs in ~2.2 s per image on a Tesla P100 GPU. Cross-domain evaluation on the Shenzhen dataset achieved 36.44 dB PSNR and 0.9099 SSIM, showing strong generalization. For resource-constrained deployment, the model was converted into a 31.16 MB ONNX model for efficient CPU inference on non-DICOM images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Denoise X:胸腔射线术中量子模压抑自导自演的U-Net
articles.content_zh: 深入学习医疗图像修复往往受到对等培训数据需要的限制. 由于病人的移动和辐射剂量限制,在活体中获取完全注册的无声无声无声的放射图是不切实际的。 为了解决这个问题,我们采用了一个自我监督的噪声2 噪声范式,在独立被腐蚀的观测上进行训练,而不配对干净的图像. 我们提出Denoise X,一种轻量级自控U-Net模型(7.79M参数),用于在低剂量胸腔射电图中压制量子摩特和电子读出噪声. 它在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集(112,120相片)上接受了训练,采用了有花样的波生-高斯噪音模拟器. 对看不见的蒙哥马利县数据集的零镜头评价实现了36.09分贝的PSNR和0.8806分贝的SSIM,在保持高频解剖细节的同时优于双边滤波器. 使用补丁推论,德诺瓦斯X在特斯拉P100GPU上每幅图像以~2.2 s处理本土分辨率的胸腔放射图. 深圳数据集跨域评价实现36.44 dB PSNR和0.9099 SSIM,显示强通. 对于资源受限的部署,该模型被转换为31.16 MB ONNX模型,用于高效地对非DICOM图像的CPU推论.

articles.title: Unbalanced W-Flow: Unbalanced Wasserstein Drifting under Finite-Batch Marginal Fluctuations
articles.content: Teacher-free one-step generative models such as W-Flow learn directly from distributional objectives, with the Sinkhorn divergence providing the strongest empirical performance among the energies studied in W-Flow. However, Sinkhorn divergence is based on balanced optimal transport, whose exact marginal constraints can induce undesirable transport under finite minibatch fluctuations. We introduce UW-Flow, which replaces the balanced Sinkhorn energy with a debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence and derives the corresponding Wasserstein velocity. The resulting dynamics retain W-Flow's cross-minus-self structure, recover the balanced limit, and preserve target identifiability under suitable assumptions. We further characterize the finite-batch velocity error of balanced and unbalanced transport by comparing each minibatch field with its population counterpart. Our analysis identifies conditions under which marginal relaxation yields smaller minibatch-to-population velocity error, and shows that for separated matched modes, balanced sensitivity grows with inter-mode separation while the corresponding Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) sensitivity remains controlled by local transport geometry. Controlled experiments on fixed-support and continuous two-mode distributions support these predictions. On MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-100, UW-Flow improves generation under matched training budgets, with the largest gains in unconditional generation and consistent improvements in the class-conditional setting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 未平衡 W- Flow: 在Finite-Batch边际波动下未平衡的瓦瑟斯坦漂移
articles.content_zh: W-花等无师子的一阶基因模型直接从分布目标中学习,而辛克霍恩分化提供了W-花所研究的能量中最强的经验性能. 然而,辛克霍恩差异是以平衡的最佳运输为基础的,其确切的边际限制在有限的小批量波动下可诱发不良运输。 我们引入了UW-Flow,它将平衡的辛克霍恩能量取而代之的是去偏见的不平衡的辛克霍恩分化并获得相应的瓦瑟斯坦速度. 由此产生的动力学保留了W-Flow的跨减自结构,恢复了平衡的极限,并在合适的假设下保留了目标可识别性. 我们通过将每个小批量区与人口对应区进行比较,进一步描述平衡和不平衡运输的有限-批量速度错误。 我们的分析确定了边际松动产生较小的小型批量对人口速度错误的条件,并表明,对于分离的匹配模式,平衡敏感度随着模式间分离而增加,而相应的不平衡优化运输(UOT)敏感度仍由局部运输几何控制。 固定支撑和连续双模式分布的控制实验支持了这些预测. 在MNIST,CIFAR-10和ImageNet-100上,UW-Flow在相匹配的培训预算下改进了生成,在无条件生成和持续改进课程条件设置方面收获最大.

articles.title: Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models
articles.content: Foundation models are increasingly used as feature extractors for downstream tasks with limited data, typically through representations obtained from their encoders. However, foundation models trained for structured tasks such as segmentation also form object-specific representations during task execution, whose transferability remains largely unexplored. We investigate Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) object pointers, compact object-level representations produced through the segmentation pathway, as transferable representations for downstream tumour prediction. Through experiments on two PET/CT tumour prediction tasks, we find that object pointers learned using segmentation supervision alone already encode tumour-discriminative information, despite never being optimised for the downstream labels. We further introduce task-guided object pointers, where an auxiliary objective jointly shapes the object pointer space for the downstream prediction together with segmentation. Task-guided pointers improve cancer-type classification, outperforming conventional encoder-based transfer and radiomics, while segmentation-only pointers perform best on the more challenging recurrence prediction task. Representation analyses reveal associations between object pointers and interpretable radiomics features, class-dependent organisation of the learned representation space, and explicit spatial grounding around the segmented tumour. Together, these findings suggest that useful transferable representations can emerge through the execution of a foundation model's primary task, providing an alternative to conventional encoder-based transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Encoder: 分块化基金会模型中出现的对象-子代表
articles.content_zh: 基础模型越来越多地被作为数据有限的下游任务的地物提取器,通常是通过从其编码器获得的表示. 然而,为分化等结构化任务所培训的基础模型在任务执行期间也形成针对对象的表示,其可转移性基本上仍未被探索. 我们调查通过分块路径生成的分块任何物模型2(SAM2)对象指针,紧凑的物体级表示,作为下游肿瘤预测的可转移表示. 通过对两个PET/CT肿瘤预测任务的实验,我们发现仅使用分解监督法学习的物体指针已经编码了肿瘤-区别信息,尽管从未被优化到下游标签. 我们进一步引入了任务制导对象指针,一个辅助目标会将下游预测的物体指针空间与分块相联而成. 任务指针改进了癌症类型的分类,优于常规编码器基于转移和放射线,而分解唯指针在更具挑战性的再生预测任务上表现最好. 代表性分析显示,物体指针与可解释的放射特征、所学代表空间的类依赖性组织以及围绕分块肿瘤的清晰空间地平面之间存在关联。 这些调查结果表明,通过执行基础模型的主要任务,可以产生有用的可转移表述,为传统的编码器转移提供一种替代办法。

articles.title: Meta-Video: Efficient Standardized Evaluation for Video Understanding
articles.content: Video understanding benchmarks are the primary yardstick for measuring progress in video-language modeling, and a growing body of work relies on them to claim improvements. The reported benchmark scores in these works, however, are almost always produced by frameworks (e.g., lmms eval) used as black boxes: certain evaluation choices like frame sampling, preprocessing, and input formatting are inherited from preset defaults and seldom inspected carefully. We show these unexamined choices are a major source of variance. Even for the same model checkpoint, evaluation configuration alone can shift accuracy by up to 19.5pp. Hence, it is unclear whether reported gains reflect genuine improvements in capability or differences in evaluation setup. Moreover, many benchmark samples offer little evidence of visual capability, since they can be answered without the video, and the full suites are expensive to evaluate. We address these issues in two parts. First, we curate existing suites for discriminability and efficiency, producing Meta-Video, a balanced 1,000-question benchmark over 791 videos spanning diverse tasks and durations, which largely preserves model rankings, at 5 times inference speedup for a full-frame count sweep experiment (4-128 frames). Second, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol by sweeping the configuration space to isolate choices that measurably affect results, distill them into best practices and reporting standards, and release reproducible reference scores across five models and seven benchmarks. We hope that the proposed evaluation framework and the Meta-Video benchmark will support video understanding research by providing a reproducible and efficient foundation to measure progress in a reliable way.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Meta-Video:视频理解高效标准化评价
articles.content_zh: 视频理解基准是衡量视频语言建模进展的主要尺度,越来越多的工作依赖于这些基准来要求改进。 然而,这些作品中所报告的基准分数几乎总是由用作黑匣子的框架(例如lmms eval)产生:某些评价选择,如框架采样,预处理,以及输入格式化,都是从预设默认中继承出来的,很少仔细检查. 我们显示,这些未经审查的选择是造成差异的主要原因。 即使同一型号的检查点,光是评价配置就可以改变准确度,最高可达19.5pp. 因此,目前还不清楚所报告的成果是否反映了能力的真正提高,还是评价结构的不同。 此外,许多基准样本很少提供视觉能力的证据,因为没有视频可以解答,而全套套房的评价成本也很高. 我们分两部分处理这些问题。 首先,我们对现有套房进行区分和效率管理,制作Meta-Video,一个平衡的1000个问题基准,超过791个涉及不同任务和持续时间的视频,这在很大程度上保留了模型排名,为全帧倒数扫描实验(4-128帧)的5倍推算速度. 第二,我们建立标准评价协议,将配置空间扫出,以隔离对成果有重大影响的选择,将它们提炼成最佳做法和报告标准,并在五个模式和七个基准中公布可复制的参考分数。 我们希望,拟议的评价框架和Meta-Video基准将支持视频理解研究,为可靠地衡量进展情况提供一个可复制和高效的基础。

articles.title: Dual-Domain Sparse-View 4D CBCT Reconstruction with Spatial-Temporal Consistency Learning
articles.content: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D CBCT) provides phase-resolved volumetric images for image-guided radiotherapy. Yet good reconstruction quality usually needs many projections. This increases scan time and radiation dose. We propose STCNet, a sparse-view 4D CBCT reconstruction framework that uses spatial-temporal consistency learning. STCNet reconstructs high-quality images from only 16 projections in each respiratory phase. STCNet integrates physics-driven positional encoding to enforce geometric consistency in the projection domain and introduces temporal encoding in latent space to capture respiratory motion dynamics across phases to capture dynamic respiratory motion across phases. A dual-domain collaborative strategy jointly optimizes both projection and image domains, enhancing structural fidelity and temporal coherence. We tested STCNet on the TCIA-LUNG dataset and a CIRS thorax phantom dataset. STCNet performed better than conventional methods and recent deep learning baselines in image quality, artifact reduction, and structural preservation. On TCIA-LUNG, STCNet reached PSNR values of 33.311, 32.695, and 32.658 dB at phases 2, 5, and 8. The corresponding SSIM values were 0.845, 0.823, and 0.825. On CIRS, STCNet achieved PSNR values up to 36.497 dB and SSIM values up to 0.877. These results support STCNet as a promising framework for low-dose, phase-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction in image-guided radiotherapy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 双领域 Sparse-View 4D CBCT 空间-时间一致性学习重建
articles.content_zh: 四维圆锥束计算成像仪(4D CBCT)提供相相解的体积图像,用于图像制导放射治疗. 然而,良好的重建质量通常需要许多预测。 这增加了扫描时间和辐射剂量. 我们提出STCNet,一个使用时空一致性学习的稀有视野4D CBCT重建框架. STCNet从每个呼吸相中只有16个预测值重建出高质量的图像. STCNet整合了物理学驱动的位置编码,以强制投影域的几何一致性,并引入了潜入空间的时间编码,以捕捉跨相的呼吸运动动力,以捕捉跨相的动态呼吸运动. 双重领域合作战略共同优化了投影和图像领域,增强了结构的忠诚性和时间一致性。 我们在TCIA-LUNG数据集上测试了STCNet和一个CIRS胸花幽灵数据集. STCNet在图像质量、减少文物和结构保存方面表现优于传统方法和最近的深入学习基线。 在TCIA-LUNG上,STCNet在第二、第五和第八阶段达到33.311、32.695和32.658分贝的PSNR值。 相应的SSIM值为0.845,0.823和0.825. 在CIRS上,STCNet实现了可达36.497分贝的PSNR值和可达0.877的SSIM值. 这些结果支持了STCNet作为低剂量,相相溶4D CBCT在影像导线放射治疗中重建的有希望的框架.

articles.title: EgoOmniWorld: Unifying Egocentric Understanding via Ego-Action-World Interactions
articles.content: Egocentric video understanding spans diverse capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats, yet these are often studied in isolation despite their tight coupling in real-world interaction. We propose the Ego-Action-World interaction loop as a unifying principle: the wearer perceives the world, forms goals, acts, changes the world, and uses feedback to guide subsequent behavior. Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark organized around four complementary interaction structures: Node captures ego, action, and world states; Edge captures directed relations among them; Chain captures linked dependencies; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions. We develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline that extracts structured interactions from egocentric videos, grounds them in visual and auditory evidence, and generates questions according to their interaction structure. Required modalities and single- or multi-turn formats follow naturally from the supporting evidence and dependencies. EgoOmniWorld contains 24,166 QA groups, including 20,284 training and 3,882 test samples. Experiments on representative open- and closed-source multimodal large language models reveal substantial and uneven limitations across interaction structures. Models trained on EgoOmniWorld improve in-domain interaction understanding and generalize to existing egocentric benchmarks. EgoOmniWorld provides a unified foundation for evaluating and advancing egocentric video understanding. Data, code, and models will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoOmni World:通过Ego-Action-World Interactives统一EgoCentral的理解
articles.content_zh: 以电子为中心的视频理解跨越不同的能力、模式和评价格式,然而,尽管它们在现实世界互动中紧密结合,这些内容往往被孤立地研究。 我们提出"Ego-Action-World"互动循环作为统一原则:穿戴者感知世界,形成目标,行为,改变世界,并使用回馈来指导后续行为. 基于这一观点,我们引入了 " EgoOmniWorld " 这一基准,该基准围绕四个互补互动结构: 节点捕捉自负,动作,和世界状态;边缘捕捉它们之间的定向关系;链捕捉相联的依赖关系;环捕捉反馈-闭塞的相互作用. 我们开发了一个以证据为基础的互动第一数据管道,从以自我为中心的视频中提取结构化互动,将它们放在视觉和听觉证据中,并根据其互动结构产生问题。 所需模式和单一或多回合格式自然地取自佐证和依赖。 EgoOmniWorld包含24,166个QA组,包括20,284个培训和3,882个测试样本. 关于具有代表性的开源和闭源多式大型语言模型的实验表明,在互动结构之间存在着巨大和不均衡的局限性。 在EgoOmniWorld接受过培训的模型增进了对内部互动的理解并概括到现有的以自我为中心的基准。 EgoOmniWorld为评价和推进以自我为中心的视频理解提供了一个统一的基础. 将发布数据、代码和模型。

articles.title: Physics-Aware Deepfake Detection via Distance-Speech Consistency
articles.content: Recent progress in generative models has made talking-head deepfakes highly realistic and easy to create, jeopardizing public trust. However, most audio-visual deepfake detectors rely on lip-speech synchronization and are designed for static, frontal videos, limiting their reliability in dynamic, in-the-wild recordings where the speaker moves and lip cues are degraded or missing. As an alternative, we propose a physics-aware detector for dynamic speaking videos that leverages an acoustic constraint: in real recordings, speech energy varies predictably with speaker-to-camera distance, whereas deepfake generation can break this coupling. Our method combines distance estimates from video with distance-dependent acoustic measures from speech to detect deepfakes. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks show that the proposed physical cue is effective in dynamic scenarios, and that it complements lip-sync-based detectors, with a simple ensemble achieving consistent gains across datasets. Codes are available at https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过远程语音一致性进行深假探测
articles.content_zh: 最近在基因模型方面取得的进展,使说话头的深层假象非常现实而容易被创造,损害了公众的信任. 然而,大多数的视听深假探测器都依赖于唇音同步,并被设计为静态,前相的视频,限制了其在动态,内相的录音中的可靠性,其中扬声器移动和唇音提示被退化或缺失. 作为另一种选择,我们提出一个物理感知探测器,用于利用声学限制的动态语音视频:在真实的录音中,语音能量随着扬声器对相机的相距而发生可预计的变化,而深假相机一代可以打破这种耦合. 我们的方法结合了视频的距离估计和从语音到检测深层假象的距离依赖声学测量. 有关 " 万能 " 基准的实验表明,拟议的物理提示在动态情景中是有效的,它补充了以唇合成为基础的探测器,有一个简单的组合,实现各数据集的一致收益。 编码见https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/。

articles.title: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
articles.content: Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion and flow models, but existing approaches often require auxiliary score models or specialized architectures. We show that simple on-policy velocity regression already provides a strong foundation for 4-NFE generation. To represent teacher velocity variation within each coarse transition, we introduce Pivot, a training-only residual proxy that separates local corrections from the student's interval-mean prediction. We further repel the student from weaker teacher predictions, providing a lightweight mechanism for avoiding undesirable modes. The resulting framework, Simplified Matching Distillation (SMD), remains entirely regression-based, requires neither online score estimation nor adversarial training, and leaves the deployed generator unchanged. We evaluate SMD on image generation and editing, 3D generation, video synthesis, and joint audio--video generation, scaling to 33 billion parameters. At 4-NFE, SMD outperforms strong few-step baselines and surpasses multi-step teachers on several benchmarks. It also supports cross-model, multi-teacher, and causal-video distillation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 简化和改进用于少数阶段传播的政策分散
articles.content_zh: 很少分步分馏会降低传播和流出模型的采样成本,但现有方法往往需要辅助分分模型或专业架构. 我们显示,简单的政策上的速度回归已经为4-NFE一代提供了坚实的基础。 为了代表每个粗糙过渡中的教师速度变化,我们引入了Pivot,这个只培训的残余代名词,它将局部校正与学生的间隔-平均值预测区分开来. 我们进一步将学生从教师的更弱预测中击退,为避免不良模式提供了轻量级机制. 由此产生的框架,即简化匹配分解(SMD),仍然是完全基于回归的,既不需要在线分数估计,也不需要进行对抗性训练,而且部署的生成器保持不变。 我们通过图像生成和编辑,3D生成,视频合成,以及联合音频-视频生成来评价SMD,规模达到330亿个参数. 在 " 4-NFE " 中,SMD的绩效超过了强而有力的 " 几步基线 " ,超过了 " 多步教师 " 的若干基准。 它还支持跨模型,多教师,和因果视频分馏.

articles.title: MFVSR: A Multi-Style and Fine-Grained Benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal
articles.content: Video subtitle removal (VSR) is an important video restoration task, yet existing evaluation remains limited by low-resolution datasets, fragmented test sets, and generic video-inpainting protocols that fail to adequately capture localized restoration errors, unintended modifications, temporal instability, and incomplete outputs. In this paper, we introduce MFVSR, a large-scale multi-style benchmark for fine-grained and reliability-aware video subtitle removal evaluation. MFVSR distinguishes itself through three key features: (1) Large-scale and diverse data, comprising 3,000 paired videos from Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-Generated sources, with an auxiliary set of 953 in-the-wild real videos for real-world coverage analysis; (2) Controlled subtitle diversity, spanning 16 languages and four factors covering spatial layout, temporal behavior, visual style, and language mode; (3) Fine-grained evaluation, introducing an information-conditioned, spatially decoupled protocol that separates blind from mask-guided removal and measures Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, Temporal Fidelity, coverage, and failures. Experiments on six representative methods reveal substantial discrepancies between local restoration, outside-region preservation, temporal consistency, and full-set reliability that are obscured by conventional full-frame metrics. MFVSR therefore provides a more comprehensive and diagnostic foundation for evaluating and advancing video subtitle removal methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MFVSR: 视频字幕删除的多层和精致基准
articles.content_zh: 视频字幕去除(VSR)是一项重要的视频修复任务,但现有的评价仍然受到低分辨率数据集,零散的测试集,以及无法充分捕捉出局部恢复错误,出乎意料的修改,时间不稳定,以及输出不完整的通用视频插图协议等的限制. 在本文中,我们引入了MFVSR,这是一个用于精细和有可靠性意识的视频字幕删除评价的大规模多风格基准. MFVSR通过三个关键特征来区分自身: (1)大型多姿多彩的数据,由来自Real-HQ,Real-LQ,和AI-Generated的3000对相配视频组成,辅以953个"活泼"真实视频,用于真实世界覆盖分析; (2)可控字幕多样性,跨越16种语言,并涉及空间布局,时间行为,视觉风格,语言模式等4个因素; (3)精细评价,采用信息条件化,空间分解协议,将盲目取出和措施"还原","保真","保真","保真","保真","保真","保真","保真"等,以及失败. 关于六种代表性方法的实验表明,当地恢复、区域外保护、时间一致性和全套可靠性之间存在巨大差异,而传统的全方位衡量标准却掩盖了这些差异。 因此,MFVSR为评估和推进视频字幕删除方法提供了更全面和诊断的基础.

articles.title: $\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP: Plug-and-Play Denoising for Scientific Imaging with Self-Supervised Score Priors
articles.content: Modern image restoration methods increasingly rely on large-scale supervised training, yet clean targets are often prohibitively difficult to obtain in scientific imaging modalities such as hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Plug-and-play ADMM (PnP-ADMM) with pretrained diffusion priors offers a promising alternative, but the learned prior distribution can mismatch both the target scientific image distribution and the distribution of ADMM denoiser inputs induced by dual feedback. To mitigate these mismatches, we propose $\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP, a self-supervised plug-and-play restoration framework that learns a score prior directly from observation-derived ADMM intermediate states, without clean training targets or externally pretrained weights. Specifically, the learned score corrects the input to the analytical prior update, combining observation-driven corrections with analytical regularization. We further analyze the convergence and reconstruction error of the corrected ADMM algorithm assuming an ideal score and quadratic data fidelity. Experiments on reference-guided HSI restoration, single-image HSI denoising, and MRI denoising demonstrate consistent improvements over competing methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: $/ mathrm{S}^3$- PnP: 插入并放出带有自评分前缀的科学图像
articles.content_zh: 现代图像恢复方法越来越依赖于大规模监督培训,然而,在超光谱成像(HSI)和磁共振成像(MRI)等科学成像模式中,清洁的目标往往难以获得。 PnP-ADMM(PnP-ADMMM)带有被预先训练的传播前科,提供了一个很有希望的替代方案,但事先获得的传播既可以不匹配目标科学图像的传播,又可以不匹配由双重反馈诱导的ADMM denoiser输入的传播. 为了缓解这些不匹配,我们提议$\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP,一个自我监督的插件和游戏恢复框架,它直接从观测衍生的ADMM中间状态中吸取分数,没有干净的训练目标或外部预先训练的分数. 具体而言,学到的分数纠正了对分析前更新的投入,将观察驱动的校正与分析正规化相结合。 我们进一步分析经过修正的ADMM算法的趋同与重建错误,假设是理想分数和四相数据忠实. 关于参考指导的HSI恢复、单图像HSI去诺和核磁共振去诺的实验表明,与相竞方法相比,持续改进。

articles.title: EmoGenie: Benchmarking and Evaluating Expressed and Evoked Emotion in T2I Generation with MLLMs
articles.content: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) have significantly promoted using text-to-image (T2I) models to generate images with specific affective intentions. However, the emotional effects conveyed by generated images frequently deviate from target expectations, and it remains unclear whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reliably interpret the emotion of AI-generated visual content. Existing affective benchmarks are predominantly built on natural images, while affective studies of generated images have largely focused on emotions expressed in portraits, lacking a unified benchmark for studying the emotions expressed and evoked by generated images. We therefore introduce EmoGenie, a benchmark of emotion for AI-generated images that evaluates capabilities in T2I generation and MLLM understanding across expressed and evoked emotions. It comprises 6,400 images generated by eight T2I models using 800 emotion-targeted prompts, annotated with question-answer (QA) pairs, termed EmoGenie-QA, and continuous human ratings, termed EmoGenie-Assess. EmoGenie-QA contains 90,000 closed-set questions in single-image and image-pair settings, as well as 1,057 open-ended questions for emotion description. EmoGenie-Assess benchmarks continuous affective and aesthetic prediction using 13,175 mean opinion scores (MOSs) aggregated from human ratings in terms of valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality. We further develop EmoProbe, which combines emotion question answering with response-aligned, dimension-specific regression heads for continuous score prediction. Experimental results show that EmoProbe achieves superior results on emotion-related QA tasks, while its affective and aesthetic predictions correlate better with human ratings, demonstrating its state-of-the-art capabilities of unified coarse-to-fine affective understanding for AI-generated images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EmoGenie:用 MLLMs 设定基准和评价 T2I 世代的表达和情感
articles.content_zh: 人工智能生成内容(AIGC)的快速进步大大地促进了使用文本到图像(T2I)模型生成具有特定情感意图的图像. 然而,生成的图像所传达的情感效应往往偏离了目标预期,目前仍不清楚多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)是否能够可靠地诠释AI生成的视觉内容的情感. 现有的情感基准主要建立在自然图像上,而对所生成图像的情感研究则主要侧重于以肖像形式表达的情绪,缺乏研究所生成图像所表达和所激发的情绪的统一基准. 因此,我们引入了EmoGenie,这是AI生成的图像的情感基准,用于评价T2I生成中的能力以及MLLM在表达和激发的情感中的理解. 它由8个T2I模型利用800个情感定向提示生成的6400个图像组成,并附加了"问答"(QA)对称,称为"EmoGenie-QA",并连续的人类收视率称为"EmoGenie-Assess". EmoGenie-QA包含9万个在单相和图像pair设置中的闭塞问题,以及1,057个供情感描述的开放式问题. EmoGenie-Assess使用从人类的评分中汇总的13,175个平均评分(MOS),从价值、振奋、支配地位和审美质量等方面,对持续影响和审美预测进行了基准。 我们进一步发展了"EmoProbe",它结合了情绪问题回答和响应相适应,维度特定的回归头来进行连续分数预测. 实验结果表明,EmoProbe在情感相关QA任务上取得了优异的成绩,而它的感官和审美预测则与人类的评级有更好的关联,显示了其对AI生成的图像的统一粗对细的感官理解的先进能力.

articles.title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
articles.content: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 思想家-WM:一个具有共同的多种方式代表的促进健全情报的统一世界模式
articles.content_zh: 世界模式已成为体现大赦国际的一个有希望的范例,但现有系统在模式及其支持的职能方面往往仍然支离破碎。 特别是视觉动力学,几何结构,可执行动作通常通过单独的界面或下游模块进行组合,而不是在一个共享动力学模型中共同代表并演化. 在这部作品中,我们介绍了"智者-WM"(Thinker-WM),这是一个统一的多模式世界模型,它通过一个共享的中间体"统一动力变形器"(United Dynamics Transformer)与模式特有编码器和解码器,联合了模型并生成了RGB,度量深度和机器人动作. 该模型在代表层面实现多模式统一:外观、几何和动作被转化为共同的动态代表,并由共同参数共同演变,同时保留其独特的产出结构。 同样的参数化支持多种功能,包括联合视频-动作生成,世界预测,政策推论,动作有条件的生成,视频-动作生成,反向动态. 为了检查共享的表示是否捕捉到与动作相关的信息,我们引入了轻量级运动探测器,显示被冻结的视觉表现包含可被取回的运动信息. Thinker-WM接受过关于多种元件的培训,包括大约20K小时的自负式视频、10K小时的真机器人数据以及1K小时的模拟数据,包括大约4K小时的真机器人数据,并配有对齐的深度监督。 广泛的实验表明,在体现的世界模式评价中,表现良好。 Thinker-WM在EWMBench,WorldOlympiad和WorldArena上排名第一,而受控研究则进一步证明了动作调节,几何相互作用,以及共享代表范围内的多功能训练的好处.

articles.title: CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation
articles.content: We present CoTL, a framework that learns a compact set of tokens that preserves scene geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images. Our encoder compresses the input images into small per-view sets of latent tokens that aggregate information across views to form a view-consistent scene representation. Each additional view expands the representation with only a small, resolution-independent set of tokens, allowing its capacity to grow with the available observations. To force this compact bottleneck to retain sufficient scene information, a query-based Gaussian decoder uses scene-independent queries to attend to the learned tokens and recover an explicit, renderable set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Novel-view rendering supervision trains the compact representation end to end through the reconstructed Gaussian scene. Experiments on \retenk{} and ACID show that the resulting compact, unstructured token set supports competitive novel-view synthesis and can serve as the latent space of a generative model for 3D Gaussian scene generation. Together, these results show that 3D Gaussian reconstruction is an effective objective for compact scene representation learning and the learned token space provides a basis for broader downstream tasks in 3D vision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: COTL: 3D 场景代表的收缩脚本学习
articles.content_zh: 我们提出COTL,这个框架可以学习一套紧凑的符号,从无位多视图图像中保存场景几何和外观. 我们的编码器将输入的图像压缩成小的一对一视的潜想符号集,这些潜想符号集成跨视界的信息,形成一个与视界一致的场景表现. 每种补充观点只用一小组独立分辨率的符号来扩大代表,使其能力随现有观测结果而增加。 为了迫使这个紧凑的瓶颈保留足够的场景信息,一个基于查询的高斯解码器使用场景独立的查询来处理所学的道具并取回一套明确,可渲染的3D高斯原始人. 小说-视觉渲染监督训练 紧凑的表示结束 通过重建的高斯风景。 在\retenk{}和ACID上的实验显示,由此产生的紧凑,无结构的符号集支持有竞争力的小说视角合成,可以作为3D高斯场景生成的基因模型的潜在空间. 这些结果表明,3D高斯重建是紧凑场景表现学习的一个有效目标,所学到的象征空间为3D愿景中更广泛的下游任务提供基础.

articles.title: Resource-Efficient 3D Shape and Orientation Estimation of Road Users using Roadside RGB Camera and 3D Radar
articles.content: End-to-end deep learning pipelines for camera-radar 3D object detection are well established in driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles; however, adapting them to roadside-mounted infrastructure presents significant challenges. On vehicles, sensor heights, pitch angles, and relative geometries remain largely uniform, allowing end-to-end models to generalize effectively. On the contrary, roadside sensor installations vary drastically in height, tilt, and field of view across locations, rendering end-to-end models prone to failure and difficult to adapt without massive location-specific datasets. Hence, instead of designing a complex end-to-end pipeline for direct 3D bounding box estimation, a low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage approach is proposed for real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation. The first stage utilizes any off-the-shelf, state-of-the-art method to extract 2D camera bounding boxes and associated 3D radar points for each road user. The proposed second stage then processes these inputs to construct 3D oriented bounding boxes where radar data determines 3D position, predefined templates define size for each road user, and a tiny neural network predicts a site-specific and optimized yaw angle. The algorithm is successfully validated at a curved road with a junction for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars, where it achieves 25 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson ORIN for real-time applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 资源有效 使用路边RGB相机和3D雷达对道路用户进行3D形状和定向估计
articles.content_zh: 在驾驶员协助系统和自主车辆中建立了用于相机雷达3D物体探测的从端到端的深层学习管道;然而,使其适应路面上架设的基础设施带来了重大挑战。 在车辆上,传感器高度,投出角和相對地圖相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 相反地,路边传感器装置在高度、倾斜度和不同地点的视场方面差异很大,使端到端的模型容易出故障并难以适应,没有针对具体位置的大规模数据集。 因此,建议采用低成本、资源效率高的两阶段办法,即实时三维外形和定向估计,而不是设计用于直接三维边框估计的复杂端到端管道。 第一阶段采用任何现成的、最先进的方法,为每个道路用户提取2D相机边框和相关3D雷达点。 拟议的第二阶段随后处理这些投入,以构建由雷达数据决定3D位置的面向3D的边框,预先定义的模板为每个道路用户定义大小,一个微小的神经网络预测一个站点特异性和优化的yaw角度. 该算法在一条有行人,自行车和汽车相接口的弯道上被成功验证,在其中,它实现每秒25帧的NVIDIA Jetson ORIN,用于实时应用.

articles.title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 双焦:无培训混合颗粒 用于多式 LLMs 的可视化拖放
articles.content_zh: 对多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的可视化符号搜索似乎非常有效,现有方法使用四分之一的可视化符号或更少的可视化符号,保留了95%以上在通用VQA基准上未被渲染的性能. 然而,我们对三个劳动、劳动、劳动和休闲家庭以及五个能力小组的十种方法的广泛评价揭示出一个重大差距:强有力的一般业绩往往以严重退化为代价,完成诸如劳动、劳动、劳动、休闲和视觉基础等精细任务。 我们追踪到这些失败之处,是因为保留排名最高的本土地块这一普遍模式有两个局限性。 单项重要性排名忽略了不同任务所需的补充证据,而稀有的补丁选择则会扰乱图像内容和空间完整性. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议采用双相交流方法,这是一种建立在混合格力框架基础上的无培训双相交流的双相循环方法。 它为注重查询和图像内涵的证据分配了单独的预算,并辅之以对整个图像的集中粗糙的表述。 在 LLM 之前, Bicocal 将提问词与视觉区域相匹配,通过柔和的结合平衡去规范-不偏倚的图像的显著性,同时选择图像-内含性的证据来最大限度地实现代表性的覆盖. 在LLM内部,它利用密度调整后文本到图像的注意,进一步打出符号. 拥有大约四分之一的原始可视化符号,Bicocal是唯一被评价的方法,在所有三个模型的每个能力组中保留了90%以上的未被验证的性能,在所有9个模型预算设置中平均排名第一. 该代码可查阅:https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bicocal。

articles.title: ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for remote sensing understanding, yet reliable reasoning remains challenging when tasks require fine-grained visual grounding and multi-step inference. Existing approaches typically rely on either costly pre-constructed reasoning trajectories or self-generated signals such as response consistency, which can reinforce shared errors and provide unreliable supervision. We introduce \textbf{Reasoning--Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS)}, a framework that separates reasoning exploration from candidate evaluation while allowing the two processes to evolve jointly. ReDiS instantiates two role-specific experts from a shared multimodal backbone: a \textbf{Reasoner} that explores diverse visual evidence--answer candidates and a \textbf{Diagnoser} that jointly evaluates the complete candidate set and provides credibility-aware feedback. As the Reasoner evolves, it exposes new candidate distributions and failure modes; the Diagnoser adapts to these changes and, in turn, reshapes the learning signal for subsequent exploration. To handle groups in which all sampled answers are incorrect and group-relative advantages vanish, we further introduce \textbf{Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)}, which provides minimal outcome-level correction without prescribing intermediate reasoning trajectories. Experiments on LHRS-Bench, MME-RS, and CHOICE show consistent improvements over Qwen3.5 backbones at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B scales. ReDiS improves category-averaged accuracy by 6.47 percentage points at 0.8B, while ReDiS-4B achieves the highest average performance among the compared remote sensing MLLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReDIS:遥感中多式联运理由的自演化
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)显示出遥感理解的强大潜力,但当任务需要精细的视觉地基和多步骤推论时,可靠的推理仍然具有挑战性。 现有办法通常依赖成本高昂的预先构建的推理轨迹,或自发生成的信号,如反应一致性,这些信号可以强化共同的错误,提供不可靠的监督. 我们提出\textbf{Reasoning-Diagnusis自发革命(ReDIS)},这个框架将推理探索与候选人评价区分开来,同时允许两个过程共同发展. ReDIS即时从一个共享的多模式主干线中培养出两位角色特有专家:一个\textbf{Reasoner},探索多种视觉证据解答候选人,以及一个\textbf{Diagnoser},共同评价完整的候选人集,提供可信-认知反馈. 随着"理性"的演化,它暴露出新的候选分布和失败模式;"诊断者"适应了这些变化,并进而重塑了学习信号,供后期探索. 要处理所有样本解答不正确和组相对优势消失的组,我们进一步引入\textbf{故障-调试恢复(FTR)},它提供了最小的结果级校正,而没有规定中间推理轨迹. 关于LHRS-Bench、MME-RS和CHOICE的实验显示,在0.8B、2B和4B等尺度上,与Quen3.5骨干相比,有一致的改进。 ReDIS在0.8B上提高了6.47个百分点的类别平均精度,而ReDIS-4B在比较遥感MLLMs中实现了最高的平均性能.

articles.title: Noise2Match: Self-Supervised Low-Dose CT Denoising via Adaptive Inter-Slice Matching
articles.content: With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised convolutional neural network methods have greatly improved the performance of low-dose computed tomography (CT) denoising. However, they require paired noisy-clean training data, which is difficult to obtain in practice. Some classic self-supervised denoising methods rely on the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise, making them ineffective for correlated noise in low-dose CT (LDCT) images. Considering the high similarity and weaker noise correlation between adjacent CT slices, several recently proposed self-supervised methods use adjacent LDCT slices for training. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to effectively account for the non-rigid misalignment between slices caused by anatomical variation, hindering them from satisfying the equal-mean condition required by the classic Noise2Noise framework. In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices, and then applies correction to the denoiser's outputs to better satisfy the equal-mean condition. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy-clean images. We further find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose conebeam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. To the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective image-domain self-supervised method for low-dose CBCT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms existing image-domain selfsupervised methods, offering broader applicability and higher practical value.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 噪声2Match:通过适应性相切匹配自导自演的低地多糖 CT Denoising
articles.content_zh: 随着深入学习的迅速发展,受监督的神经网络方法大大提高了低剂量计算成像术去诺能的性能. 然而,它们需要配对的噪音清洁培训数据,这在实践中很难获得。 一些经典的自监督去诺方法依赖于对像素型独立噪声的假设,使得它们在低剂量CT(LDCT)图像中的相關噪声无效. 考虑到相邻的CT切片之间的高度相似性和较弱的噪声关联性,最近提出的几种自我监督的方法将相邻的LDCT切片用于培训. 尽管如此,这些方法未能有效地说明解剖变异导致的切片间非刚性错配的原因,妨碍了它们满足经典噪声2噪声框架所要求的等同性条件. 在本文中,我们提出"噪声2Match"(Noise2Match),这是一种基于适应性切片间匹配的自控LDCT去诺克方法. 噪声2Match引入了切片间匹配网络,以在相邻切片间建模标签过渡过程,再将校正应用到denoiser的输出上来更好地满足等分条件. 我们理论上证明,在理想化的条件下,使用相邻的LDCT切片来训练噪声2Match,相当于用配对的噪音-清洁图像来监督训练. 我们进一步发现,噪声2Match也可以有效进行低剂量锥体CT(CBCT)去诺活化,这可以归结于它的校正操作会降低切片间噪声的相关性. 据我们所知,Noise2Match是低剂量CBCT的第一个有效的图像域自控方法. 广泛的实验表明,Noise2Match超越了现有的图像领域自我监督的方法,提供了更广泛的适用性和更高的实用价值.

articles.title: SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema
articles.content: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SchemaPose:基于RGB的类别-同参数类的Pose估计
articles.content_zh: 基于 RGB 的类别级别 9D 的估算仍然极具挑战性,因为一个单光学系统必须泛指整个未见的对象实例,同时共同推断出3D翻译,3D旋转,和3D大小. 与实例级的平面估计不同,类别级设置要求网络既了解一个类别内对象之间共享的内容,又了解单个实例在结构上的差异. 这一挑战在只使用RGB的设定中被放大了,在这种设定中,姿势提示,类别层次的共性,以及具体实例的变异在外观上缠绕而无直接的几何限制,使得现有框架难以学习一种与类别层次估计目标真正一致的表示. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议施克马波斯(SchemaPose),一个基于RGB的类别级的有计划制导框架提出估计. 司马 Pose为估算管道配备了用于模拟类别级常态的明确的参数化方案以及结构化实例变异,并使用推断出的方案变量在一个端到端的查询框架中指导与姿势有关的预测. 同一配方还支持模板即时化,合成注释,并呈现出统一框架内的学习. 关于合成和真实数据的实验表明,SchemaPose在基于RGB的9D级方法中实现了最先进的性能,提出了估计.

articles.title: Hallucination-aware Faithful Reasoning in Remote Sensing
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities for remote sensing reasoning, yet they frequently generate visually unsupported reasoning that contradicts the visual evidence. Existing post-training methods optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for identifying and correcting hallucinations that arise during the reasoning process. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{FaithRS}, a hallucination-aware self-reflection framework for faithful reasoning in remote sensing. We first construct \textbf{SFHD-43K}, a dataset of 43K structured, fine-grained hallucination annotations, and train a detector to identify hallucination types, underlying causes, and supporting visual evidence. FaithRS then incorporates this diagnostic feedback into a Safe Detector-Guided Corrective Rollout framework, where a safety-aware gate selectively determines whether and how to revise the response. Training is driven by a composite reward that jointly optimizes answer accuracy, reasoning faithfulness, hallucination reduction, format compliance, and revision safety. Experiments with Qwen3.5 backbones (0.8B, 4B, and 9B) show consistent improvements across four remote sensing benchmarks, with gains of up to 11.64 points.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 迷幻意识 遥感中的忠实理性
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在遥感推理方面表现出了有希望的能力,但它们经常产生与视觉证据相矛盾的视觉上无支持的推理. 现有的后培训方法主要优化于最终答案正确性,为识别和纠正推理过程中产生的幻觉提供了有限的监督. 为了解决这一局限性,我们提出\textbf{FaithRS},即遥感中忠实推理的幻觉觉自反框架。 我们首先构建了\textbf{SFHD-43K},一个由43K结构分明,精细的幻觉说明组成的数据集,并训练出一个探测器来识别幻觉类型,根本原因,以及支持视觉证据. 信仰 然后,塞族共和国将这一诊断反馈纳入安全探测器指导的矫正推出框架,其中安全意识门有选择地确定是否以及如何修改反应。 培训的驱动力是综合奖励,它共同优化了回答的准确性、推理的忠实性、减少幻觉、格式合规性和修订安全性。 以Qune3.5为主干线(0.8B,4B,9B)的实验显示,在四个遥感基准上,不断改进,得分可达11.64分.

articles.title: Visual Sevoing from Lines
articles.content: In this work, we present a fundamentally new approach to visual servoing using lines. It is based on a theoretical and geometrical study of the main line representations which allowed us to define a new representation, the so-called binormalized Plucker coordinates. They are particularly well suited to visual servoing. Indeed, they allow the definition of a proper image line alignment concept. The control law which realizes such an alignment has moreover several properties: partial decoupling between rotation and translation, analytical inversion of the motion equations and global asymptotic stability conditions. This control law was validated both in simulation and experimentally in the specific case of an orthogonal trihedron.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从行中选择视觉
articles.content_zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了使用线条进行视觉服务的一种全新的方法. 它基于对主线表示的理论和几何学研究,使我们能够确定一个新的表示,即所谓的双常态的普吕克坐标. 它们特别适合视觉伺服. 事实上,它们允许界定适当的图像线对接概念。 实现这种一致性的控制法还具有若干特性:旋转与翻译部分脱钩、运动等式的分析倒置和全球不对称稳定性条件。 这种控制定律在模拟中得到了验证,在正统三面体的特定情况下得到了实验验证.

articles.title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
articles.content: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Urbex: 市级三维场景的代理空间定位
articles.content_zh: 城市规模的3D地平面通常被表述为候选人排名,这需要预先计算的实例建议,并在大型户外场景中变得效率低下. 我们提议使用Urbex,这是一种代理式的视觉语言框架,它将地面定位为积极的空间搜索。 Urbex代表一个城市尺度的3D场景作为交互式多视图环境,允许一个VLM代理查询地标,放大到局部区域,渲染出oblique视图,并执行一个被禁入的边框. 我们优化了这项工具使用政策,在城市参考文献上进行强化学习,利用平稳的本地化奖励和轻量级塑造奖励来高效地探索。 实验显示,Urbex在City Refer上实现了最好的Hit@1和IoU,支持没有地上真人盒的无候选人地面,并且大大快于最强的城市规模排名基线. STPLS3D-Refer上的零镜头结果进一步表明跨场稳健性得到改进.

articles.title: CityCode: Building Agent-Operable 3D Cities from Sparse Aerial Observations
articles.content: Urban spatial intelligence calls for 3D cities that agents can measure, interpret, and modify across successive tasks. Maintaining such cities as persistent, code-based states requires lightweight acquisition and support for consistent state updates without repeated dense reconstruction. We therefore formulate a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating large-scale, instance-level parameterized 3D cities from one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, while recovering metrically scaled buildings and explicit road geometry and connectivity. We introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation that unifies metric geometry, urban topology, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities, with dependency-aware versioned execution for validated updates and historical restoration. We further develop Air2Code to construct this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation. To address occlusion and incomplete coverage, recovered structure and observed appearance guide generative completion and subsequent structure-aware 3D generation for buildings and backgrounds. Experiments on CitySample-Aerial and UrbanScene3D demonstrate substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to the target cities compared with the evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, CityCode supports continued querying, editing, planning, and historical restoration over evolving city states. Together, CityCode and Air2Code turn sparse aerial observations into persistent, agent-operable urban worlds for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CityCode: 从 Sparse 空中观测中建立可操作代理 3D 城市
articles.content_zh: 城市空间情报需要3D城市,使代理人能够测量、解释和修改连续的任务。 维持持续,以代码为基础的状态等城市,需要轻量级的获取和支持一致的状态更新而不重复密集重建. 因此,我们为基于城市的世界建设制定一个新的环境:从每个区域一个低空空中RGB图像和已知相机参数生成大规模、实例级参数化的三维城市,同时恢复测量规模的建筑物和明确的道路几何和连通性。 我们引入了CityCode(City Code),这是一个可操作的代理代表,它通过持续的实体身份来统一度量几何,城市地貌,视觉语义和3D资产,并具有依赖意识版本的执行,用于验证更新和历史修复. 我们进一步发展了Air2Code,通过将视觉结构提取与调整后的测量深度估计相结合来构建这种表示. 为解决隔离和覆盖不完整的问题,恢复结构和观察外观指导建筑物和背景的分基因完成和随后的结构意识3D生成。 关于CitySample-Air和UrbanScene3D的实验表明,与所评估的基线相比,对目标城市的测量结构恢复和较高的视觉忠诚度要高得多。 在50个任务链中,每个50个步骤,CityCode支持持续查询、编辑、规划和历史修复,以覆盖不断演变的城市州。 CityCode和Air2Code一起,将稀有的空中观测变成能持续使用剂的城市世界,用于长相空间智能.

articles.title: ShoeFit: A New Dataset and Dual-image-stream DiT Framework for Virtual Footwear Try-On
articles.content: Virtual footwear try-on (VFTON), a critical yet underexplored area in virtual try-on (VTON), aims to synthesize faithful try-on results given diverse footwear and model images while maintaining 3D consistency and texture authenticity. Unlike conventional garment-focused VTON methods, VFTON presents unique challenges due to (1) Data Scarcity, which arises from the difficulty of perfectly matching product shoes with models wearing the identical ones, (2) Viewpoint Misalignment, where the target foot pose and source shoe views are always misaligned, leading to incomplete texture information and detail distortion, and (3) Background-induced Color Distortion, where complex material of footwear interacts with environmental lighting, causing unintended color contamination. To address these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, a multi-view shoe try-on dataset consisting of 7305 well-annotated image triplets, covering diverse footwear categories and challenging try-on scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a dual-stream DiT architecture, ShoeFit, designed to mitigate viewpoint misalignment through Multi-View Conditioning with 3D Rotary Position Embedding, and alleviate background-induced distortion using the LayeredRefAttention which leverages background features to modulate footwear latents. The proposed framework effectively decouples shoe appearance from environmental interferences while preserving high-quality texture detail through decoupled denoising and conditioning branches. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves rendering fidelity and robustness under challenging real-world product shoes, establishing a new benchmark in high-fidelity footwear try-on synthesis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ShoeFit: 虚拟脚套试验的新数据集和双图像流 DiT 框架
articles.content_zh: 虚拟鞋试验区(VFTON)是虚拟鞋试验区(VTON)中一个关键但探索不足的地区,旨在结合不同鞋类和模型图像,综合忠实的试验结果,同时保持三维一致性和纹理真实性。 与传统的以服装为主的VTON方法不同的是,VFTON由于(1)Data Scarcity,由于产品鞋与穿同型鞋的模型难以完全匹配而产生出独特的挑战;(2)Videopoint Misalication,目标脚姿势和源鞋视图总是错位相通,导致纹理信息不全和细节扭曲;(3)背景所引发的色彩扭曲,鞋类的复杂材料与环境照明相互作用,造成出乎意料的色彩污染. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了MVShoes,这是一个多视图鞋试验数据集,由7305个有说明的图像三重体组成,涵盖不同的鞋类和具有挑战性的试穿情景. 此外,我们提议采用双流DiT架构,即ShoeFit,目的是通过多维条件和三维扶轮姿势嵌入来缓解观点的错位,并使用利用背景特性来调制鞋类潜伏物来缓解背景引起的扭曲。 拟议框架有效地将鞋的外观同环境干扰脱钩,同时通过脱钩和调节分枝保留出高质量的纹理细节. 广泛的定量和定性实验表明,在挑战性的现实世界产品鞋下,我们的方法大大提高了忠贞性和稳健性,建立了高诚信鞋试验合成的新基准。

articles.title: Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing
articles.content: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Omni-RS:统一遥感多任务理解和生成
articles.content_zh: 实用的遥感应用往往需要同一地貌的理解和生成能力。 然而,大多数现有方法要么孤立地解决理解或生成问题,而现有的统一遥感模型的基因能力仅限于文本到图像. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议Omni-RS,一个支持四项遥感理解任务和五代任务的统一框架。 具体来说,我们引入了"场景向导双层训练"策略,首先将多模式大语言模型用于遥感理解,再用其隐藏状态来引导一个扩散变压器来进行图像生成. 为了能够在不同世代任务中进行联合学习,我们通过将各种遥感数据组织成一个统一格式,构建一个统一的多任务生成数据集UniGen。 此外,我们引入了"详细视觉条件",它使用由一VAE编码的视觉条件来指导生成过程,从而支持需要参考图像的额外生成任务. 广泛的实验表明,Omni-RS在理解任务方面表现特别出色,并在各种遗传性任务中取得了突出成果.

articles.title: AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction
articles.content: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions.
