AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Afect World:确定情感驱动未来世界预测的基准
articles.content_zh: 世界包括自然环境和人类行为者。 预测其演化需要既了解物理定律,又了解情感如何塑造人的行动. 然而,现有的世界模型基准主要评估物理可信度和知觉质量,使得由情感驱动的世界演变在很大程度上没有经过测试. 我们引入了AfifeWorld,这个基准通过三项任务来评价情感-行动-世界国家链: 世界-状态一致性,情感-行动一致性,和Causal一致性. 它由1 498个每日录像样本组成,上面标注着合理的情绪、行动倾向和原子世界国家的限制。 由233个样本组成的反事实子集测试在固定场景和事件条件下改变剂的情绪是否产生相应的动作和后果变化. 我们界定了三项任务的8个指标和一个额外的反事实指标,将自动视觉评估和人校准的VLM/LLM判断结合起来。 对5个"SOTA"世界模型(如Cosmos3)的评价要求世界态变化分数为0.100-0.280分,反事实情感敏感分数为0.027-0.070分,按[0, 1]分级计算. 这些结果表明,在产生由情感驱动的行动的后果和使未来的预测适应情感干预方面存在着巨大的差距。 AffectWorld提供了一个测试台,用于推进那些能够捕捉情感如何塑造未来物理和社会状态的世界模型.

articles.title: Robust Logical Anomaly Detection under Capture Shifts via Synthetic Anomalies
articles.content: Detectors of logical anomalies, such as missing, extra or wrongly combined parts, usually score a test image by its distance from normal (good) images. They achieve near-perfect image-level AUROC on standard industrial anomaly detection benchmarks such as MVTec LOCO, but their robustness to changes in capture conditions remains largely unexamined. Under a heterogeneous perturbation protocol in which each test image is randomly kept unaltered or subjected to a brightness reduction or a zoom-out transformation, the normal-reference methods we tested lose 9.7 to 34.1 AUROC points, and two of the strongest, CSAD and SALAD, fall from 97.7% and 96.4% to 68.1% and 62.3%. We propose a framework in which a classifier, trained on normal images and on synthetic anomalies, scores a test image without comparing it with normal data. From a short description of each product, a language model derives anomaly types and editing instructions, an image editor applies them to normal images, and the classifier learns to separate the edited images from automatically discovered normal sub-modes. With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the perturbation protocol. Trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, so that neither test perturbation occurs in training, it still reaches 92.5% (93.2% clean). These results suggest that clean benchmark scores can hide a strong sensitivity to capture conditions, and that learning the decision from both normal images and rule violations may reduce it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过合成异常物进行强力逻辑异常检测
articles.content_zh: 逻辑异常的探测器,如缺失,额外或错误地组合的部分,通常会以与正常(好)图像相距相距而得分. 它们在MVTec LOCO等标准工业异常检测基准上实现了近完美图像级的AUROC,但是它们对于捕捉条件变化的强性基本上仍未被考察. 在一个千差万别的扰动协议中,每个测试图像被随机地保持不改变,或受到亮度降低或放大变换的影响,我们测试的正常参照方法损失了9.7至34.1AUROC分,两个最强的CSAD和SALAD从97.7%和96.4%下降到68.1%和62.3%。 我们提出一个框架,一个接受过正常图像和合成异常培训的分类员,在不与正常数据进行比较的情况下,对一个测试图像进行评分。 从对每种产品的简短描述中,一个语言模型得出异常类型和编辑指令,一个图像编辑器将其应用于普通图像,分类者学习将所编辑的图像与自动发现的普通子模型相分离. 有了完整的培训食谱,框架在清洁图像方面达到94.9%的AUROC,低于SALAD和CSAD的1.5至2.8分,在扰动协议下达到94.1%. 训练时没有亮度或放大增能,因此在训练时没有发生试验扰动,仍然达到92.5%(93.2%)。 这些结果表明,干净的基准分数可以隐藏对捕捉条件的强烈敏感性,从正常图像和违反规则行为中学习决定可能会减少.

articles.title: Unsupervised and Supervised Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)
articles.content: Since the rise of supervised deep learning modelet dets, researchers has attempt to solve infrared small targection using various models like conventional neural networks, GANS, Transformers, Mixture of Experts and recent graph/hypergraph neural networks. Moreover, these deep neural networks methods surpassed the traditional unsupervised models and the low-rank and sparse decomposition unsupervised models reviewed in "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1). In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the deep learning models in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models of strategies. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the specific performance evaluation. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research.

articles.title_zh: 红外小目标探测的不受监督和监督的方法:概览、挑战和观点(第二部分)
articles.content_zh: 自被监管的深层学习模型德特兴起后,研究人员一直尝试利用常规神经网络,GANS,变形器,专家混合和最近的图/通谱神经网络等多种模型来解决红外小凝固. 此外,这些深层神经网络方法超越了传统的无监督模型以及"红外小目标探测的传统和近期方法:概览、挑战和视角"(第一部分)所审查的低等和稀有分解的无监督模型。 在这方面,本文的目的是提供红外小目标探测中深层学习模型的完整调查. 首先,我们从战略模型的模型方面对文献中发现的不同方法进行分类。 然后,我们讨论了他们声称处理的危急局势。 此外,我们提出了具体的绩效评估。 然后,我们最后为今后的研究提出几个有希望的方向。

articles.title: LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout
articles.content: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

articles.title_zh: LongForcing: 为长视世界推出增高时间操纵仪
articles.content_zh: 自动回放的视频传播模式已经出现,成为长视世界推出的基础. 然而,当这些模型被扩展到远远超出其训练窗口时,会遭受进取漂移:视觉质量恶化,运动变得不一致,随着生成的相框作为上下文递归再利用,物体身份会逐渐崩溃. 我们研究一个监督-视距差距:短视蒸馏在以后推出时没有直接监督。 我们显示,匹配短窗口边际不需要决定长视野的行为,而较长的政策轨迹则暴露出延迟被训练失败. 这促使长期世界模型在时间上进行多重匹配。 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们引入了"长效"(LongForcing),一种分馏方法,将师资监督范围扩大到长期学生自学. LongForcing保留了短视的教师强制和因果ODE-dispiration阶段,同时将最终分配-比对阶段的真分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分取分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分 长相师监使用标准分配相配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配配 我们评价了从文本到视频生成的"长效"(LongForcing)和具有交互行动条件的世界模式,实现了V Bench质量分数85.52分,并在第一人称平分中将WorldRoam Bench 60s动作分数提高23.9分. 定性应激测试进一步抽取互动推出时间可达24小时,远远超出训练范围. 这些结果表明,在时间轴上扩大监督是朝着长期世界模式迈出的实际步骤。 项目网站和代码见https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

articles.title: Efficient Scene-Text Refinement via Pixel-Space Grouped Image Generation
articles.content: Generated images often have coherent layouts and visual content, yet local errors in small text and complex characters still limit their readability and practical use. Scene-text refinement requires accuracy, preservation, and efficiency. Existing methods based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) can lose fine strokes during reconstruction, while full-image editing can shift background colors. In this work, we introduce PixText, a model that formulates local text refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space. Conditioned on the original image, PixText generates only the target regions, preserves unedited content, and uses MeanFlow for four-step generation. We further introduce Text Refinement Bench to evaluate text correction and image preservation in generated images. On this benchmark, PixText achieves 83.06% glyph pass and 94.66% exact target-character OCR accuracy, versus 36.77% and 52.31% for the strongest baseline. Its four-step MeanFlow variant retains an 81.84% pass rate with less than one GPU-second of amortized generation cost per image.

articles.title_zh: 通过像素-空间组合图像生成来完善高效的场景文本
articles.content_zh: 所生成的图像往往有连贯的布局和视觉内容,而小文本和复杂字符的局部错误仍然限制了其可读性和实用性. 改进场景文本需要准确、保存和效率。 以可变自编码器(VAEs)为基础的现有方法在重建期间会失去细微的中风,而全图像编辑可以改变背景颜色. 在这个作品中,我们引入了PixText,这个模型在像素空间中以分组图像生成的形式,来表达本地文本的完善. 以原始图像为条件,PixText只生成目标区域,保存未经编辑的内容,并使用MeanFlow进行四步生成. 我们还引入了 " 文本改进座椅 " ,以评估生成图像中的文本校正和图像保存情况。 在这个基准上,PixText实现了83.06%的glyph通取和94.66%的精确目标特征OCR精度,而最强的基准为36.77%和52.31%. 其四相平面变体保留了81.84%的通过率,每幅图像的分期摊还成本不到一GPU-秒.

articles.title: Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)
articles.content: Infrared small target detection is often used in different civilian and military applications to detect static or moving targets in scenes like in ground, air and sea surveillance. First valuable research has emerged since 30 years ago and the two last decades witnessed very significant publications in this field following the rise of low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods) and deep learning models (data-based methods). Furthermore, several surveys can be found in the literature but none of them addresses an overall review in this field. In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the traditional and recent approaches in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models, i.e mathematical models, machine learning models and signal processing models. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the available resources, datasets and libraries. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research. For the sake of reading, this survey is divided into two parts: 1) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)" about conventional and low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods), and 2) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)" about deep learning models (data-based methods).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 红外小目标探测的传统和最近方法:概述、挑战和观点(第一部分)
articles.content_zh: 红外小目标探测常用于不同的民用和军用,用于探测地上,空中和海上监视等场景中的静态或移动目标. 自30年前以来,出现了第一次有价值的研究,在低等和稀有分解(以模型为基础的方法)和深层学习模式(以数据为基础的方法)的兴起后,在过去的20年中,在这一领域出现了非常重要的出版物。 此外,文献中还有几项调查,但其中没有任何一项涉及这一领域的全面审查。 在这方面,本文件的目的是对红外小目标探测中的传统和最近的方法进行完整的调查。 首先,我们从建模模型,即数学模型,机器学习模型和信号处理模型的角度,对文献中发现的不同方法进行分类. 然后,我们讨论了他们声称处理的危急局势。 此外,我们介绍了现有资源、数据集和图书馆。 然后,我们最后为今后的研究提出几个有希望的方向。 为了阅读,本调查分为两部分: 1)"红外小目标探测的传统与近期方法:概述,挑战和视角(第一部分)"关于常规和低等和稀有分解(以模型为基础的方法),2) 关于深度学习模式(以数据为基础的方法)的"红外小目标探测的传统与近期方法:概述,挑战和视角(第二部分)".

articles.title: FALLNEST: Dual-Domain Dataset Condensation of Imbalanced IMU Data for Wearable Fall Detection
articles.content: Wearable fall detection is hampered by rare fall events, scarce labeled IMU data, and the cost of training deep models on large, imbalanced corpora. Existing methods either rely on hand-crafted features with shallow classifiers, which limits learning from raw signals, or train deep networks on full datasets that require re-sampling to counter class skew and demand substantial data and compute. To address this, we propose a novel Fall detection framework via Normalized-gradient and Embedding matched Synthetic Time-frequency condensation, dubbed FALLNEST, a data-centric approach that distills large, imbalanced IMU datasets into tiny, class-balanced synthetic training sets. Building on dual-domain time-series condensation (CondTSC), FALLNEST introduces a fall-specific 7-channel input with accelerometer vector magnitude, class-balanced K-Means initialization, and normalized gradient matching with gradient clipping, combined with MMD-based embedding alignment and multi-view Fourier-domain augmentation, so that class balance arises from the condensed set itself rather than from re-sampling. We evaluate on SisFall, KFall, and MobiFall using strict subject-wise splits and naturally imbalanced test sets, reporting accuracy, Macro-F1, and PR-AUC over five seeds. A 102K-parameter TinyCNN trained on only 32 to 146 synthetic windows (about only 1% of the training windows) reaches 93.5-95.8% mean accuracy and 0.89-0.98 PR-AUC, with standard deviations of 1.0-1.7% in accuracy, demonstrating the efficacy of our approach.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FALLNEST:可穿戴瀑布检测的IMU平衡数据双领域数据集凝聚
articles.content_zh: 可穿戴的倒地探测因罕见的倒地事件而受阻,被贴上IMU标签的数据稀少,在大型不平衡的蝎子上训练深层模型的成本也很高. 现有方法要么依靠手制特征和浅分仪,这些特征限制了从原始信号中学习,要么在需要再作取样的完整数据集上训练深分网络,以对抗类分仪并需要大量数据和计算. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出一个新的Fall检测框架,通过正常升级和嵌入匹配的Synthetic Time-频率收缩,被誉为FALLNEST,一种以数据为中心的方法,将庞大的,不平衡的IMU数据集分解成细小的,阶级平衡的合成培训集. 在双域时间序列收缩(CondTSC)的基础上,FALLNEST引入了带有加速计矢量级的秋季特异性7道输入,类平衡K-Means初始化,并实现梯度相匹配与梯度剪接的常态相匹配,并结合了基于MMD的嵌入对接和多视图Fourier-domain增生,因此类平衡来自于收缩的设定本身,而不是从再采样. 我们用严格的主题划分和自然不平衡的测试集、报告准确性、Macro-F1和PR-AUC来评价SisFall、KFall和MobiFall。 102K-参数的TinyCNN只培训了32至146个合成窗口(约占培训窗口的1%),达到93.5-95.8%的中精度和0.89-0.98 PR-AUC,标准偏差为1.0-1.7%的精度,证明了我们的方法的有效性.

articles.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
articles.content: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 春克法案:代理机器人动作春克
articles.content_zh: 代理机器人在机器人控制回路中放置了一款大型语言模型(LLM)代理,由它将感知,运动,和视觉-语言动作(VLA)工具作成于一个内存的引导下,从而在不进行再培训的情况下被概括为新任务. 这种通俗性以高效益为代价。 每个原始人都需要在完整的互动史上进行一轮LLM推理,因此一集的成本随着原始人的数量而增加. 我们认为这一推理在很大程度上是多余的:一旦选择了一个子目标,它的原始就遵循了内存已经规定的常规. 我们介绍Chunk Act, 它引入动作块化 代理机器人。 Online,单调会发射出一整块被链式的原始人,这些原始人只在失败时自动执行并返回控制. 下行,ChunkAct将内存编译入这些块中,因此执行在测试时是无内存的,计划员被保留给需要推理的决定. 因此,LLM的计算以决定数而不是原始数为尺度. 在LIBERO-Pro上,ChunkAct在代理机器人的艺术状态上提高了5.0分,同时需要2.9x更少的LLM调用,4.4x更少的输入符,2.3x更少的输出符.

articles.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
articles.content: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Tev: 扩展长线代理环境,并给予合理进步奖励
articles.content_zh: 长视距物剂越来越引起人们注意,它们能够自发地 -- -- 从小时到天天 -- -- 执行具有经济价值的任务,这是自动发现和递归自我改进所必不可少的能力。 然而开源模式在长距离任务上仍然挣扎着,主要因为缺乏培训数据和工作食谱,而规模化两者都是很困难的:长而复杂的任务很难处理和核实,其回报也很少. 我们讨论两个。 首先,我们介绍Tev-Gym,这是第一个具有可核查的,密集的,渐进的奖励的长视距特工训练数据集——跨7个领域核查的1,170个任务环境. 它基于一种潜在的世界第一方法,首先构建一个潜在的世界:对任务领域、工作流程和每个步骤之后的预期状态的完整和正确的隐藏规格。 然后,每项任务都从这一规格逐步转化为一种能产生物剂的环境,从而实现可控制的复杂性和自然进展的衡量标准。 第二,我们把这一衡量标准变成一种培训方法:通过制定进步潜力奖励(PPRS),我们把进步转化为密集的逐步奖励,提高培训效率,使否则无法完成的任务能够训练。 使用这种食谱进行的培训产生了Tev-27B,这在代理最后考试的计算和数学科学领域(ALE-CM)上取得了实质性成果,在Pass@5上与GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5相匹配。 尽管仅接受ALE相关数据培训,它还是概括到终端-奔驰(TB)3.0和4.0子集,超过了GLM 5.2和双子座 3.7 Flash,并在TB 2.1等中视任务上达到克洛德·奥普斯 4.8级的性能.

articles.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
articles.content: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 怀疑失信:为高效理性而无培训矛盾解码
articles.content_zh: 理性模型通过一长串思维(COT)实现强效,但往往花费比解决问题所需的多的代币. 现有的缩短CoT的方法需要对每个模型进行额外的训练,在模型的隐藏状态中添加一个固定的向导矢量,或者使用解码的heuristics,如"等"等能降低准确性. 我们提议怀疑Less是一种免费的解码方法,在这个方法中,一个小得多的推理模型引导大型的推理模型走向简洁. 小模型至今已两次读取了大模型的"COT",一度被催生为简洁(简短的思想家)并一度被催生为动词(动词思想家),而其两个对数向量的相差被强度所缩放,被加入了大模型在"COT"每一步的对数. 在竞赛数学,研究生一级科学和竞争性编程的七个基准上,"怀疑Less"将Qwen3-32B的COT缩短了31%,精确度不变,表现超过了五个推断时间基线. 我们还显示,在任务性能不变的自调试编码代理中,怀疑Less将每转弯思维符减少20%. 它还以不变的准确性向另外两个模范家庭概括. 当与基于培训的压缩相结合时,它会进一步缩短已经受过简洁训练的模型的CoT. 贬损和行为分析显示"怀疑莱斯"减少了重复检查,大多数象征性的节省是在正确答案后首先出现在CoT中. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess上查阅。

articles.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
articles.content: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 混合理由代理人
articles.content_zh: 我们怎样才能建立一种超越人类语言,而仍在外部环境中通过它行事的代理人呢? 现代LLM代理商仍然通过文本进行理性和互动,而潜在的推理则提供了高效的内部介质,但缺乏本土工具访问和推理透明度. 我们用混合理性代理(HybridAgents)将这两个方向相接,在整个统一的生成过程中,这些代理在潜在推理和基于文本的互动之间动态地导航。 在结构上,一个轻量级的HybridLink可以在文本和潜伏模式之间实现无缝的过渡,而代理的连续工作内存则保存了跨多转弯的无损杂交环境. 这些设计保留了工具集成剂能力,同时使潜想可以直接检查。 基于这一架构,我们进一步发展了用于混合推理的专用培训后算法: HybridSFT通过教主干线与HybridLink相协调来稳定工具-集成混合生成,然后HybridRL通过学习何时在潜在空间思考和何时通过文本采取行动来进行规模推理. 我们以3个模型尺度评价混合体,涉及数学、科学、医学、搜索和代理推理等11个基准。 与涵盖文字和潜在方法的前沿LLM代理和代理框架相比,混合代理公司不断提高性能10.4%,同时实现35.5%-54.7%的象征性减排,1.8x-2.6x更快的推论,以及2.7x-3.7x成本节约。 代码和数据见https://github.com/couplecomputer/HybridAgent。

articles.title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.content: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 人类最后建造的遥感模型? 将任何地球观测任务设定为递归自我改进
articles.content_zh: 地球观测(EO)模型仍然由人工构建. 对于每一项新任务,专家都设计出一种培训方法,并参照基准加以调整。 我们显示这个循环可以交给代理商. 任何可核查的任务都可以作为牵引装置和验证装置,在这种装置中,验证装置界定了代理人可以使用什么,验证装置界定了什么是成功。 每个EO任务都可以通过标注的基准,独立的传感器,物理模型或同一地的反复观测来进行可核查. 仅考虑到这两个组成部分,通用编码剂就构建了EO模型,并根据自己的输出递归改进. 设置长期以来被视为单独的研究问题,从用少数标签学习到跨域适应,成为了使用和核实的选择。 在跨越光学、合成孔径雷达和多光谱时间序列图象的4个EO基准上,特制模型超过了最新水平,并且将大部分精确度保持在培训标签的1%左右。 这为EO建立了一个新的范式,在这种范式中,人们设计了用具和核查员以及代理商来构建模型,因此EO模型会像代理商一样得到改进.

articles.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
articles.content: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniCompass:Omni-Modal视频定位和理解的整体基准
articles.content_zh: 随着多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)的迅速发展,评价其视频理解能力变得日益重要. 现有的视频理解基准只涵盖部分评价层面,限制了对全方位模式视频理解的系统诊断. 我们引入了OmniCompass,这是全方位模式视频定位和理解的整体基准. OmniCompass 定义了两个评价轨道: OmniCompass-VL对需要视觉证据的任务进行视觉语言模型评估,而OmniCompass-AV对需要视听联合证据的任务进行全方位模型评估. 每个轨道包括三项相辅相成的任务:时间定位(TG)、空间定位(SG)和问答(QA),评估一个被引用的目标何时出现、在哪里以及会发生什么。 QA涵盖OmniCompass-VL中的5个认知和3个推理类,而OmniCompass-AV中的3个认知和2个推理类. OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频和2,460个跨域实例,以及短、中和长三种持续时间类型。 一个叙述和音频丰富的子集组成了OmniCompass-AV,包含240个视频和720个实例. 每个实例在两个对齐的设置下进行评估:仅文本和文本+图像,通过文本和可视语言指导来指定同一目标. 所有实例都用人工说明,并进行多轮质量核查。 对50个小额供资和微型企业的评价表明,开放源码模式仍然落后于专有模式,特别是在视听理解方面。 精确的时间和空间定位即使在领先的模型中也仍然具有挑战性,其预测仍然显示出成对的目标规格不一致。

articles.title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在模型生成前读取房间
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)一般依靠采样温度来调节其输出的随机性. 选择温度的主流方法通常涉及固定的、高压的全球设置和上下文或符号级的校正,而不是以几何解释的方式表示交流情景。 在这个作品中,我们引入了一个简单且可解释的温度选择框架,即\textbf{Scenario-Actor},它适应了所推断的情况特征的解码. 情景-actor从变形器隐藏状态中取出情景-相关结构,从情景嵌入中确定温度,这是交流环境的结构化几何表示. 经验结果显示,在Llama-3.1-8B-指令中,情景-参与者在互动社会情景中实现了强大的目标完成性能,在后续的开放式教学上取得了显著进展,与多个基线相比,在多回合对话上取得了竞争性表现。

articles.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
articles.content: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Back- Translation Still Matters: 用 LLMs 调用单语言数据进行低资源机器翻译
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的"大语言模型"(LLMS)在"零发"和"少发"的设置中,在许多任务上是有效的. 对于低资源语言的机器翻译,显而易见的选项是少发快感和微调在小型平行集上. 我们问:如果也有少量的低资源单一语言数据,怎么办? 我们主张,这种数据的更有效使用与其说是持续的预训,不如说是回译(BT)的LLM前时代技术. 目前微调的LLM会翻译出每种语言的单语句子,由此产生的对子会将其训练为倒向. 平行集的更新相隔以稳定学习. 在Odia和斯瓦希里岛上的1K并列对联中,BT以7.7至16.4 XCOMET-XXL域分继续将预训入低资源语言. 以束解码的中间翻译,它也以10次多的并行数据来比一个模型. 从平行数据中取回的文本中的例子进一步改善了BT。 我们还分析了单一语言文本的来源、质量和数量。 BT在以印地语为高资源控制语言的五种低资源语言和两套3B主干语言中,将译入低资源语言的翻译比平行的微调改进了16%至173%的XCOMET-XXL. Odia和梵文上的盲族人类评价与自动测量一致.

articles.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
articles.content: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自我演进的特工
articles.content_zh: Harness自演化修改了代理的软件脚手架,包括提示,内存,工作流程,以及可执行组件,同时保持模型权重固定. 我们正式确定一个反馈驱动的进程,在这一进程中,接受的修订始终存在。 该框架将更新目标与建议和接纳机制分开。 它区分了对解释状态的修改和对工具和代码的修订,寄存器级控制逻辑,以及插件构成. 我们通过进化优化来描述搜索的特点,并通过持续的PAC学习来检查其可靠性. 在明确的假设下,分析产生一个预期的概括约束,以历史回归预算为条件的保留约束,以及使用新的独立验证数据的高概率的承认规则。 我们审查持续利用的修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流程,对科学可靠性、人身安全和机构问责制产生影响。 以往工作的案例说明了模型-harness协同设计、分布式执行和插件再利用。 可靠的部署需要随着任务分配和评价人员的改变而不断加以验证,同时对学习、运行时间特权和相应的行动提供独立的保障。 我们在https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI网站上,全面讨论了66页的有关工作、理论、算法、评价、应用以及Harness RSI的更广泛影响。

articles.title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
articles.content: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 技能脚手架 : 以政策辅助技能信贷分配和选择性注射加强辅助学习
articles.content_zh: 活性加固学习(RL)使大型语言模型(LLM)能够从多回合相互作用中学习可核查的结果. 文字技能可以通过将之前的相互作用分馏入可再用的指导来改进探索. 然而,现有的基于技能的远程教育办法往往要么假定技能注入是有益的,要么依靠间接反馈或大量推广评价来评估其效用。 我们的试点研究表明,在有限抽样的情况下,基于推出的技能信贷分配效用估计成本高,而且不稳定,而技能效益则因候选人而异,取决于现行政策对每个查询的能力。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了SkillScaffold,这是一种适应政策的培训脚手架,将低成本技能实用性估计与选择性技能注射相结合。 SkillScafold通过重新使用经结果核实的培训轨迹,产生候选人技能,并通过对结果认识可能性的比较来估计其效用,而不推出候选人特有的环境。 由此产生的效用指导了注射是否以及注射何种技能,在估计没有候选人帮助的情况下,保留无技能的处决。 联合培训使发电机能够产生适合不断变化的执行者的技能。 脚手架RL鼓励技能内化,以进行无技能推断. 有关ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld和$τ^2$-Bench的实验表明,在短期和长期任务中,对强活剂-RL和基于技能的RL基线都取得了收益。 偏差和进一步分析支持基于公用事业的选择和弃权的重要性。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScafold上查阅。

articles.title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
articles.content: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

articles.title_zh: (原始内容存档于2018-10-21) (英语). SEAR:自演代理机器人
articles.content_zh: 边疆语言模型代理人现在可以自行改进机器人:他们写出控制代码,测试它,并保留什么作为下一步任务的技能和记忆. 我们引入了SEAR(自演代理机器人),这是一个围绕两个问题构建的框架和基准. 特工真的在学习 还是经常尝试? 它所学的东西是否仍然有助于新任务,新模拟器和真正的机器人? 框架以三种模式运行一个代理:它写出成为政策(code-as-policy)的代码,行为活在控制循环(agent-as-policy)中,或者作为一个研究者来微调一个视觉-语言-行动模型(auto-research). 该基准增加了将保留经验与反复尝试、熟悉的任务、特权模拟状态、更大的预算和运气分开的控制。 跨越7个前沿语言模型,330个模拟和5个物理任务,经过4年的代理运行时间,我们强调三个发现. 首先,机器人剂的学习曲线既取决于总的时间预算,也取决于相对于模型能力的任务难度. 更艰巨的任务使较长的会议更值得进行;在较轻松的任务中,重新滚动简短的尝试同样有用。 其次,控制代码和共享的常规在任务和模拟器之间转移,而任务特定解决方案则没有. 在一个真正的机器人上,我们观测到代理设计练习和人类新设计场景之间的性能差距. 第三,不同的模型以不同的方式更有效地演变. 有的演技最好,有的先写出代码. 而只用文字的模型与可比较的多式模型保持了同步:感知有助于错误评估,但代理推理和工具使用可能更重要. 我们发布了基准和代码库 以支持未来的研究。

articles.title: Where Do LLM Ensemble Gains Come From? Decomposing Candidate Value, Diversity, and Aggregation
articles.content: LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6.33; stronger +3.33). In FRAMES evidence aggregation, candidate-context contrasts remain strongly negative under both non-diverse controls. Our results show why ensemble evaluations should state the reference control before attributing gains to additional candidates.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在哪里进行 LLM 连成一体? 分解候选价值、多样性和综合
articles.content_zh: LLM 综艺增益常以单一的基准来衡量,但附加候选方的归属值会随着使用的比较而改变. 我们在四个相应条件下研究LLM汇总器:直接(无候选人),单相位(多相位界面中一名候选人),重复(重复一名候选人)和多相位(单独产生候选人)。 在非二相控制下,总的候选者增益(CIV)在代数上分裂为附加的候选者对比(DSV)和候选者-候选者对比(CCV);分出而非CIV取决于所选择的控制. 在MultiHopRAG模型多样性(k=2)上,重复差距Rep=-8.33 pp [13.25,-3.75]量化了相对于重复和单相位的增益之差. 在匹配的FRAMES更强小板扩展(n=200,k=3,聚合输出限制为4096)上,成对的Delta Rep=+9.67pp [+6.00,+13.50];在面板内,Rep更改符号(原-6.33;更强的+3.33). 在FRAMES证据汇总中,在两种非相向控制下,候选文本对比仍然非常负面。 我们的结果显示,为什么共同评价应说明参考控制,然后才将收益分配给其他候选人。

articles.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.content: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Pack Light, CarryOn: 为长视线特工建造面向对象的上下文
articles.content_zh: 长视野因素在持续的任务状态下累积了进展,但反复说明了如何取得这种进展的流程互动历史。 这自然提出了一个问题:长距离背景能否围绕可重复使用的进展而不是产生这种进展的历史来安排? 在本文中,我们引入了面向对象的上下文运行时间(World On),它围绕可重复使用的任务对象组织续作. 与其将压缩历史或重建的进展叙述作为延续的主要依据,WorldOn从延续载体、互补执行背景和最近互动的活后起伏的角度构建了上下文。 一项核心挑战是,在其周围历史退役后,这一可重复使用的基础仍然有效:如何携带 在更新的基础上,而不重建每一行的完整代表? 携带 保持承运人的记录,根据约束性证据和适用的环境检查修订受影响的记录,同时结转未受影响的记录并联合更新执行背景。 在OSWorld 2.0和浏览器Comp-Plus上的实验显示,分别提高了5.8%和7.0%,同时将总的象征性使用量减少了51.9%和22.9%。 项目网页:https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

articles.title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
articles.content: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BLADE: LLM 多代理系统中失败归属的审计信息使用
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型多代理系统通过跨专业角色、工具和工作流程的协作,扩大个人代理的能力。 然而,协作使失败更难诊断:一个代理人可能误解一个正确的结果,而另一个代理人则将错误推向前进。 因此,失败归属试图确定负责的代理人和决定性的错误步骤。 最近的方法追踪依赖性,但知道信息从哪里来并不等于知道信息从哪里出错. 我们引入了BLADE(通过审计依赖性证据进行Blame本地化),这是一个从追踪信息到审计其使用情况的无培训框架。 利用Jev进行结构化概率判断,BLADE利用依赖概率来选择相关的源决定交割用于审计. 在这些交割时,它审查接收决定是否忠实地和在任务要求范围内使用其来源,区别错误的引入、传播和维修。 这些结论为考虑所有执行步骤的全球诊断提供了依据。 在没有参考答案的情况下,BLADE在1 228 个失败的共享Jev决定界面下,在8个策略中实现了最佳或捆绑的步入精度,横跨了5个Who&When和Who&When Pro子集,比All-at-on快表现高2.2-11.1个百分点. 明确责任证据为建立更可解释和更可靠的代理系统提供了一条道路。

articles.title: Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges
articles.content: Rubric-based reward models (RMs) evaluate responses against explicit criteria. However, existing methods often derive criteria from observed response candidates, introducing response-induced bias that may limit rubric generalizability. Their judges also struggle with mechanical constraints when relying on reading alone, and commonly used pairwise judges provide only relative preferences, complicating their direct use for policy optimization. We propose ReVeR, a pointwise rubric RM that derives hard rules and graded principles by reasoning about the instruction alone and evaluates responses independently through tool-augmented judging. Both components are trained through label-blind distillation, in which preference labels only filter a teacher's outputs, yielding ReVeR-Traces, a large-scale dataset of rubric-reasoning and judging trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that ReVeR outperforms pairwise rubric RMs in average preference accuracy, most clearly on instruction following, as well as in test-time scaling and downstream policy optimization. We further find that generator RL improves preference accuracy while reducing rubric fidelity, and that higher preference accuracy does not necessarily translate into better downstream policies. These findings highlight that rubric fidelity, preference accuracy, and downstream utility are distinct properties, shedding light on future RM research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 任务中的Rubrics,证据中的判断:有工具强化法官的尖端Rubric奖
articles.content_zh: 基于Rubric的奖励模式(RM)根据明确的标准来评价应对措施. 然而,现有方法往往取自观测到的反应候选标准,引入了反应引起的偏差,从而可能限制标的通俗性。 其法官在单独依靠阅读时也会与机械约束相抗衡,而常用的对等裁判只提供相对偏好,使其直接用于政策优化变得复杂. 我们提出ReVeR,这是一个有指针的RM,它通过对指令的单独推理得出了硬规则和分级原则,并通过工具强化判断独立评价反应. 这两个组件都通过标签-盲分馏来训练,其中偏好标签只过滤出老师的输出,产生ReVeR-Traces,一个由rum-合理性和判断轨迹的大规模数据集. 实验表明,ReVeR在平均偏好精确度上比对分数RMs的成绩要好,其中最明显的是后续指令,以及试验时间的缩放和下游政策优化。 我们还发现,发电机RL提高了偏好准确度,同时减少了标点忠诚度,而且偏好精确度较高并不一定会转化为更好的下游政策。 这些结论强调,名义忠诚、偏好准确性和下游效用是不同的属性,为今后的管理研究提供了依据。

articles.title: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
articles.content: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI $[-.049,.059]$; permutation $p=.852$), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's $κ=.799$. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected $κ$. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Look Complete is not been grounded:评估LLM Sitreps与人类授权的情况报告
articles.content_zh: 自动危机报告评价应衡量从业人员需要什么,而不是比较什么。 通过LLM协助、作者批准的内容分析,我们利用质量内容分析,从专业人道主义局势报告中得出一个15分块信息计划,然后评价121个人类报告和261个LLM生成的报告,涉及5个灾害和3个危险类型。 在 " Idai " 气旋上的google/gemini-3.7-flash下,最好的机器臂名义上高于经验性的人类上限(0.827对0.821),但从统计学上看,这种区别与零(95-X靴子CI $[-049.059]美元;通量=852美元)是无法区分的;在Openai/gpt-5.6-luna下,订单不会重复。 在盲目100个项目Idai样本中,提交人同意双子座法官的意见,准确性为0.910,未加权的Cohen为799美元。 4名法官都同意该计划的原始协议标准为7;只有双子公司在概率补偿的美元中达到7分。 在三个主要活动中,机器报告转载了5.4%至11.0%的同日官方数字。 在这些事件中,原始准确数字与官方数字的14.3%-19.6%和机器数字的85.4%-90.1%与社会流相匹配;人工审计确认45%/50人宣布缺席,4/25人正式匹配,24/25人机器完全匹配。 在所观察到的所有12个事件判断单元中,签发与证明之间的差距是积极的:报告日期、组织、系列和权威没有在任何单元的专业报告覆盖范围内提供。 在三个主要事件中,ROUGE-L是无信息化的,BERTScore在经过多重修正后与完整性有负关系,一个通用LLM法官会改变标志.

articles.title: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 精密编码器: 忠实而通俗的调试超越单位测试奖励
articles.content_zh: 从单位测试得到的强化学习(RL)是培训后代码模型的共同配方,但单位测试只询问最终程序是否通过. 我们分析这个单位测试的奖励在调试时教给一个模型的是什么,发现虽然它提高了通过率,但它也教给模型更多的编辑,并在代码中幻觉已经正确的错误. 我们引入了PreciseCoder,一种训练算法,它用信号增强单位测试奖励,用于精密核实的本地化编辑,它与较小的编辑和较高的通过率相关. 在4B,9B,和27B型号上,"精密编码"将编辑行从7-15到3的平均次数以与单位试训相同的通过率降低. 仅被训练于单行臭虫上,PreciseCoder可以被概括到寄存器级程序修复,在那里用更小的补丁解决更多的问题. 其精度也从更弱的模型转移到更强的模型:鉴于9B精密编码器模型的推理痕迹,GPT-5.6 Sol和Qune3.8-Max等前沿模型在编辑精度上获得了4.6-12.4分,没有额外的训练. 对思维痕迹的语言分析表明,我们的奖励鼓励模型对单个行进行推理,命名出buggy行,形成一致的bug假说.

articles.title: On the Monitorability of Natural Language Autoencoders: Identification vs Discrimination
articles.content: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the Av's explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model's activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV's explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA's own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (std.err. 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation's account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV's explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model's conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model's own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.
