articles.title_zh: 关于自然语言自动编码器的可监测性:识别与歧视
articles.content_zh: Natural Language Autoencoders(NLAs)被提议作为语言模型的监督工具:活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活 它们对监督的价值取决于一个人类监视器能够从一个假的监视器中说出一个真实的激活情况,考虑到Av的解释. 我们正式将NLA培训和NLA监督部署作为两个与Emergent Communication不同的特长游戏:培训是一款基因特长游戏,而监督则是一款歧视性的多模式,部分可观察特长游戏,在被监测语言模型的激活和真实的账号之间玩出多对多的关系. 两款游戏间的差距预言AV的解释会识别它们描述的活性,而不区分其真实的叙述与相近的假的叙述,因为训练从不要求解释排除任何东西. 使用NA本身的AR作为最大协同的替代监视器模型,我们实验性地证实了对一个已放行的检查点的这种理论洞察:真实的帐号在所有320个比较中都比其他激活的帐号要好,但一次只比60.2%的单项索赔中的流利对手(std.er.6.7%,概率为50%,美元=35美元). 一个未参与的模型重写意义保留只花费了另一个活化账户的2.1%的距离,因此失败并非由NLA对子在AV的解释中开发出私人公约. 我们的对手账户测试的只是被监控语言模型的对话所解决的笔录层面的真相,因此这些结果将最简单的案件捆绑起来,而未测试关于被监控模型自身处理的诉求. 我们提出的猜想将使框架产生两种结果。

articles.title: Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models
articles.content: Code-switching (CS), the alternation between languages within an utterance, is common in multilingual speech but underrepresented in pretraining corpora. Increasing CS coverage requires finding relevant utterances in large speech collections so that they can be included in training data. One way to find such utterances is to transcribe the speech and detect language alternation in the text, but this depends on obtaining accurate multilingual transcriptions. We propose a lightweight method that detects CS directly from speech. It uses frame-level language information in pretrained speech encoders to determine whether both languages are present within an utterance. Specifically, we identify language-selective hidden-state dimensions using monolingual recordings and aggregate their frame-level activations into a CS prediction. With a small CS set used to tune a decision rule, we show that the Whisper-small encoder achieves a mean F1 of $0.798$ across 14 language pairs in CS-FLEURS, compared with $0.776$ for a CNN and $0.751$ for a HuBERT linear baseline trained for monolingual language identification. Our findings suggest that pretrained speech encoders already encode the information needed to identify CS utterances, and they provide a lightweight tool for building more representative multilingual corpora.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在语音基础模型中通过语言选择维度进行代码切换检测
articles.content_zh: 代码切换(CS),一种语境中语言之间的交替,在多语种语音中很常见,但在预训Corpora中代表不足. 扩大CS的覆盖范围要求在大型语音收集中找到相关言论,以便将其纳入培训数据。 找到这种言论的一种方法是在文字中转录语音并检测语言交替,但这取决于能否获得准确的多语种转录. 我们提出一种轻量级方法,直接从语音中检测出CS. 它在预先训练的语音编码器中使用帧级语言信息,以确定两种语言是否都存在于一个语音中. 具体来说,我们用单一语言的录音来识别语言选择性隐藏状态维度,并将其帧级活化为CS预测. 使用一个小的CS集来调制一个决定规则,我们显示,Whisper-小编码器在CS-FLEURS的14个语言对中实现平均F1为0.798美元,而CNN为0.776美元,HuBERT为单一语言识别培训的线性基线为0.751美元。 我们的调查结果表明,预先训练的语音编码器已经编码了识别CS语音所需的信息,它们为建设更具代表性的多语种公司提供了轻量级工具。

articles.title: From Relation-Specific Heads to Shared Interventions: Contextual Entrainment in Language Models
articles.content: Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. Same-family transfer exceeds different-family transfer, family residuals weaken once globally shared heads are removed, and subtype-specific searches repeatedly rediscover many global heads. Clean-completion and context-use probes further suggest that this shared intervention can reduce harmful copying while preserving ordinary relation completion and simple in-context abilities. Our findings provide a more precise perspective on contextual entrainment and its mitigation: harmful context following is not best addressed by searching for isolated relation-specific circuits, but by using heterogeneous attack prompts to reveal reusable intervention targets whose effects are shaped by semantic relation structure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从关系-特定头到共享干预:语言模型的背景培训
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型依靠即时上下文来进行内文学习,遵循格式,并适应当地证据. 然而,这种能力也引起了强烈性的关注:模型在回答后期的询问时可能会再利用早期上下文中无关的符号. 先前的工作将这种行为确定为上下文入内并找到其衰减的注意力头,认为这些头主要是任务或关系所特有的. 但是,环境内涵背后的机制是真正被关系所隔离的,还是有关系条件的搜索可以回收跨关系共享的可重复使用的组件? 我们利用19个语法语义亚型的实事求是关系 - 完成的提示, 找出了注意力头, 他们的膨胀会减少内涵, 同族家庭转移超过同族家庭转移,一旦全球共享头被移除后,家族残余被削弱,分型特异性搜索反复地重新发现许多全球头. 清洁补全和上下文使用探测器进一步表明,这种共享干预可以减少有害的复制,同时保留普通的连接补全和简单的内文本能力. 我们的研究结果提供了更精确的关于内在环境及其缓解的视角:后续有害环境不是通过寻找孤立的关联特定线路,而是通过使用异质攻击来揭示可重复使用的干预目标,其影响由语义关系结构所决定。

articles.title: SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
articles.content: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SMI: 用于分级的本体学-全体语义学ID-全能医学概念代表
articles.content_zh: 生物医学语言模型(LM)为临床任务提供了很强的表示力,但它们往往无法捕捉到医学概念中的分级结构. 这种限制对于长尾词组中稀有和精细的临床代码特别明显,随着概念频率的降低,分级-不可知的LM表达变得信息较少. 我们引入了语义医学识别器(SMI),这是构建基于本体学的语义特征和分级意识医学概念表述的无培训框架. 对于每个诊断,程序,或药物概念,SMI通过专家定义的医学本体学,将它的语义ID定义为粗到细的路径. SMI然后将冰冻的生物医学LM嵌入到相应的肿瘤层面,以形成分级-有意识的医学概念表述来保存粗细的临床语义. 基础SMI采用跨本体学层次的统一聚合,而水平加权变体则在验证数据上选择全球水平加权. 我们的理论分析显示,SMI产生比分级-不可知LM嵌入法更丰富的医学概念表现,特别是对于稀有和精细的临床概念. 实验显示SMI捕捉到有意义的分级结构并改进了临床关系预测. 关于MIMIC-IV,SMI改进了死亡率预测,再接收预测,药物推荐,以及罕见的药物预测. 在医院间疾病分类中,在跨医院分布变化的情况下,社会疾病分类的病人表现更加有力。

articles.title: Known-Voice Cloning and the Limits of Personality Transfer for Character Design
articles.content: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. Study 1 examined this question in a real-world university setting using the cloned voice of a lecturer familiar to the participating students. Study 2 examined the same question online using voices of social media content creators and members of their communities. Drawing on the concepts of identity activation, trait transfer, and person reconstruction, we show that evidence of personality transfer was limited in both studies. Observed effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. In the online study in particular, recognizable voice identity cues activated expectations about the speaker but did not reconstruct the broader person impression. Qualitative responses further indicated that judgments were frequently shaped by perceived artificiality and by whether voice and appearance fit together. Our findings moderate common concerns that cloned voices straightforwardly manipulate people into perceiving artificial characters as capable social actors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 已知的- Voice 克隆和字符设计人格转让的限制
articles.content_zh: 最近零镜头语音克隆系统的进步使得能够从短录音中再现一个可识别的声音并附在任意的虚拟字符上. 之前的工作表明,熟悉的相声身份可以将相联的个性印象带入机器人或虚拟人物等新目标. 然而,这些作品主要研究了熟悉和个性化的特效,而不是直接测试一个被克隆的熟悉的声音是否系统地将个性印象传递给一个被体现的虚拟人物. 这种转移引起人们的关切,即克隆的声音可能被用来操纵人们作为有能力的社会行为者与虚拟人物打交道。 在两项研究中,我们调查了一个虚拟角色与熟人克隆的声音说话时,人格印象是否转移. 第1个研究在现实世界的大学环境中利用学员熟悉的讲师的克隆声音来研究这个问题。 第二研究利用社交媒体内容创造者及其社区成员的声音,在网上审查了同一问题。 根据身份激活、特征转移和人员重建的概念,我们表明,在两项研究中,人格转移的证据都很有限。 观察到的效应是有选择性的,没有将不同特征或研究背景加以概括。 尤其是在线研究中,可识别的语音身份提示激发了对演讲者的期望,但没有重新塑造更广泛的个人印象。 定性答复还表明,判决往往由所认为的人为性以及声音和外观是否一致而形成。 我们的调查结果缓和了共同的关切,即克隆声音直接操纵人们将人造人物视为有能力的社会行为者。

articles.title: Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback
articles.content: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Bayesian 测试-时间推论,从薄弱的互动反馈中得出任务相匹配的相似性
articles.content_zh: 语言模型系统通过比较相似性来反复做出测试时间的决定:它们检索实例,对候选人进行排名,并修改答复. 然而相似性并不是独一无二的:词典学,语义学,结构学,和文体学的相似性可以指向不同的候选者,任务相协调的概念可以因情况而变化. 我们采用BASIS(Bayesian Axis Setching by Interactive Signals),这是一种免费培训的Bayesian方法,它使用微弱的测试时间反馈来推断所提供特定任务库中哪个标准制约当前的决定。 它对候选目标和标准保持联合后台,根据分数、对等偏好或核查输出进行更新,并根据预期的信息收益选择探测器。 在一个有限度的噪音模型中,我们描述目标-标准对何时是可被恢复的,并表明为什么固定-标准与固定-混合规则在标准转移下会失败. 在概念恢复、推理实例选择和反应改进方面,BASIS改进了六概率概念恢复成功@1,从56.0%到68.1%,推理精度从72.3%到73.1%,精度从61.4%到63.8%超过调取的静态混合物。 它也超过了推理(72.1%)和精细(61.2%)方面计算出的N类最佳选择。 在标准不匹配的情况下,增益最大,而且候选人才库较大,相匹配的控制措施表明,适应性标准加权可以解释许多好处,联合目标标准推论可以增加进一步的价值。 BASIS只在提供的标准中选择,没有发现新的标准.

articles.title: Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?
articles.content: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预训教学化学语言模型化学吗?.
articles.content_zh: 化学语言模型(CLMs)被预先训练于分子的大型子体上,目的是学习向多种下游任务转移的表达. 在这里,我们系统研究了使用一系列这类CLM在64个分子属性预测数据集中进行预训的效果. 我们发现,人工智能预训的下游收益在梯度-起动基线下没有规模和性能饱和度。 在整个被评价制度中,只有受监督的传统物理化学说明书的预训才能不断提高所测试的CLM的下游性能,而某些形式的预训则导致模型比随机初始编码器更糟糕。 虽然模型可以很好地解决分子结构,但是它们做的并不比随机初始化模型更好,说明CLMs除了在预训期间学习低等符号统计之外,最多还能学习像描述器一样的特性,但除了古典分子特征已经捕捉到的化学特征之外,令人惊讶的是几乎没有什么化学特征.

articles.title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
articles.content: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对齐或不对齐:在您列车前检查您的COMPAS
articles.content_zh: 结合预先训练过的模型是构建AI系统的共同战略,无论是通过将视觉编码器与语言模型相配合还是合并微调的检查站. 然而,寻找相容配对通常需要昂贵的经验性搜索,因为相容性只有在对齐或合并后才能被知道. 我们提出COMPASS(COMPatibility Assessment Score),这是一种理论上有动机的诊断,在对齐或合并之前估计一对模型是否相容. 基于代表式趋同在当地街区一级最强的观察,COMPASS将模型相容性分解为两个廉价相通轴:一对特异性易取,被定义为两个编码器之间的$k$-NN相接;一是范式级上限,捕捉出它们的培训范式允许的最大相接性. 这两个轴共同提供了候选模式对等的排名,并规定了如何对每对模式采取行动: (一)对已经同意且其范式相容的对等进行优先排序; (二)对具有相容范式但初始协议较低的对等进行额外计算; (三)在无法支持足够协议时切换预训范式; (四)对在两轴上得分不佳的对等进行优先排序. 我们把COMPAS应用于72美元跨模式对接试验和392美元任务-算术模型的合并,并表明COMPAS的相容性估计与下游的成功密切相关,在跨模式对接任务方面实现了平均Pearson的0.91美元和在模型合并方面达到了0.70美元。

articles.title: Breakdown of Conversational Involvement: A Joint Multi-Modal Analysis of Conversation Floors and F-formation Detection with Multiple Features
articles.content: Interactions happen universally and spontaneously in daily lives. Studying involvement in interactions helps us analyze who can influence who and has a wide potential in applications. Specifically, we consider conversational involvement in free-standing conversations. We study two operationalizations of an FCG: F-formations and conversation floors, and propose that current assumption that F-formations capture single conversations is insufficient. To illustrate how different implementations could impact the detected F-formations, we employ three analyses. First, we propose that speaking status can be used for estimating conversation floors, and leveraged it to analyze floors within F-formations. Second, we analyze spatial characteristics of the detection results by applying different feature sets on chosen baselines, and find that groups resulting from head features are more likely to be subsumed by groups detected using other features. Finally, we do a joint analysis which combines the spatial features and floor patterns in the conversation. We observe that certain pipelines can detect groups with single floors from upper body features, while retaining F-formations with lower body features. We conclude that a more detailed theory and framework is needed to holistically demonstrate conversational involvement within interactions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对话分类 参与:对对话底座和有多种特征的F-构型检测进行多模式联合分析
articles.content_zh: 互动在日常生活中普遍和自发地发生。 研究参与互动有助于我们分析谁能够影响谁,在应用方面具有广泛潜力。 具体而言,我们考虑在对话中参与独立对话。 我们研究了两个FCG的运作: F-forms和对话地层,并提议目前F-forms捕捉单声道的假设是不够的. 为了说明不同的实施会如何影响检测出的F-成型,我们采用了三种分析。 首先,我们提议,发言状态可用于估计对话层,并利用它来分析F-forms中的地板。 第二,我们通过在选定的基线上应用不同的特征集来分析检测结果的空间特征,并发现由头部特征所形成的组更有可能被使用其他特征被检测到的组所包含. 最后,我们做了一个联合分析,把对话中的空间特征和地层模式结合起来。 我们观察到,某些管线可以从上体特征中检测出单层的组,同时保留下体特征的F-形. 我们的结论是,需要有一个更详尽的理论和框架,以全面显示互动中的对话参与。

articles.title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
articles.content: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 知识图作为文件:工具创建和工具使用共同演变的代理工具
articles.content_zh: 搜索富于文字的知识的图表需要遵循关系,同时审查文字证据. 被预先定义的图界面制约了证据代理能够访问的东西,即使他们写出代码来结合工具调用或处理被检索子图. 我们提出直接的知识图交互(DKGI),一种语言模型代理在完全节点和边缘文件上直接创建图访问工具的杠杆. 代理者会写出Python代码来跟踪关系,结合节点设置,并选择文字证据,将执行与 shell 搜索和文件检查相衔接. 这样可以让代理在返回选定文本供模型评估的同时大量处理大型节点设置. 执行反馈指导工具的创建和修订,而不断演变的工具则决定代理人接下来收集哪些证据. 在横跨三个领域的基准数据集上,无培训的DKGI在每个图表上至少比最强的公布基线多出6.7 Hit@1分,即使使用最小的吊带. 被控制的活化显示多回合编程对仅壳访问和预定义的图形工具的好处,而轨迹显示代理修改代码以扩展搜索或解决出错. 这些发现突出了允许工具创建和工具使用在图搜索过程中共同演变的价值. 我们的代码和数据可查阅https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI。

articles.title: Does self-distillation improve reasoning?
articles.content: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自我消化会改善推理吗?
articles.content_zh: 自我消化是一种新兴的方法,它训练一种模型在以特权信息为条件时模仿自己的预测,如正确的答案或环境反馈. 与强化学习(RL)相比,最近的方法报告样本效率和通用性更好,但目前还不清楚这些收益是否超出分配评价的范围,以及这些收益是否来自特权分馏。 在本文中,我们重新审视了两种代表性方法,即自我分裂政策优化(SDPO)和On-Policy自我分裂(OPSD),跨越代码,科学,工具使用和数学推理任务. 我们发现,他们所报告的进展并没有始终被概括到看不见的问题,在很大程度上是由于过度调整或转移了现有的推理行为,而不是有效地利用特权信息。 此外,自我消化梯度显示与直接优化预期回报的政策梯度的配合薄弱,质疑梯度是否为改进政策提供了有效方向。 我们跨越Qune3模型(1.7B-14B)和OLMo-3-7B的实验表明,有效利用特权信息改进推理仍然是一个公开的挑战。 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/sleepypandu/ does-sd-improve-reasoning。

articles.title: Legal-R1: Agentic Retrieval for Evidence-Based Legal Reasoning
articles.content: Legal question answering requires answers that are not only plausible, but also grounded in legally valid and citable evidence. Standard retrieval-augmented generation often relies on one-shot semantic matching, which is insufficient when legal evidence must be selected according to authority, applicability, and diversity across heterogeneous sources. We introduce Legal-R1, an agentic retrieval framework for evidence-based legal reasoning. Legal-R1 decomposes legal reasoning into a multi-agent workflow, where a Lawyer agent learns when to retrieve, which legal source to query, what evidence to seek, and when the collected evidence is sufficient. A Legal Assistant agent retrieves from normative legal sources and precedent cases with authority-aware and diversity-aware selection, while a Judge agent generates the final answer from the complete evidence trajectory. We post-train only the Lawyer agent with masked supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-aware reinforcement learning. Experiments on multiple Chinese legal benchmarks show that Legal-R1 improves over general-purpose, legal-specific, and retrieval-augmented baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法律-R1:基于证据的法律依据代理检索
articles.content_zh: 回答法律问题不仅需要合理的答案,而且需要以法律上有效和可援引的证据为依据。 标准的取回增强的生成往往依赖于一发相声的语义匹配,这在必须根据权威、适用性和不同来源的多样性选择法律证据时是不够的。 我们引入了Legal-R1,一个基于证据的法律推理的代理检索框架. legal-R1将法律推理分解成一个多代理工作流程,由律师代理学习何时取回,哪一个法律来源可以查询,找什么证据,何时收集的证据足够. 一名法律助理人员从规范性法律来源和先例中取出具有权威意识和多样性意识的案件,而一名法官人员则从完整的证据轨迹中得出最后答案。 我们只培训了律师代理 戴着蒙面监督的微调 和有轨迹意识的强化学习 关于中国多项法律基准的实验表明,Legal-R1比通用性、法律针对性和检索性基线有所改进。

articles.title: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models
articles.content: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Jev-Tom:在打入式决定模型中评价思维理论
articles.content_zh: 对话和协作助理反复判断伙伴知道、相信或打算做什么。 所打出的决定模型提供了一种潜在的替代基因大语言模型,用于选择有界限的Mind理论(Tom). 我们介绍了Jev-Tom,比较了六个能力组的9个Tom基准的11,117个英文文本问题上的5个打入式决定模型和7个基因基线。 类型安全 Jev达到了73.2%的源平衡精确度,包括本土控制,在所有六种能力中排名第一或第二,主要信仰、目标/期望/意图和情感。 其他打字模型显示出不同任务的不同优势。 单独的资源比较表明,Jev可以减少重复的Tom选择的成本和等待时间. 基于信心的选择仍然依赖于基准,提供的理由可以修复错误或推翻正确答案,视其附件而定. 候选人的扩充显示出明显的甄选和产出有效性问题。 相关问题提示占了Jev下游的大部分收益,其任务依赖效应来自预测状态. 这些结果促使将Jev作为助理的Tom选择部分进行测试,将特定任务的信心校准、候选人设计和产出验证作为整合的优先事项。

articles.title: Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
articles.content: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Answer voice: LLM的精细校正 通过图表对齐各样本线索进行解释
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地处理需要多步骤推理的任务,中间索赔的错误可能影响最终答案。 自我一致性(SC)通过对所抽取的最后答案进行投票来改进推理,但其表决留下了中间分歧未解决. 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了DDRG(由理性图指导的DDreaty-Driven核查),这是一个从被冻结的推理痕迹库中进行选择性纠正的框架。 我们的洞察力是,图表统一可以揭露索赔层次的分歧,并提供纠正证据,而不扩大抽样的追踪库。 DDRG构建了基于源代码的诉求图,并向一个解答-盲验证器发送了局部冲突. 达到多数答案的支持路径的核查者支持的反驳触发了一次有重点的修复;否则DDRG返回准确的SC投票. 5个基准的实验结果显示,原生零发DDRG比直接应答提高了8.65分和15.83分,分别是Qune2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B. 它也超过了COT, 被评价的GOT和GOV的问答适应,以及SC在这个宏观度量. DDRG 在不扩大初始候选银行的情况下,将本地验证与选择性更正联系起来。

articles.title: From Hindsight to Foresight: Dissecting Clinical Evidence Acquisition in Large Language Models
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) often diagnose full sight, static clinical cases well yet struggle in foresight, dynamic diagnosis. Prior work has improved this limitation by quantifying the information models acquire and by developing stronger follow-up strategies to improve diagnostic accuracy. In contrast, we introduce a distinctive hindsight to systematically dissect why LLMs fail to acquire diagnostically critical evidence, tracing the failure from evidence identification, utilization and downstream diagnostic updating through not only diagnostic accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, and elicited probability and information entropy. Starting experiments from the breakdown at the level of capabilities, to the diagnosis of the pre-event state before the evidence arrives, and to the post-event state transition after the evidence arrives, our research has revealed the profound limitations and internal causes existing in the dynamic diagnostic process. At the same time, we have also conducted sufficient verification and generalization experiments to prove that these limitations are widespread. Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从"后视"到"前视":以"大语言模型"进行临床证据分解获取.
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)经常诊断出全视,静态临床病例很好,但在前瞻,动态诊断中却挣扎. 先前的工作通过量化所获得的信息模型并制订更强有力的后续战略来提高诊断准确性,从而改进了这一局限性。 相比之下,我们引入了一种独特的后视力,系统地解析LLMS为何未能获得诊断性的关键证据,通过不仅诊断准确性,而且证据覆盖面,轨迹动态,以及引出概率和信息等手段追踪证据识别、利用和下游诊断更新的失败。 从能力水平的分解开始实验,到证据到来之前对事前状态的诊断,再到证据到来之后的事后状态过渡,我们的研究揭示了动态诊断过程中存在的深刻局限性和内在原因. 同时,我们还进行了充分的核查和概括试验,以证明这些限制是普遍的。 这些结论共同将中心挑战从LLMS是否拥有相关的临床知识转移到它们是否能够识别,获取并有效利用临床诊断中正确的证据,并进行更详尽的机制分析,以确定能力差距的确切位置.

articles.title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20\%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in $3$ of $7$ (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average $98\%$ of its score across the other four.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 反思多式有限责任管理课程的投影员培训
articles.content_zh: 多式联运有限责任公司通常首先通过大型图像封装数据集的投影器培训,将视觉编码器与语言模型相统一,然后对完整的多式联运模型进行联合培训。 尽管它被广泛使用,但投影器培训阶段的作用仍然没有得到很好的了解. 我们发现:(一) 仅使用10至20美元的数据来培训投影仪已经恢复了大部分下游的性能收益,(二) 接受过不同数据集培训的出影仪可以线性地插入,同时基本上保持性能. 这些结果表明,投影仪培训主要进行粗细的对接,许多不同的投影仪同样取得了良好的成绩. 基于这些调查结果,我们提议PORTAL,一种无培训投影器初始化,既不要求成对的图像封装数据,也不要求以梯度为基础的优化,而只要求每个模式的汇总统计。 Portal在共享主子空间上计算视野和语言特征分布的高斯近似值之间的最优化的基于交通的地图,从而可以完全跳出投影器训练阶段. 在没有任何对接数据的情况下,PORTAL匹配了在558k图像封装对上培训的标准管线,跨越了6个LLM主干线,两个视觉编码器,以及16个基准. 它的绩效超过了以7美元(视觉编码器、LLM)设置的3美元铺设,在其他四个国家平均达到98美元。

articles.title: Decomposing and Predicting Annotation Disagreement in Harmful Content Across Languages
articles.content: Annotator disagreement is increasingly recognized as a meaningful property of subjective tasks, rather than merely noise to be removed. Predicting which items are likely to be contested could help allocate annotation effort and route difficult cases to human review. We propose predicting disagreement from interpretable semantic properties of the text. An LLM answers a set of binary questions covering harmful-content characteristics, disagreement-related cues such as borderline severity and missing context, and language-sensitive cues such as local slurs. A classifier predicts disagreement from these answers, and we analyze which questions contribute most to the predictions. Across four datasets in English, German, and Turkish and three open-weight LLMs, our structured question features outperform direct prompting by 10.5 ROC-AUC points and the strongest text-based baselines by 5.0 points. A compact subset of eight questions performs within 1.5 ROC-AUC points of the full twenty-question set. In leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, models retain roughly 90-95% of their in-domain ROC-AUC. Across models and datasets, questions about derogation, missing context, and decision boundaries serve as the strongest predictors, suggesting that what makes harmful content contested is partly observable in the text.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 各种语文有害内容的不一致之处
articles.content_zh: 公证人的分歧日益被公认为是主观任务的有意义的财产,而不仅仅是要去除的噪音. 预测哪些项目可能会引起争议,有助于作出说明,并将困难案件交由人审查。 我们提议预测对案文可解释的语义特性的分歧。 LLM解答了一组二进制问题,包括有害内容特性,与分歧相关的提示如边框严重性和缺失上下文等,以及语言敏感的提示如本地 sluers等. 一个分类者预测出与这些答案的分歧,我们分析哪些问题最有助于预测。 在英文、德文和土耳其文的4个数据集和3个可开放重量的LLMs中,我们的结构化问题特征直接超过10.5个ROC-AUC点,最强的文本基线超过5.0点。 由8个问题组成的紧凑子集在整组20个问题中的1.5个ROC-AUC点内进行。 在 " 一个数据集 " 评估中,模型保留了大约90-95%的域内ROC-AUC。 在各种模型和数据集中,关于减损、缺失上下文和决定界限的问题充当了最强的预测者,这表明在文本中可以部分地看到哪些内容引起对有害内容的争议。

articles.title: The Many Morals of AI: The cautionary bias of North American news narratives in global perspective
articles.content: The stories told about artificial intelligence (AI) play a central role in shaping public understanding, policy debates, and expectations about technological change. News media are especially influential in this process. Using a cross-regional corpus of 12,924 English-language news articles about AI published since 2022, we examine how storytelling about AI varies across media systems in four regions: North America, China, India, and the Middle East. Leveraging large language models, we extract the implicit narrative lessons conveyed by each article---commonly known as story morals---capturing value-laden interpretations that extend beyond thematic content or sentiment. We find that North American AI coverage is uniquely characterized by narratives of caution, while under-emphasizing narratives of innovation and collaboration that are more prevalent elsewhere. However, this pattern is largely explained by a broader regional negativity bias in North American news sentiment, rather than by heightened concern about AI itself. Our findings bring into view the culturally conditioned nature of AI news narratives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大赦国际的许多道德观:从全球角度看北美新闻叙事的警告性偏见
articles.content_zh: 关于人工智能(AI)的故事在塑造公众对技术变革的理解、政策辩论和期望方面发挥了中心作用。 新闻媒体在这一过程中尤其有影响力. 我们利用自2022年以来发表的12,924篇有关AI的英文新闻跨区域文集,审视了北美、中国、印度和中东等四个地区媒体系统对AI的报道有何不同。 利用大型语言模式,我们提取每一篇文章所传达的隐含的叙事教训 -- -- 通称为故事道德 -- -- 抓住价值 -- -- 超越主题内容或情感的解释。 我们发现,北美AI报道的独特特征是谨慎的叙述,而忽视了其他地方更为普遍的创新和合作的叙述。 然而,这种模式主要由北美新闻情绪中更广泛的区域消极倾向来解释,而不是由对AI本身的高度关注来解释. 我们的调查结果反映了AI新闻叙事在文化上受到制约的性质。

articles.title: CREATE: Creativity Evaluation of VLMs using the Visual Remote Associates Test
articles.content: Vision language models (VLMs) are used in creative tasks such as visual storytelling, design ideation, art interpretation, and advertising. Yet we lack principled ways to measure the lateral reasoning of these models compared to human potential. We introduce CREATE, a semi-automatically constructed benchmark containing 155 visual Remote Associates Test problems. These problems require a solver to find an underlying connection among three seemingly dissimilar images. We conduct a human study (N=25) to validate and ground the quality of our benchmark, and evaluate 11 VLMs. Our findings show that most VLMs underperform humans on this task. Our experiments indicate that the associative ability of VLMs depends on the cue concepts provided in the text and does not universally extend to visual puzzles.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CREATE:利用视觉远程关联测试对VLM进行创造性评价
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)被用在视觉故事讲述,设计创意,艺术诠释,广告等创造性任务上. 然而,我们缺乏衡量这些模式相对于人类潜力的横向推理的原则性方法。 我们引入了CREATE,一个半自动构建的基准,包含155个视觉远程关联测试问题. 这些问题需要一个解决者在三种看似相异的图像中找到一个根本的联系. 我们进行一项人类研究(N=25),以验证和确定我们的基准质量,并评估11个自愿最低水平。 我们的研究结果表明,大多数VLM在这项任务中表现不佳。 我们的实验表明,VLMs的关联能力取决于文本中提供的提示概念,并不普遍延伸到视觉谜题.

articles.title: Empathy Is Not the Scapegoat for Declines in Factuality and Reliability
articles.content: Language models are increasingly expected to support users in stressful or uncertain situations, where warmth and empathy are desirable. While recent work associates warmer models with reduced reliability, we show that this conclusion is incomplete. Prior studies often train primarily on empathetic dialogue, making it difficult to separate tone effects from SFT-induced distribution shift. We revisit this issue at both the model and evaluation levels. We study prompting, SFT, and RL for inducing warm behavior, and comprehensively evaluate capability preservation using an 11-dataset benchmark suite and EMOFACT under emotional contexts. Across multiple model families, we find that warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, while task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, although some capability trade-offs remain. We further introduce human-validated empathy evaluators specifically developed to assess empathetic model responses. Our results suggest that models can be more supportive in social interactions while remaining reliable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 失真和可靠性下降的隐患
articles.content_zh: 人们越来越期望语言模型在需要温暖和同情的紧张或不确定情况下支持用户。 虽然最近的工作将更温暖的模型与可靠性降低联系起来,但我们表明这一结论不完整。 之前的研究往往主要对情感对话进行训练,因此很难将音调效应与SFT引发的分布变化区分开来. 我们从模式和评价两个层面重新审视这一问题。 我们研究诱导、SFT和RL, 并使用11个数据集的基准套件和情感背景下的EMOFACT来全面评估能力保护。 在多个模范家庭中,我们发现温和效应是任务和模型的依赖性,而任务相适应的适应语气可以提高同情心和针对性的可靠性,尽管仍然有一些能力取舍。 我们进一步引进了经人验证的同情评价员,专门用来评估同情模型的反应。 我们的结果表明,模式在社会互动方面可以更加支持,同时保持可靠。

articles.title: How Reliable Are System-One Decisions in Medicine? A Comparative Study of Jev, Jev-like Models, and LLMs
articles.content: Jev has attracted considerable attention for its rapid, generalizable decision-making, yet its medical reliability remains under explored. To address this gap, our study compares various types of system-one decision models across 15 medical datasets comprising 8,742 instances under a unified protocol. Beyond accuracy, we assess decision stability and the ability to recognize unreliable decisions. Our results show that Jev rivals leading models on primarily text-driven tasks but is less effective on numerically driven tasks, revealing a distinct capability boundary. Under question-format variations, Jev demonstrates strong robustness, achieving the lowest decision reversal rate and relatively small accuracy fluctuations. Among evaluated open-source alternatives, only StartLux exhibits comparable robustness. But these strengths do not extend to reliable abstention awareness: most evaluated models show limitations in both recognizing missing correct answers and using optional abstention. Moreover, we find that Jev's probability-based answer selection can be improved by changing how decisions are scored: normalizing option-wise binary scores yields higher retained accuracy than choice scoring. Taken together, our findings provide early guidance for improving and applying decision models in medicine.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个系统在医学上的决定有多可靠? Jev、类似Jev的模型和LLMs的比较研究
articles.content_zh: Jev因其快速而笼统的决策而吸引了相当大的关注,但其医疗可靠性仍在被探索之中. 为了弥补这一差距,我们的研究比较了15个医疗数据集的各类系统一个决定模型,这些数据集由统一协议下的8,742个病例组成。 除了准确性外,我们还评估决策稳定性和识别不可靠决定的能力。 我们的结果表明,Jev主要在文本驱动的任务上与领先模式相竞争,但在数字驱动的任务上则不那么有效,揭示出一个独特的能力界限。 在问题格式变化中,Jev表现出强烈的稳健性,实现了最低的决定倒转率和相对较小的准确性波动. 在经过评价的开源替代品中,只有StartLux表现出相仿的稳健性. 但这些优势并没有延伸到可靠的弃权意识:大多数被评价的模型在识别缺失的正确答案和使用可选弃权时都显示出局限性. 此外,我们发现Jev基于概率的答案选择可以通过改变决定的得分方式来改进: 将选项明智的二进制分数正常化后,保留精度比选择分数高. 总之,我们的调查结果为改进和应用医学决策模式提供了早期指导。

articles.title: Retrieval Disagreement as a Signal: Diagnosing and Steering Multilingual Dense Embedders
articles.content: Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 检索分歧作为信号:诊断和指导多种语言的ense嵌入器
articles.content_zh: 多语种稠密检索器将所有语言放在一个共享的空间中,这样一个问题就能找到相关的文档,不管它们用哪种语言写出. 我们显示,用不同语言问到的同一问题检索到的文档大相径庭,这种分歧并非因为语言理解薄弱. 每种语言本身都表现良好,候选人的排名与其他语言一致;只有在语言共用索引时才会出现分歧。 我们追踪这个机制:每种语言都保持自己的排名,但在共享索引中,它的正确答案被推得非常低,被埋入不相关的文档中,这些文档要么是查询自己的语言,要么是英语,取决于模型. 我们引入了分歧指导:对于每种语言,我们把其他语言就一个问题所商定的文件与那些从语言中回溯到通常情况的文件作对比,并将它们表述的不同作为语言特定方向,加上该语言推论中的疑问。 对照语言-正值删除、子空间删除和每个语言旋转的基线,它最能减少同一种语言的拥挤,同时在召回问题上保持竞争力,与平均删除进行交换,这更好地保持了排名质量。

articles.title: The Geometry of Language Model Logits: Generic Structure and Learned Departures
articles.content:
Autoregressive language models produce, at every prediction step, a vocabulary-sized logit vector whose structure determines the conditional next-token distribution. We empirically identify that the ordered vocabulary-head logits follow a remarkably consistent log-linear relation
  \[ z_{(r)} \approx μ- α\log r. \] across prediction contexts, architectures, and scales, emerging progressively during pretraining. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of the logit geometry underlying the distributional assumptions used in the prior decoding work. While controlled order-statistic baselines spanning bounded, light-tailed, and heavier-tailed distributions can largely explain the observed log-linear geometry, they do not explain the systematic shift in the slope $α$: trained language models exhibit $α\approx 1.4$--$1.7$, sitting well above the initialization baseline ($α\approx 0.2$) . Moreover, $α$ correlates with predictive performance, suggesting that it captures learned structure beyond generic extreme-value effects.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型逻辑的几何:通用结构与学习的出发
articles.content_zh:
自动递归语言模型在每一个预测步骤上都会产生一个词汇大小的对数向量,其结构决定了有条件的相邻分布. 我们经验性地发现,命令的词汇头日志遵循了非常一致的日志线性关系
\[z_{(r)]\相近 μ- α\log r.\] 跨越预测背景,结构和尺度,在预训期间逐渐出现. 据我们所知,这是对先前解码工作所使用的分配假设所依据的对数几何进行的第一次系统分析。 虽然控制有序的统计基线跨越界限、轻尾和较重的尾部分布大致可以解释所观察到的对数线几何,但它们不能解释坡度的系统变化:训练有素的语言模型显示大约为1.4-1.7美元,远远高于初始化基线(约0.2美元)。 此外,美元与预测性能有关,表明它捕捉到超出一般极端价值效应的学习出的结构。

articles.title: Imprinting: Knowledge Distillation Can Shift Student Behavior
articles.content: Knowledge distillation trains student models on teacher-generated responses to transfer task capability, but those responses may also carry behavioral tendencies of their source. We investigate whether the source teacher can shape student behavior beyond the capability that distillation is intended to transfer. We construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same base teacher, use them to generate responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions unrelated to safety, and distill those responses into students with different base models. Students generally acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher's safety-pragmatism disposition, a phenomenon we call imprinting. Distillation from the harm-accepting teacher reduces harm avoidance, whereas distillation from the harm-avoiding teacher increases it. Imprinting varies across teacher-student pairs and does not extend uniformly across different forms of safety behavior. Excluding a sparse set of divergence tokens reduces imprinting, whereas response rewriting preserves the source-dependent effect and can introduce additional rewriter-dependent shifts. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference. These results show that behavioral tendencies can be intentionally imprinted through the source teacher, even with ordinary task supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Imprinting:知识分解可以改变学生的行为
articles.content_zh: 知识分解对学生模型进行关于教师生成的对转移任务能力的反应的培训,但这些反应也可能带有其来源的行为倾向. 我们调查源头老师是否能够 塑造学生的行为 超越蒸馏 打算转移的能力。 我们构建同一个基础教师的伤害接受和伤害避免变体,利用这些变体生成对普通推理和知识问题的答复,而这些问题与安全无关,并将这些反应提炼成具有不同基础模式的学生。 学生一般会获得任务能力, 而他们的下游决定 转向源头教师的安全pragmatism的处置, 我们称之为印记现象。 从接受伤害的教师身上蒸馏会减少避免伤害,而避免伤害的教师身上蒸馏会增加伤害。 印相因师生对相而异,不统一地延伸至不同形式的安全行为. 排除一串稀少的相差符号会减少印记,而反应重写则保留了依赖源的效果并可以引入额外的依赖重写的相差分. 消化后优先优化可避免损害,但不能消除依赖源的差异。 这些结果表明,行为倾向可以通过源师有意地被刻入,即使是普通的任务监督.

articles.title: The Last Mile of Coding Agents for Long-Document Tasks: An Empirical Study on Clinical Trial Protocol Digitization
articles.content: Clinical trial protocols serve as the source of truth for study design, but are mostly written and used as unstructured PDF documents. Digitizing protocols turns static content into structured, machine-readable data that clinical software can analyze, validate, and execute. Coding agents, which select tools, execute code, and revise their approach as they work, are increasingly applied to such long-document tasks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they turn complete documents into accurate structured outputs. We study this question using protocol digitization as a testbed. We introduce TrialPD-Bench, an expert-annotated benchmark of 150 publicly available protocol PDFs spanning four task categories. Beyond final-answer performance, our evaluation measures evidence recall from agent traces, agent behavior, and cost. Across nine proprietary and open-weight models in five coding-agent harnesses, even the strongest agents do not fully solve protocol digitization. Our analysis further shows that agents usually locate the required evidence but fail in the last mile of transcribing and structuring it. We further develop TrialScribe, a domain-specific harness that equips coding agents with task skills and a verification loop. TrialScribe improves a locally served open-weight model by 6.2-59.4 points across eight metrics, enabling it to match or surpass proprietary models such as GPT-5.6-Sol.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 长文件的最后一英里编码代理 任务:临床试验协议的实证研究
articles.content_zh: 临床试验协议作为研究设计的真理来源,但大多是被写作并用作无结构的PDF文件. 数字化协议将静态内容转化为结构化的可机器读取的数据,临床软件可以分析,验证和执行. 选择工具、执行代码和在工作过程中修改方法的编码代理越来越多地应用于这种长文件任务,但目前仍不清楚它们如何可靠地将完整的文件转化为准确的结构化产出。 我们用协议数字化来研究这个问题。 我们引入了TrialPD-Bench,这是一个由150个公开协议PDF组成的专家说明的基准,涵盖四个任务类别。 除了最后的回答,我们的评估 衡量证据 从代理追踪,代理行为和成本。 在5个编码代理机的9个专有和开放量级模型中,即使是最强的代理机也无法完全解决协议数字化问题. 我们的分析进一步表明,特工通常会找到所需的证据,但在转录和结构的最后一英里中失败了。 我们进一步发展了TrimeScribe,这是一种针对特定域的用具,它使编码人员具备任务技能和核查循环。 TrialScribe改进了本地服务的开放量级模型,在8个度量衡上积分为6.2-59.4分,使其能够匹配或超越GPT-5.6-Sol等专有模型.

articles.title: Aligning Faithfulness for Theory-Scale Autoformalization
articles.content: Autoformalization (AF) requires more than compilation: formal statements must preserve the meaning of their informal sources, a property known as faithfulness. An emerging frontier is the automated evaluation of this property, yet most existing methods operate at the statement level and produce whole-item verdicts, failing to reveal how individual expressions correspond or which contextual interpretations support the judgment. This omission is consequential because AF is inherently theory-scale: target statements derive their meaning from surrounding mathematical material and unstated conventions. We formulate faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem: identifying phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements and assigning a faithfulness label to each under explicitly specified contextual interpretations and assumptions. We also introduce FaithAlign, the first theory-scale faithfulness benchmark comprising 460 items and 4,982 annotated phrase-level links, alongside FaithAlign-Gap, a companion set of 146 items with informal context and assumptions withheld. Each FaithAlign item includes the target statement pair, relevant context, formal dependencies, and, where needed, assumptions specifying one given interpretation. Across 8 models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest defect F1 at 47.8% and identifies all defects in only 4.5% of items with two or more defects. On FaithAlign-Gap, Astra identifies only 28.2% of undecidable items as such. These results show the difficulty of recovering context-dependent correspondences, establishing FaithAlign as a testbed for fine-grained, context-aware faithfulness evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 调整对理论-规模自动化的信念
articles.content_zh: 自动形式化(AF)不仅仅需要汇编:正式声明必须保留其非正式来源的含义,这种财产被称为忠诚. 一个新出现的前沿是对这种属性进行自动评估,然而,大多数现有方法都在语句层面运作并产生整个项目的判决,未能揭示个人表达方式如何对应或哪些背景解释支持判断。 这种省略是必然的,因为AF是内在的理论尺度:目标声明从周围的数学材料和未声明的公约中得出其意义. 我们将忠实评价作为了解背景的校正和标签问题:确定非正式声明和正式声明之间的短语级对应关系,并在明确规定的背景解释和假设下为每一项声明指定忠实标签。 我们还介绍了FaithAlign,这是第一个理论规模的忠诚度基准,包括460个项目和4 982个附加说明的短语级链接,以及FaithAlign-Gap,这是一套由146个项目组成的配套组合,不附带非正式上下文和假设。 每个FaithAlign项目包括目标语句配对,相关上下文,形式依赖性,以及必要时指定一个给定解释的假设. 在8个模型中,GPT-6 Astra以47.8%的成绩实现了最高的缺陷F1,并在只有4.5%的有2个或2个以上缺陷的物品中识别出所有缺陷. 在FaithAlign-Gap上,Astra只识别出28.2%的不可识别项目是这样. 这些结果表明,很难恢复依赖上下文的函证,将FaithAlign确立为精细而了解上下文的忠诚评价的测试床.

articles.title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
articles.content: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法官遵循参考文献:验证工具呼叫参数的衍生漏洞
articles.content_zh: 工具调用法官评价LLM代理商提出的论证值. 我们发现,当它们的投入没有提及价值时,即没有说明价值的文本时,它们接受的正确价值较少。 当该值是用户未提及的函数图案的默认值时,当必须推断时,或者当它来自的文本被从判断器输入中切出时,就发生了这种情况. 我们把这种接受率的下降称为衍生差距。 它出现在我们评价的所有七个法官中,包括系统一模型CLM和Jev。 差距不仅仅是一个切换文物:正确的默认值在一个基准上有最大的差距,没有切换. 一个受控的源移位测试显示,法官在输入中遵循了引用:他们倾向于一个可见不正确的值,而不是一个其源被隐藏的正确值. 我们介绍De Ref (Derived Reference):一个单独的模型在不见候选人的情况下读取全部历史,并为法官写出参考. 从三个基准来看, " 参考 " 改进了对所有法官进行测试的AUROC的总体论点。 在受控试验中,它使AUROC从概率或低于98.40至99.59之间.

articles.title: How Safe Is ChatGPT Health Advice? Evidence from Real User Conversations in Four Global South Countries
articles.content: People increasingly bring their health questions to ChatGPT, yet safety evaluations of LLM health advice rest almost entirely on clinician-authored vignettes, synthetic prompts, or simulated user profiles. The gap is widest for the Global South, where concerns about demographic bias and unsafe recommendations are well documented but have never been tested on real usage. We present, to our knowledge, the first demographically grounded safety evaluation of real-world health conversations with ChatGPT. From a consent-based data-donation corpus of 202,590 conversations from 1,252 users in India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan (December 2022 to February 2026), each linked to self-reported age and gender, we identify 15,555 health conversations, classify their health intent using an LLM classifier adapted from an established taxonomy, and score response safety under both a context-blind and a user-context-aware rubric. Roughly one in five health conversations receives a high-risk rating. Risk concentrates in symptom and condition queries and recurs through identifiable failure modes: unsafe medication or dosage guidance, harmful self-diagnosis, missing safety warnings, encouraging over-reliance on the model, and failure to refer users to professionals. Supplying the user's own accumulated context raises the high-risk share by 13-17 percentage points, and about one in four conversations rated safe in isolation turns out to be unsafe for the specific person asking. Safety evaluations built on synthetic cases are likely to miss these harms.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ChatGPT健康咨询如何安全? 四个全球南方国家实际用户对话提供的证据
articles.content_zh: 人们越来越多地将自己的健康问题提交到ChatGPT,然而LLM健康咨询的安全评价几乎完全依赖于临床医生授权的阴道、合成快感或模拟用户简介。 全球南方差距最大,那里对人口偏见和不安全建议的关切有详细记录,但从未经过实际使用测试。 据我们所知,我们对与ChatGPT进行的实际世界卫生对话进行了第一次基于人口的安全评估。 根据来自印度、尼日利亚、巴西和巴基斯坦1 252个用户(2022年12月至2026年2月)的202 590次基于同意的数据捐赠书,每个用户都与自我报告的年龄和性别有关,我们确定15 555次健康对话,使用从既定分类法改编的LLM分类法,将其健康意图分类,并在上下文盲和用户文字意识分数下评分反应安全。 大约五分之一的保健谈话获得高风险评级。 风险集中于症状和病情查询,并通过可识别的故障模式再现:不安全的药物或剂量指导、有害的自我诊断、缺失的安全警告、鼓励过度依赖该模式、以及未能将用户推荐给专业人员。 提供用户自己累积的上下文,将高风险份额提高了13-17个百分点,而且每4个谈话中约有1个被评为隔离安全,结果对具体询问者来说是不安全的. 以合成案例为基础的安全评价很可能错过这些伤害。

articles.title: Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery
articles.content: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 读出放大形状 sparse 特性恢复
articles.content_zh: 读出缩放会改变一个稀疏的自编码器(SAE)学到的东西,但是去除它的好处取决于数据. 我们使用读出 -- -- 名称化的决定空间(RC-DS)坐标去除单值收益,同时保留保留的决定信息。 在固定的读出条件编号下,改变生成的分布倒数,使训练协调最能回收已知因素。 在我们的控制坐标比对研究中,当培训恢复产生因素的空间时,恢复程度最高。 与同一预算下的核心记录培训相比,在读取缩放前产生因素时,RC-DS将第100个条件的稀有因素回收率从0.506增至0.913。 精确的包装器将RC-DS训练复制到数字精度,将训练几何相隔离,而不是附加信息. 在神经政策中,RC-DS改进意味着在经过测试的预算下进行登录重建。 在三个固定语言模式的检查站,驻地协调员发展服务系统在所有18个经过测试的任务分布环境中有更高的无收益重建,而中心记录SAE则在17个中更好地重建产出记录。 小标签头控制显示,较长的培训将重建缺口从0.0198减少到了0.016. 这些结果共同表明,读取规模、数据分布和培训如何形成稀缺的学习。 RC-DS为研究和控制读取的贡献提供了一种信息保存方法. 单独的标签检测和指向测试区分这些重建效果与任务特定特征的有用性.

articles.title: Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints
articles.content: External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher's while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher's probability mass. Extensive experiments on BFCL v4 and API Bank demonstrate that SeTPO achieves superior overall performance over supervised fine tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation baselines across all three student scales.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过双向 KL 限制为小语言模型提供教师指导工具学习
articles.content_zh: 外部工具可以扩展小语言模型(SLM)的能力,使其能够在受资源限制的环境中被部署. 然而,由于能力有限,可持续土地管理很难单独通过强化学习发现有效的工具使用行为,而直接的教师监督则有师生行为分布不匹配的情况并可能传播错误的偏好。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出有选择的教师指导政策优化(SeTPO),协调学生探索与有选择的教师指导和持续的示范监督. 具体地说,SETPO将反向KL派生的符号级教师反馈纳入低奖励轨迹的政策优势,而辅助前行KL监督则保留了教师在整个培训过程中的表现行为. 在理想化的双向KL目标下,我们理论上确定,最佳政策实现的预期奖励不低于教师,同时保留教师概率质量的保证分量. BFCL v4 和 API Bank 的广泛实验表明,SETPO在所有三个学生规模上都取得了优于受监督的微调,强化学习和分馏基线的整体性能.

articles.title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit
articles.content: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 复制不是打地基:具有授权-登场信用的训练忠实长式RAG
articles.content_zh: 在搜索引擎和助手中,长式RAG答案可以误导读者,声称其来源不支持. 忠诚的奖励, 支持的判刑份额, 训练模型 减少这种主张。 我们显示这些奖赏是通过抄袭黑入的. 从段落中抄取的句子几乎得到了构造的支持,因此训练有素的模型学会了抄写而不是将所写的东西地面. 普通防守只移动黑客:一KL或复制罚让复制到位或交易,以缩短,更空洞的答案和拒绝. GRPO,标准RL算法,通过给每个句子以答案的优势,同时强化被复制和被基于的句子,使其更加糟糕. 我们提出授权-常识信用(ASC), 赏罚记分只写出而非抄录的句子,多说出出问题来,得到段落的支持. 优势是将每个句子与每个被抽取的句子相提并论,因此一个没有获得信用排名的句子是最后的,并且从未被强化. 在四个模型和两个域内,三个被搁置的公司,只有ASC降低作者句子的出错率,并在每个设定中写出更多得到支持的句子,在被搁置评价员的中位数下分别上升了38%和46%,为读者提供了更有根据的信息. 它不需要这些快捷键,两个LLM评委比较整个答案都不喜欢基准模型,而是对ASC的答案进行等价评分. 我们的结论是,忠诚的奖励应该归功于一个模型写的东西,而不是它复制的东西。

articles.title: Estimating Surprisal from the Speech Signal
articles.content: Although language is predominantly spoken, empirical tests of surprisal theory rely almost entirely on written text. In practice, surprisal is estimated using language models (LMs) trained on text and applied to transcriptions, creating a text bottleneck that limits evaluation of the theory in the spoken modality. We remove this bottleneck by estimating surprisal directly from the speech signal using a speech LM. This raises a key question: should surprisal be defined over realization-specific acoustic inputs or over abstract linguistic units? Since a single unit can have many distinct acoustic realizations, each assigned a different probability by the model, defining surprisal over abstract units is difficult. To address this, we introduce an importance sampling estimator that approximates the probability of an abstract unit by marginalizing over realizations generated by a text-to-speech model. Using pupillometry data from a listening study, we evaluate surprisal theory in this text-free setting at multiple levels of granularity. Obtaining surprisal from several speech LMs, we consistently find that surprisal estimated via importance sampling better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific surprisal for words. We also find that surprisal values for sub-lexical units are predictive of pupil dilation. While we find that surprisal can be estimated without recourse to text, and that marginalizing over distinct realizations of words is more predictive of lexical processing effort, surprisal as a whole is not a strong predictor of change in pupil size, regardless of its source.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从语音信号中估算溢出值
articles.content_zh: 虽然语言以口语为主,但实验性测试优势理论几乎完全依赖于书面文字. 在实际操作中,超额是使用语言模型(LMs)进行文字培训并被应用于转录,从而形成文本瓶颈,限制了对口语模式中理论的评价. 我们通过使用语音LM从语音信号中直接估算超音速来去除这个瓶颈. 这提出了一个关键问题:是否应当比特定实现的声学投入或抽象的语言单元来定义占优势? 由于单个单元可以有许多不同的相声实现,每个单元被模型分配出不同的概率,所以定义超相比抽象单元是困难的. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一个重要的抽样估计器,它通过将文本对语音模型产生的实现边缘化,从而接近抽象单元的概率。 利用听力研究中的瞳孔测量数据,我们评估了这种无文字设置中多层次颗粒的外观理论. 从几个语言语言语言语言中获取优势,我们始终认为,通过重要性抽样估计的优势比特定实现语言优势更能预测瞳孔扩张。 我们还发现,子读取单位的外观值是预测瞳孔扩张的. 虽然我们发现在不诉诸文字的情况下可以估计超额,而将单词的实现边缘化于不同的实现,则更能预测词汇的处理努力,但超额整体并不是对学生规模变化的强烈预测,无论其来源如何.

articles.title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
articles.content: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 来自不稳定生长的可靠内存:用随机化实验来校正自写代理游戏本
articles.content_zh: 持续的文字记忆让语言-模型代理重新利用过去任务的经验教训来改进未来的多步骤任务而无需再培训. ACE和Dynamic Cheatsheet等系统将其保存为游戏本: 代理员在每次任务后写出的经验教训并及时阅读. 一个关键的挑战是如何决定哪些经验教训可以改进以后的任务。 目前的系统将决定权留给代理商自己,这使得性能不稳定:同样的程序可以写出一个有帮助的游戏本,也可以写出一个低于无玩本下69.6分的游戏本. 这些结论激励人们重视经验教训,因为它们对任务的成功有衡量效果,而不是代理人的判断。 我们提议随机区块校准(RBC),通过随机试验实践任务来衡量这种效果. 它将经验教训分成足以衡量成功与否的分块,在每项实践任务中,任意包括或排除每个分块。 随机的包含使得任务有和没有块可以比较,因此它们成功的缺口估计了块的效果. RBC保留有帮助的区块,由于同一程序可以写出有帮助的或有害的剧本,因此可以长出数个,并服务于在新鲜练习节目中成绩最佳的全能或无能的剧本。 通过两个内存系统,三个模型和三个基准,RBC将平均成功率提高到66.9分,而整个游戏本的成绩为55.5分,没有游戏本的成绩为54.1分,而代理商自己判断的成绩为53.8分.

articles.title: Receiver Decides Agent-to-Agent Negotiations
articles.content: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a $100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决定代理对代理谈判
articles.content_zh: 当一个语言模型代理人向另一个人索要钱时,这两个人中谁决定了多少易手? 我们在15名特工中 进行了1 049次回合比赛 在每场比赛中,一个请求者试图从一个被告知要保留100美元捐赠的持有者那里筹集资金. 了解哪个代理人持有资金,可以解释所转移金额的47%的差异;了解哪个代理人询问,可以解释2%的差异. 放下最极端的毒剂 将分数缩小到22%对4% 将请求者的上诉从一个被点名的人改为一个群体,改变了请求者所写的内容,但在两个框架下转移的数额在统计学上是等同的. 损失最少的持有人是拒绝开放请求的持有人,他们的回合-1拒绝率按总损失排名(Spearman conversation=-0.73)。 培训将这种行为分为两个方向。 对Qune3-8B的说服书进行精细调整,几乎没有拒绝,将它作为持有者捐赠的捐赠从12%提高到84%。 将两个从未失去的持枪者分解为4B学生,其损失从95%降至1%。 对持有资源的代理人进行评价时,应测试其持有者的作用,包括说服后微调.

articles.title: Agaram 2.5B: The First Tamil-First Language Model Trained from Scratch with Tool Calling. A Playbook for Under-Represented Languages
articles.content: We trained Agaram 2.5B, a 2.5-billion-parameter Tamil-English language model, from scratch on about 50 billion tokens (58% Tamil, the rest English, math, code and parallel text) on one node of eight H100 GPUs in about six days, with a new tokenizer that, unlike our first model's, keeps line breaks. Supervised fine-tuning on 134,428 conversations, whose replies an open-weight teacher model wrote, and three short targeted rounds turned it into a chat model that answers in Tamil script, romanized Tamil (Tanglish) and English and can call tools: on 25 tool prompts whose schemas appear in training it picks the right tool 23 times and gives exactly the expected arguments 13 times. The released model translates better than Sarvam-1, a 2B Indic base model, in all six FLORES and IN22 directions (FLORES chrF 54.3 into Tamil and 55.2 into English, against 49.2 and 44.2), and nearly doubles its base model on native-Tamil IndicIFEval (19.3% from 10.0%). It is weak on knowledge: reading-comprehension and knowledge benchmarks sit near chance, and on 50 held-out everyday questions written by one native speaker, one LLM judge rated 46% of its replies usable (22-24 of 50 over three passes; 95% interval for 23 of 50, 33-60%), with nearly every failure a wrong fact. Our two further SFT experiments changed answer format but not the knowledge measures. We also describe our first model, Agaram 1.5B, whose failures shaped the choices here; how the judge's scores varied between passes on identical replies; and, item by item, what the targeted rounds trained against and where frontier-model text entered the data. The project ran on compute credits and our own funds, about USD 13,300 across both models; the weights are released (licence to be announced after legal review), with GGUF files for llama.cpp, at https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct; code at https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b

articles.title_zh: Agaram 2.5B:第一泰米尔-第一语言模式从Scratch上用工具调用训练. 代表不足语言的游戏本
articles.content_zh: 我们训练了Agaram 2.5B, 一个25亿参数的泰米尔-英语语言模型, 从头到尾的大约500亿个信使(58%泰米尔, 其余的英语,数学,代码和平行文本), 在大约6天的时间里, 监督134,428个对话的微调,这些对话的回答是开放式的教师模型所写的,三个简短的定向回合将它变成了一个聊天模式,用泰米尔文、罗马化的泰米尔文(英语)和英文回答,并且可以调用工具:在25个工具提示上,其计划出现在培训中,它选择了正确的工具23次,并给出了13次预期的论据。 发布模型比Sarvam-1,一个2B Indic基准模型翻译得更好,在所有六个FLORES和IN22方向(FLORES chrF 54.3为泰米尔语,55.2为英语,对49.2和44.2),几乎是本土-Tamil Indicaleval基准模型的两倍(19.3%为10.0%)。 在知识方面它很薄弱:阅读-理解和知识基准几乎是偶然的,在一位讲母语的人每天写的50个被搁置的问题上,一位LLM法官将46%的答复评为可用(50分之三的22-24分;23分之33-60%的间隔为95%),几乎每一次失败都是错误的事实。 我们的另外两个SFT实验改变了答案格式,但并没有改变知识措施。 我们还描述了我们的第一个模型Agaram 1.5B, 其失败决定了这里的选择; 法官的得分如何在相同答复上出现差异; 以及逐个项目, 所训练的定向子弹, 以及边界模型文本输入数据的地方。 该项目使用计算入计量和我们自己的资金,大约13,300美元。 两种模型的权重(许可证在法律审查后公布)公布,GGUF文件为lama.cpp,见https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct;代码见https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b。

articles.title: Do Factuality Methods Make LLMs More Factual? Reproducibility and Fair Comparison
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 做事实 方法让LLMs更真实? 可复制性和公平比较
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在经过了预训和受监督的微调步骤后,与人类偏好相适应. 然而,RLHF等标准RL校正步骤并不注重LLMs的事实性,因此它们可能产生非事实性信息,这可能导致出乎意料的后果. 作为回应,文献中提出了若干事实一致性方法,声称根据自己的基准提高有限责任公司的事实质量。 然而,这些方法并非是独立复制的,也不具有可比性,因为每种方法都使用不同的基准模型、培训数据、评价集、法官和衡量标准。 在本文件中,我们首次独立复制了五种实际质量调整方法,这些方法跨越政策上的RL(PPO、GRPO和Dr.~GRPO)和离线偏好优化(DPO和KTO),并以共同基准与共同评价指标进行比较。 我们发现,没有一种方法能完全复制,在共同基准上,没有一种方法能大大超过基准模型。 在进行更仔细的检查时,对格式、长度或简短的奖励是最佳的,而不是对事实和相关性的奖励,而政策培训与线下培训之间的选择则无关紧要。 此外,评价指标和基准也是问题的一部分,因为它们没有衡量案文与及时性的相关性。 由于这些提示没有基本事实,依赖LLM法官和检索进行核查也使评价变得脆弱。 我们公布我们的代码,数据和检查站。

articles.title: Revisiting the Estimation of Unigram Surprisal in Computational Psycholinguistics
articles.content: Contextual and unigram surprisal are standard predictors of reading time in computational psycholinguistics. While contextual surprisal is typically derived from neural language models, unigram surprisal is usually obtained from independent corpus counts. Although both quantities are deterministic functionals of a single underlying distribution---capturing conditional and marginal structure respectively---this practice breaks their probabilistic link and may introduce estimation error from the mismatch. We propose three principles for estimating unigram surprisal in psycholinguistic research, including the requirement that both quantities be derived from the same language model. We operationalize this principle by introducing a Monte Carlo estimator of unigram surprisal from a language model, along with a marginalized variant that has lower variance empirically. When unigram surprisal is re-estimated under this unified framework, we find evidence that predictors change in their predictive contribution to reading time. We also confirm prior findings that frequency can be a stronger predictor of processing effort than contextual surprisal under this unified framework.
