articles.title_zh: 重审计算心理语言学中Unigram Surprisal的估算
articles.content_zh: 在计算心理语言学中,上下文和unigram suprisal是阅读时间的标准预测器. 虽然上下文外观一般取自神经语言模型,而单格外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外观外 虽然这两种量都是单一基础分布的确定性功能 -- -- 捕捉条件和边际结构 -- -- 这种做法打破了它们的概率联系,并可能引入不匹配的估计错误。 我们提出在心理语言学研究中估算单语超音速的三项原则,包括要求从同一种语言模型中得出两种数量。 我们从语言模式中引入了单格语补充语的蒙特卡洛估计法,同时引入了在经验上差异较小的边缘化变体,从而落实了这一原则。 当unigram surprisal在这个统一框架下重新估计时,我们发现预测器在预测其对阅读时间的贡献上会发生变化的证据. 我们还确认先前的调查结果,即频率是处理努力的更强预测器,而不是在这一统一框架下的环境优势。

articles.title: Not All Drift Is a Mechanism: Tracing Prompt Adaptation in LLMs
articles.content: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 并非全部漂流 是一个机制:追踪及时适应法学硕士课程
articles.content_zh: 基于即时的改编为专门使用被冷冻的语言模型提供了几种方法,从自然语言即时优化到学到的连续快取. 这些方法通常通过下游业绩进行比较,尽管类似的内部计算不需要产生类似的产出. 我们研究离散的即时优化,即时调和和前缀调和如何改变密集和混合的专家语言模型的处理. 我们的分析显示,适应的位置预测了任务信息如何被带入输出:优化后的文本主要改变响应构造,输入级提示将其影响写入内容表达,分层前缀通过注意保持直接控制. 在教育部模式中,这些差异进一步诱发了独特的专家路线模式。 同时,通用代表级测量对通用上下文变化反应强烈,不能可靠地区分出相匹配的安慰剂的有用适应. 我们主张,理解迅速适应要求将代表漂移与模型任务计算一致和因果使用的漂移部分区分开来。 这种观点为选择、评价和解释迅速适应方法提供了实际指导。

articles.title: Prompt-Injection Probes Learn the Conversation, Not Just the Injection
articles.content: Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 即时注射探测器 学习对话 不只是注射
articles.content_zh: 模型所隐藏状态上的线性探测器被用作间接即时注射的廉价显示器:它们筛选工具输出出一个代理读取,并发送出可疑的探测器到较慢的第二次检查,因此每个假警报都有成本. 但探测器会知道 任何能区分其训练实例的东西 注射探针的标准评价可以在没有模型的情况下通过:对话位置和文本长度单独达到0.91-0.98 AUROC. 当每次攻击被比作没有注射的同一种对话,或者用像注射一样无害的文字格式,标准探测器标出大多数这些无害的病例. 在培训数据中,我们把此类案例与负数相匹配。 在6个开放型号中,在培训期间和默认阈值的应用中,只改变培训数据将无注射对话的假警报从41-80%减少到4-27%,将无害外观从92-98%减少到3-16%。 我们的探测器仍能捕捉95%的中位数攻击, 在新的应用中,假警报保持低水平,但检测取决于模型和阈值的设定方式. 同样的数据也帮助了一个仅文本过滤器.

articles.title: Multi-Stream Residual Computation in Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion language models reconstruct masked tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive generation. Yet their Transformer backbones typically carry visible evidence and evolving masked predictions through a single residual stream. We equip masked diffusion models with multiple residual streams that persist through depth and adaptive routing between them, then investigate how they support these complementary roles. On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 扩散语言模型中的多结构残余计算
articles.content_zh: 分化语言模型平行地重建了被遮住的活符,为自发生成提供了一种替代. 然而,他们的变形器骨干通常通过单一的残余流携带可见证据并不断演化出被掩盖的预测. 我们为被遮住的传播模型配备了多条残留流,这些流流通过深度和适应性途径在它们之间持续存在,然后调查它们如何支持这些互补作用。 在前期训练任务方面,两道溪流在验证数据上减少了5.71%的重建迷惑度,与标准的剩余连接相比,整个外部公司平均减少了5.13%. 我们观察到,如果没有预先确定的角色,可见和被遮掩的位置就会学习出不同的路由规律. 原因干预表明,这种区别组织着读写路由,而具体符号的写作强度在每个角色中仍然很重要. 以这些调查结果为指导,一个受过角色条件化路线训练的模型恢复了增加第二流的验证收益的一半. 国家干预解释了额外流动的好处:它保留了早期的象征性表示,供以后再使用,而证据则在被遮蔽的位置上积累。 这一机制在更大的模型规模下重复出现,表明持久性流如何在改进预测的同时支持环境保护。

articles.title: PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes
articles.content: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to reduce reliance on costly human evaluation, yet their scores can systematically disagree with human judgments. We ask whether responses to an explicitly imposed evaluative bias can help correct a judge's implicit scoring biases. We introduce PRISM (Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment), which holds the evaluated content fixed and measures score changes when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized. A local sensitivity model motivates representing these responses as a surrogate Jacobian. Ridge regression on human labels learns a correction to the baseline score. The resulting scoring protocol is rubric-free: it uses overall scores without requesting criterion-level ratings. In the main Jev and Sol comparisons on SummEval summarization and HANNA story evaluation, PRISM and its learned-baseline variant significantly improve agreement with human rankings over uncalibrated scores while remaining competitive with rubric-based methods. A controlled SummEval comparison yields similar agreement for rubric-derived quality probes and style probes, supporting calibration without reproducing rubric criteria. The learned coefficients reveal shared and opposing correction directions across judges.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PISM: 校正带有反事实测试的黑盒法官
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型被越来越多地用作法官,以减少对昂贵的人类评价的依赖,然而他们的分数却会系统地与人类判断不相符. 我们问,对明确强加的评价偏见作出反应是否有助于纠正法官的隐含的评分偏见。 我们引入了PISM(Probe-based restitution of Scoring Misalignment),它将评价的内容固定下来,当属性被强调或被去强调时,计量分数会有所改变. 一个当地敏感性模型激励人们代表这些反应,作为代孕人雅各比安. 人类标签上的岭后退学习了对基线分数的校正. 由此而来得分协议是无粗略的:它使用整体分数而不要求标准等级分数. 在对SummEval summarization和HANNA故事评价的主要Jev和Sol比较中,PRISM及其所学底线变体大大改善了与人类排名高于未校正分数的一致,同时保持了对基于分数方法的竞争. 受控的SummEval比较得出了类似Rumic衍生出的质量探测器和样式探测器的协议,支持校正而无需再出Rumic标准. 学到的系数表明,法官们有共同和对立的改正方向。

articles.title: Pin It on Anyone: Certified Targeted Displacement of Multi-Bit LLM Watermarks Without the Key
articles.content: Multi-bit watermarking embeds a message, typically an account identifier, into LLM output so that harmful text can be traced to its origin. We show an attack technique that allows to alter the watermarking message. This allows to, for example, exchange the embedded account ID to an arbitrary different one. The attacker mainly needs access to a few accounts for generating LLM output and model logits, but crucially not the secret key used to watermark. The attacker then rewrites the text, keeping its meaning, so that the watermarking message decoder recovers the watermarking message embedded by the attacker. We are, to our knowledge, the first to propose such an attack, which we call a targeted displacement. Theoretically, we present upper and lower bounds on the probability of our attack succeeding. This bound depends on the number of accounts the attacker has access to, the length of the message and some characteristics of the given text. Our attack can succeed whenever we can bound the ambiguity of the generated text well enough. Empirically, we test our attack technique against five watermarking methods and four LLMs. Attack success tracks our predicted bounds, allowing us to alter watermarking messages in almost all cases with high accuracy, given enough accounts. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Batorskq/PinIt.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Bin It on Anyone:经认证的多比特LLM定向迁移 没有密钥的水印
articles.content_zh: 多位水标记将一个消息,通常是一个账户标识符,嵌入到LLM输出中,这样有害文本就可以被追溯到它的出处. 我们展示一种攻击技术 允许改变水印信息。 例如,这允许将嵌入式账户ID交换到任意的不同的账户. 攻击者主要需要访问几个账户来生成LLM输出和模型日志,但关键不是用于水印的秘密密钥. 攻击者再重写出文字,保留其意义,使水印信息解码器恢复由攻击者嵌入的水印信息. 据我们所知,我们首先提出这种攻击,我们称之为有针对性的流离失所。 理论上,我们呈现出我们攻击成功概率的上下界限。 此绑定取决于攻击者可以访问的帐号数量,消息的长度以及给定文本的一些特征. 只要我们能够很好地将所产生的文字的模糊性联系在一起,我们的攻击就能够成功。 从经验上讲,我们用5个水标记法和4个LLM来测试攻击技术. 攻击成功追踪到我们预计的界限,使我们能够在几乎所有情况下都以高度准确的方式改变水印信息,并有足够的说明。 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Batorskq/PinIt上找到.

articles.title: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English
articles.content: Post-training quantisation reduces the memory cost of large language models, but it remains unclear whether compression preserves language skills of regional varieties as reliably as their standard-language counterparts. We study this question for Bavarian, Standard German, and English using BAVGROUND, a multiple-choice benchmark, where 206 source questions are aligned across all three languages. Across 14 open-weight 7B--10B instruction models, we compare BF16 with 8-bit GPTQ and two 4-bit settings, GPTQ and AWQ. Eight-bit GPTQ remains close to BF16 and largely preserves the relative behaviour of the three languages, while 4-bit quantisation was found to be much less stable. The two 4-bit methods reduce average accuracy by about 1.4--1.5 percentage points and change 11.9--16.0% of BF16 decisions, with changes concentrated on examples where the BF16 model is already uncertain. This instability does not translate into a consistent Bavarian disadvantage. Although Bavarian, a low-resource dialect, has lower baseline accuracy than German and English, the language most affected at 4 bits varies across models and quantisation methods. Calibration further shapes these cross-language effects: the relative Bavarian--German effect changes with calibration language, while changing the calibration source has little average effect on GPTQ-4 but can affect AWQ-4 much more strongly. Free-form evaluation on five models further shows that 4-bit compression can degrade generated responses even in settings where multiple-choice accuracy changes only modestly, while 8-bit GPTQ remains comparatively stable. Overall, our results show that quantisation robustness for regional language varieties depends on the model, quantisation method, calibration data, and evaluation setting, and cannot be measured by aggregate multilingual accuracy alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 轻量级但语言公平? 横跨巴伐利亚、德文和英文的量子化
articles.content_zh: 训练后量化降低了大型语言模型的内存成本,但目前仍不清楚压缩能否像标准语言的对应物那样可靠地保留了区域品种的语言技能. 我们用BAVGROUND这一多选择基准来研究巴伐利亚语、标准德语和英语的这个问题,在这三种语言中,206个源问题都一致。 跨越14个开口重的7B-10B指令模型,我们比较了BF16和8位GPTQ以及两个4位设置,GPTQ和AWQ. 八位GPTQ仍然与BF16相近,并基本保持了三种语言的相对行为,而4位的四位分解则被认为稳定得多. 两种4位法将平均精度降低约1.4-1.5个百分点并更改了11.9-16.0%的BF16决定,而改变集中于BF16模型已经不确定的例子. 这种不稳定并没有转化为巴伐利亚一贯的劣势. 虽然低资源方言巴伐利亚语的基线精度低于德语和英语,但以4比特受影响最大的语言在模型和量化方法上有所不同. 校正进一步塑造了这些跨语言效应:相对的巴伐利亚-德意志效应会用校正语言来改变,而改变校正源对GPTQ-4几乎没有平均影响,但可以更强烈地影响AWQ-4. 对5个模型的自由式评价进一步显示,4位压缩即使在多选择精度变化不大的环境下也能降解生成的响应,而8位的GPTQ仍然相对稳定. 总的来说,我们的结果表明,区域语言品种的量化稳健性取决于模型、量化方法、校准数据和评价设置,不能仅用多语种总体准确性来衡量。

articles.title: Probing the Geometry of Color Representations in Multilingual Language Models
articles.content: Do multilingual language models learn a universal internal geometry for color, and is it perceptually grounded or primarily linguistic? We decompose color representations into two geometric axes: (P1) alignment to perceptual color space, and (P2) cross-lingual symmetry. Analyzing layerwise embeddings across models and multilingual datasets, we find that perceptual grounding is weak: alignment to CIE-LAB peaks in intermediate layers, then collapses toward output layers. Cross-lingual symmetry degrades with depth, suggesting later layers encode language-specific structure. Functionally, we show that geometric properties predict task performance: models achieve 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where P1 alignment peaks, with P1 alignment (r=0.70) significantly correlating with downstream capabilities. Our results reveal a dissociation: text-only LMs learn universal color-language geometry, not universal color-perception geometry, providing diagnostics for where perceptual structure is preserved in language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在多语种语言模型中检验颜色表示的几何
articles.content_zh: 多语种语言模型是否学习了一种通用的内相几何来表示颜色,它是否在概念上立足还是以语言为主? 我们把颜色表示分解成两个几何轴: (P1)与知觉色彩空间相接, (P2) 交叉语言对称. 分析跨模型和多语言数据集的分层嵌入,我们发现感知地平线很弱:与中间层的CIE-LAB峰相接,然后倒向输出层. 跨语言对称以深度降解,建议后层编码语言特有结构. 在功能上,我们显示几何属性预测任务性能:模型在P1对齐峰值的地层实现色分级的96.7%的精度,而P1对齐(r=0.70)与下游能力有显著的关联. 我们的研究结果揭示了一种分化:只有文本的LM学习了通用色彩语言几何,而不是通用色彩感知几何,为语言模型中保存了知觉结构的地方提供了诊断.

articles.title: Jev-Guard: Fast Routing and Auditing Agent Actions over Editable Policy Trees
articles.content: Agent harnesses require a low-latency guardrail model together with customizable audit policies. However, deploying an auto-regressive guardrail model remains challenging: such models incur high inference latency and are often poorly aligned with customized policies. To address these problems, we present Jev-Guard, a unified model for safety classification and policy routing. We further construct a policy tree over which Jev-Guard performs routing, spanning diverse domains including content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. Specifically, Jev-Guard first navigates the policy tree to select the applicable audit policy given the caller's audit context, and then performs safety classification conditioned on the retrieved policies. On 7,033 evaluation cases, Jev-Guard achieves 93.72\% safety accuracy, a mean latency of 58ms, and 93.10\% hierarchical routing accuracy. The full routing-and-classification pipeline averages 240ms. Furthermore, we integrate Jev-Guard into the Hermes harness framework. Across agent trajectories, its separate permission gate cuts mean review time per task from 4.80s for an SFT-LLM judge to 1.33s, with no policy violations are observed for either guard.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Jev- Guard: 快速运行和审计代理行动超过可编辑的政策树
articles.content_zh: 代理设备需要低纬度的护栏模型以及可定制的审计政策。 然而,采用自动递归式护栏模式仍然具有挑战性:这种模式具有很高的推论延迟性,而且往往与定制政策不相一致。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出Jev-Guard,一个安全分类和政策路线的统一模式。 包括内容节制、网络安全、隐私和法律合规。 具体来说,Jev-Guard首先在政策树上导航,根据呼叫者的审计背景选择适用的审计政策,然后在收回的政策上进行安全分类。 在7,033个评价案件中,Jev-Guard实现了93.72\%的安全精度,平均潜伏度为58ms;93.10\%分等级的路由精度. 全线贯通-分级管线平均240m. 此外,我们还将Jev-Guard纳入Hermes的利用框架。 纵观代理轨迹,其单独的许可门切口意味着每任务的审查时间从SFT-LLM法官的4.80分到1.33分,而任何一名警卫都没有违反政策的情况。

articles.title: Prompt or Policy? Optimizing Physician Slate Presentations with LLM User Simulators
articles.content: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 即时还是政策? 用 LLM 用户模拟器优化物理模型演示文稿
articles.content_zh: 选择合适的医生是寻求医疗的病人面临的一个关键挑战。 物理推荐系统识别出相关的医生,但患者仍然发现难以比较其剖面以作出决定. 我们制定最优化的列表:鉴于病人的医疗病例和固定的、排名排列的医生名单,我们生成简短的、针对具体案例的概要,使医生更容易比较,同时以他们简介中的信息为基础。 为了在不依赖真正的病人互动的情况下优化医生的介绍,我们开发了一个线下框架,使用个性化的LLMs模拟病人的选择. 我们从每个医疗病例中提取的属性中产生病人的个性,并评价陈述的事实准确性、相关性、自然性和模拟病人的选择。 我们还使用第二个LLM评委,在优化期间是看不见的,用来评估模拟器的特异性过于适应. 我们比较自动即时级优化与GEPA,参数级优化与GRPO,以及它们跨越两个模型大小的组合. GRPO在满足一整套制约因素方面大大超过GEPA,它在模拟转换方面的成果在看不见的判断下继续存在。 仅GEPA就带来了更小的改进,但利用其最优化的快取来初始化了GRPO加速了训练并实现了最高的模拟转换. 这些结果表明,迅速一级和参数一级优化在改进医生建议的提出方式方面起互补作用。

articles.title: SimInter: Evidence-Grounded User Simulation with Interview-Based Profile Enrichment for Conversational Recommender Systems
articles.content: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) require reliable user simulators for cost-effective evaluation. LLM-based simulators have made realistic simulation possible but typically condition on profiles derived from explicit ratings, demographics, and static sources capturing surface preferences while omitting implicit behavioral characteristics such as decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, and domain expertise. We propose SimInter, a pipeline that elicits these attributes via synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, grounded in the user's statistical profile and historical conversational evidence. Before profile enrichment, an audit agent explicitly flags potential fabrication and stereotyping at the turn level. We instantiate and evaluate SimInter on movie recommendation. We simulate 300 ReDial users and, on a matched subset of 100 users, compare SimInter with a statistics-only baseline: SimInter significantly increases the diversity of expressed preference aspects (filtered aspect entropy: 1.619 vs. 0.859; paired d = 0.96, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). This gain persists when the simulator converses with two trained recommenders, KBRD and UniCRS, under two independent evaluation judges (+0.28 to +0.56 nats; all p < 0.001). Human evaluation finds 94.3% of enriched-attribute claims supported or partially supported, while human judgments agree with 95.2% of the auditor's binary filtering decisions on a stratified sample.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SimInter: 以访谈为主的用户模拟, 丰富对话推荐系统
articles.content_zh: 竞争性推荐系统需要可靠的用户模拟器进行成本效益评价。 基于LLM的模拟器使得现实的模拟成为可能,但通常条件是来自明确评级、人口统计和静态源的剖面偏好,而忽略了隐含的行为特征,如决策风格、侧面偏好和领域专门知识。 我们提议SimInter,通过两个LLM代理人的合成访谈来获取这些属性的管道,基于用户的统计概况和历史对话证据. 在丰富概况之前,审计人员明确标出回合一级潜在的捏造和陈规定型。 我们根据电影推荐对SimInter进行即时评估。 我们模拟300个ReDial用户,并在100个用户的匹配子集上,将SimInter与仅统计基线进行比较: SimInter大大增加了表达的偏好方面的多样性(被过滤的一面 en:1.619 vs. 0.859;配对d=0.96,Holm调整后p < 0.001). 当模拟器在两名独立评审法官(+0.28至+0.56纳特;全部为 < 0.001页)下与两名训练有素的推荐人KBRD和UniCRS进行交流时,这一收益依然存在。 人类评价发现,94.3%的丰富属性索赔得到支持或部分支持,而人类的判断则同意审计师对分层抽样作出的95.2%的二进制过滤决定。

articles.title: LegalRewardBench: Benchmarking Reward Models for Legal Preference Evaluation
articles.content: Reward models are central to preference alignment for legal tasks, yet existing reward model benchmarks are still primarily centered on general-domain preferences. In this work, we introduce LegalRewardBench, the first human-verified benchmark for evaluating reward models in the legal domain. The benchmark organizes legal preference evaluation into five capability levels: knowledge, understanding, analysis, decision, and writing, and preference examples are constructed through rubric-guided automatic judging combined with human verification. We evaluate three families of judges, covering both general and fine-tuned models, and generative and discriminative architectures. Experimental results show that strong general-purpose generative models are currently the most robust legal reward models, while existing fine-tuned reward models transfer less reliably to legal preference evaluation. We also conduct detailed comparisons of input organizations and training strategies.

articles.title_zh: 法律奖励奔驰:法律优先评价基准奖励模式
articles.content_zh: 奖励模式对于调整法律任务的优惠至关重要,但现有的奖励模式基准仍然主要集中于一般领域。 在这部作品中,我们引入了Legal Reward Bench,这是第一个在法律领域评价奖励模式的人验证基准. 该基准将法律偏好评价组织为五个能力级别:知识、理解、分析、决定和写作,偏好实例是通过由指导的自动判断与人类核查相结合构建的。 我们评价三个法官家庭,既包括一般模型,也包括经过微调的模型,以及遗传性和歧视性建筑。 实验结果表明,强大的通用基因模型是目前最强大的法律奖励模型,而现有的微调奖励模型则不太可靠地转移到法律优先评价上. 我们还对投入组织和培训战略进行详细比较。

articles.title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
articles.content: Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research agents. Evidence analysis shows broader source inspection and greater coverage of supporting documents in the research loop, highlighting efficient evidence processing as a route to more capable autonomous research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: JevGPT:在自主研究中思考快慢
articles.content_zh: 自主研究人员必须在有限的预算范围内获取证据并进行论证. 然而,相关来源可能仍然未经检查或未使用,从而在检索范围和为研究提供依据的证据之间留下了空白。 挑战是如何使迅速的当地判断与不断变化的证据需要相配合,并将其调查结果反馈到研究决定中。 我们引入了JevGPT,一种自主研究的双系统架构,将证据处理与审议研究规划结合起来。 系统 二是确定证据目标和综合调查结果,一是系统定位支持、评估相关性并指导进一步检查。 独立的源判断平行进行;选定的原始段落为下一个研究步骤提供了信息。 关于固定公司问题回答和文件排名的实验表明,JevGPT实现了领先的任务性能,完成速度快,成本也比相较有效的研究剂要低. 证据分析显示,研究圈中源头检查范围更广,证明文件范围更广,突出了高效的证据处理是更有能力自主研究的途径.

articles.title: PAINT: A Framework for Multilingual Pain Representation from Medical Licensing Exams to Real-World Clinical Texts
articles.content: Pain is one of the most common and clinically important symptoms, reflecting disease onset, progression, and treatment response. However, pain is difficult to accurately capture and interpret from medical text, as its expression varies across languages, documentation types, and patient demographics, and is often embedded in terminology, negation, temporality, and contextual descriptions. Existing pain-related studies remain largely monolingual or limited to narrow clinical settings. In this study, we introduce PAINT, a multilingual framework for studying pain representation across medical exams and real-world clinical texts. PAINT includes nine pain-focused dataset partitions spanning English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese, with clinician annotations in all four languages. We curated a structured schema covering pain relevance, pain presence, anatomical location, pain descriptors, and demographic information. To capture multilingual pain representations, we leverage large language models (LLMs) and adopt an ensemble strategy to improve performance. Ten clinicians across four languages validate the labels: the ensemble reaches macro-F1 of 0.91-1.00 on pain relevance and pain presence and 92-100% accuracy on demographics, with inter-annotator $κ$ of 0.82-1.00. We release the WorldMedQA-Pain ensemble labels, the extraction pipeline, validation scripts, and clinician annotation sheets for publicly licensed corpora, providing a foundation for pain-centered clinical NLP and for studying pain documentation across languages and healthcare contexts.

articles.title_zh: PAINT:从医疗许可考试到真实世界临床文本的多种语言疼痛表现框架
articles.content_zh: 疼痛是最常见的临床上最重要的症状之一,反映了疾病的发作、进展和治疗反应。 然而,痛苦很难从医疗文本中准确捕捉和解释,因为其表达因语言、文献类型和病人人口统计而异,而且往往被嵌入术语、否定、时间和背景描述之中。 现有的与疼痛有关的研究基本上仍然是单一语言的或仅限于狭窄的临床环境. 在这项研究中,我们介绍了PAINT,这是一个多语种框架,用于研究通过医学考试和现实世界临床课本的疼痛表现。 PAINT包括9个以疼痛为重点的数据集分区,包括英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语和日语,所有四种语言都有临床说明。 我们设计了一个结构化的图案 包括疼痛的相关性 疼痛的存在 解剖位置 疼痛描述符 和人口信息 为了捕捉多语种疼痛表现,我们利用大型语言模型(LLMS),并采用综艺策略来提高性能. 4种语言的10名临床医生验证了标签:综艺节目在疼痛相关和疼痛存在方面达到0.91-1.00的宏F1,在人口统计方面达到92%-100%的准确度,广告间费用为0.82-1.00美元。 我们发布了WorldMedQA-Pain 综艺节目标签、提取管道、验证脚本和临床医生注释单,供公开许可的Corcora使用,为以疼痛为中心的临床NLP以及研究不同语言和保健背景的疼痛文献奠定了基础。

articles.title: Encrypted Skills Can Become New Security Exploits If AI Agents Know How to Decipher
articles.content: Third-party skills can expose LLM agents to malicious instructions hidden by encoding. We introduce Ciphered Skill Injection (CSI), which embeds such instructions in skill files for agents to decode and follow. We evaluate Caesar and layered variants across eight models and 139 injection-task pairs, separating instruction recovery from attack success. In the primary setting with shortened skills, the variants achieve attack success rates of up to 47.5% and 40.3%, respectively. Successful decoding does not guarantee attack success, and layering has model-dependent effects. The tested skill scanners rarely flag injected skills. These findings highlight the risk of promoting decoded, untrusted content into actionable instructions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 如果 AI 代理商知道如何解密,加密的技能可以成为新的安全爆炸
articles.content_zh: 第三方技能可以使LLM代理通过编码被隐藏的恶意指令所暴露. 我们引入了 Cephered 技能注射(CSI),将此类指令嵌入技能文件中,供特工解码并遵循. 我们评价凯撒和分层变体 跨越了8个模型和139个注射任务对 将指令恢复和攻击成功分开 在技能缩短的小学阶段,这些变体分别达到47.5%和40.3%。 成功的解码并不能保证攻击成功,分层具有模型依赖的效果. 被测试的技能扫描仪很少用旗子来注入技能. 这些调查结果突出了将解码、不可信内容推广到可操作指令的风险。

articles.title: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
articles.content: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 我们测试太多吗? 高语文模式有效评价基准压缩调查
articles.content_zh: 基准对于评价和改进大型语言模型至关重要。 然而,许多广泛使用的基准是多余的,使评价不必要地昂贵。 基准压缩通过从部分评价中估算出全基准分数和排名来降低这一成本. 2024年以来,这方面的研究迅速发展,但据我们所知,没有一项调查系统地组织其方法和调查结果。 我们审查119篇论文,解释如何选择评估、恢复全部基准结果并核实其可靠性的方法。 从这一分析中,我们开发了一个分类学,涵盖单个基准范围内的压缩,跨基准套件的压缩,在适应性评价期间,以及冗余和可靠性方面的工作。 我们比较了他们的信息需求、总成本、可靠性检查和局限性。 方法通过选择具有代表性的子集,使用更便宜或可重复使用的信息,并进行适应性测试来降低评价成本,但有覆盖面差、估计数不准确和相继延误的风险。 由此产生的分类和实用指南帮助研究人员选择、验证和部署方法,以进行更有效和可靠的LLM评价。

articles.title: PACT: A Pragmatic Prompting Framework for Expressive and Voice-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation
articles.content: Speech-to-speech translation should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascade systems can preserve content or timbre, but often struggle to realize emotion, tone, rhythm, pauses, and pragmatic attitude in the target language. We propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT extracts source pragmatic cues, projects them into the target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator. On bidirectional Spanish-English TOPI evaluation, PACT achieves the best overall performance among evaluated systems across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PACT: 表达式和语音保留对语音翻译实用提示框架
articles.content_zh: 对口相传的翻译不仅应保留所说的话,而且应保留谁说的和如何说的. 现有的端到端的S2ST,语音MLLM,和级联系统可以保留内容或timbre,但往往在目标语言中挣扎去实现情感,语气,节奏,暂停,以及务实的态度. 我们提议PACT,这是一个目标空间实用的激励框架,用于表达和语音保留S2ST。 PACT提取出源实用提示,将其投放到目标语言表达空间中,将预测的表达值校正到可实现的目标子空间,并转换为被冻结的语音生成器的连续提示. 在西班牙语-英语TOPI双向评价中,PACT在内容忠实、语音保存和表达保全指标等被评价系统中取得了最佳的总体业绩。
